b095f89ead5ae6ee8f28ddcdc6f81e1493857ea5.goal: Speeds up longwave radiative transfer calculations in atmospheric models, which are costly when called at every grid point and time step.
b095f89ead5ae6ee8f28ddcdc6f81e1493857ea5.architecture: Multilayer perceptron (the NeuroFlux approach) that maps atmospheric temperature, humidity and cloud profiles to longwave fluxes and cooling rates.
b095f89ead5ae6ee8f28ddcdc6f81e1493857ea5.data: Trained on radiative transfer calculations over a large set of representative atmospheric profiles (the TIGR climatological dataset).
b095f89ead5ae6ee8f28ddcdc6f81e1493857ea5.result: The network reproduces longwave fluxes and cooling rates with accuracy close to the reference scheme at a much lower computational cost. Exact speed-up figures are not reported here.
b095f89ead5ae6ee8f28ddcdc6f81e1493857ea5.open_work: Extending the approach to more complex cloud representations and coupling it operationally in GCMs and NWP models.
b095f89ead5ae6ee8f28ddcdc6f81e1493857ea5.issues: Fixed profile inputs and training set limit generalization to unseen climates; offline accuracy does not guarantee stable online coupling. Abstract unavailable.

283755d554bcf4a23528d70da6addeb08e4898c8.goal: Reduces the cost of the longwave radiation parameterization in a climate model by replacing it with an accurate, fast statistical emulator.
283755d554bcf4a23528d70da6addeb08e4898c8.architecture: Shallow feed-forward neural network (single hidden layer MLP) emulating the full longwave radiation scheme, mapping column profiles to heating rates and fluxes.
283755d554bcf4a23528d70da6addeb08e4898c8.data: Input/output pairs generated by the original longwave radiation scheme in the NCAR Community Atmospheric Model (CAM) climate simulations.
283755d554bcf4a23528d70da6addeb08e4898c8.result: The NN emulation is much faster than the original scheme while closely reproducing its outputs; multiyear runs with the emulator stay close to control simulations.
283755d554bcf4a23528d70da6addeb08e4898c8.open_work: Emulating shortwave radiation and other physics, and checking robustness in changed-climate conditions.
283755d554bcf4a23528d70da6addeb08e4898c8.issues: Emulates an existing parameterization, so inherits its errors; generalization outside the training climate is not guaranteed. Abstract unavailable.

f9c990b1b5724e50e5632b94fdb7484ece8a6ce7.goal: Frames radar precipitation nowcasting as spatiotemporal sequence forecasting to predict short-term local rainfall intensity.
f9c990b1b5724e50e5632b94fdb7484ece8a6ce7.architecture: Convolutional LSTM (ConvLSTM), replacing the matrix multiplications of FC-LSTM with convolutions in input-to-state and state-to-state transitions, in an encoder-forecaster setup.
f9c990b1b5724e50e5632b94fdb7484ece8a6ce7.data: Moving MNIST synthetic sequences and a Hong Kong Observatory radar echo dataset (sequences of radar maps).
f9c990b1b5724e50e5632b94fdb7484ece8a6ce7.result: ConvLSTM captures spatiotemporal correlations better than FC-LSTM and outperforms the operational optical-flow ROVER algorithm on nowcasting metrics.
f9c990b1b5724e50e5632b94fdb7484ece8a6ce7.open_work: Handling location-variant motion, longer lead times and sharper predictions (addressed later by TrajGRU and successors).
f9c990b1b5724e50e5632b94fdb7484ece8a6ce7.issues: Predictions blur with lead time due to MSE-type training; evaluation limited to one region and short horizons; deterministic only.

5d150cec2775f9bc863760448f14104cc8f42368.goal: Discovers governing equations of dynamical systems directly from measurement data, producing parsimonious, interpretable models.
5d150cec2775f9bc863760448f14104cc8f42368.architecture: SINDy: sparse regression (sequentially thresholded least squares) over a library of candidate nonlinear functions to select the few active terms in the dynamics. Not deep learning.
5d150cec2775f9bc863760448f14104cc8f42368.data: Simulated data from canonical systems: linear and nonlinear oscillators, the chaotic Lorenz system, and vortex shedding behind a cylinder (via a reduced POD basis).
5d150cec2775f9bc863760448f14104cc8f42368.result: Recovers correct equations from noisy data, including the Lorenz system and the mean-field model of vortex shedding; extends to parameterized, time-varying and forced systems.
5d150cec2775f9bc863760448f14104cc8f42368.open_work: Scaling to high-dimensional systems, choosing good coordinates and function libraries, and robustness to heavy noise.
5d150cec2775f9bc863760448f14104cc8f42368.issues: Relies on the dynamics being sparse in the chosen library; sensitive to noise in derivative estimation; demonstrated mostly on low-dimensional systems.

35e4b2d62ff35ade25f89c09e22a65b1279756e9.goal: Reviews how numerical weather prediction steadily improved through scientific and computational advances, and what challenges lie ahead.
35e4b2d62ff35ade25f89c09e22a65b1279756e9.architecture: Review/perspective (not ML) covering physical process representation, ensemble forecasting, data assimilation and high-performance computing.
35e4b2d62ff35ade25f89c09e22a65b1279756e9.data: Draws on operational forecast skill records, notably from ECMWF and other major centres.
35e4b2d62ff35ade25f89c09e22a65b1279756e9.result: Forecast skill has increased by roughly one day of lead time per decade, so a 6-day forecast today matches a 5-day forecast a decade earlier, driven by incremental improvements.
35e4b2d62ff35ade25f89c09e22a65b1279756e9.open_work: Seamless prediction, higher resolution, Earth-system coupling, and computing/energy efficiency on future architectures.
35e4b2d62ff35ade25f89c09e22a65b1279756e9.issues: Predates the ML weather-model era, so it does not address data-driven forecasting. Abstract unavailable.

180e0380046d1da2bf512d6b4bb27bd7038353b2.goal: Reduces systematic bias in satellite infrared-based precipitation estimates, which suffer from a weak link between cloud-top properties and surface rain.
180e0380046d1da2bf512d6b4bb27bd7038353b2.architecture: Deep neural network (stacked denoising autoencoder) that extracts features from satellite infrared imagery to correct precipitation estimates.
180e0380046d1da2bf512d6b4bb27bd7038353b2.data: Geostationary infrared satellite imagery and the PERSIANN-CCS product, evaluated against radar-based precipitation over the central United States (details not confirmed).
180e0380046d1da2bf512d6b4bb27bd7038353b2.result: The deep network reduces bias in the satellite precipitation estimates relative to the baseline product. Specific numbers not reported here.
180e0380046d1da2bf512d6b4bb27bd7038353b2.open_work: Adding further channels such as water vapor and microwave data, and extending evaluation to other regions and seasons.
180e0380046d1da2bf512d6b4bb27bd7038353b2.issues: Limited region and period; depends on radar reference data for training. Abstract unavailable.

84e21a55d1078ed8f3debbb0f5dfd05d007c86b2.goal: Replaces subjective threshold-based detection of extreme weather events in climate data with learned pattern recognition.
84e21a55d1078ed8f3debbb0f5dfd05d007c86b2.architecture: Deep convolutional neural network classifiers tuned with Bayesian hyperparameter optimization, one per event type.
84e21a55d1078ed8f3debbb0f5dfd05d007c86b2.data: Labeled image patches from climate simulations and reanalysis (e.g., CAM5 output) for tropical cyclones, atmospheric rivers and weather fronts.
84e21a55d1078ed8f3debbb0f5dfd05d007c86b2.result: Classification accuracy of about 89% to 99% for tropical cyclones, atmospheric rivers and weather fronts.
84e21a55d1078ed8f3debbb0f5dfd05d007c86b2.open_work: Moving from patch classification to localization and segmentation in full global fields, and reducing reliance on labels.
84e21a55d1078ed8f3debbb0f5dfd05d007c86b2.issues: Labels come from heuristic detection schemes, so the CNN learns those definitions; classification of pre-cropped patches, not detection in raw data.

8a97057ac40a67f211481d4a1250849cc6eb6f75.goal: Improves the spatial resolution of satellite-derived sea surface temperature fields with deep learning.
8a97057ac40a67f211481d4a1250849cc6eb6f75.architecture: Convolutional neural network for single-image super-resolution (SRCNN-type) applied to SST maps.
8a97057ac40a67f211481d4a1250849cc6eb6f75.data: Satellite-derived SST products; low-resolution inputs generated by degrading higher-resolution fields (exact product not confirmed).
8a97057ac40a67f211481d4a1250849cc6eb6f75.result: The CNN reconstructs finer-scale SST structure better than standard interpolation baselines. Quantitative gains not reported here.
8a97057ac40a67f211481d4a1250849cc6eb6f75.open_work: Using multi-source inputs and handling real missing data (clouds) rather than synthetic degradation.
8a97057ac40a67f211481d4a1250849cc6eb6f75.issues: Trained on synthetic degradation, which may not match real resolution differences; workshop-scale study. Abstract unavailable.

3faebe9d5c47fc90998811c4ac768706283d605c.goal: Detects and localizes many types of extreme weather in climate simulations when labeled data are scarce.
3faebe9d5c47fc90998811c4ac768706283d605c.architecture: Multichannel spatiotemporal encoder-decoder (3D convolutional autoencoder) with a one-pass bounding-box regression loss, trained semi-supervised.
3faebe9d5c47fc90998811c4ac768706283d605c.data: Multi-variable climate simulation output (CAM5) with bounding-box labels from heuristic detectors plus unlabeled data (released as the ExtremeWeather dataset).
3faebe9d5c47fc90998811c4ac768706283d605c.result: Temporal information and unlabeled data improve localization of extreme weather events; learned representations aid exploratory analysis.
3faebe9d5c47fc90998811c4ac768706283d605c.open_work: Improving detection of small or rare event classes and extending to more event types and observational data.
3faebe9d5c47fc90998811c4ac768706283d605c.issues: Overall localization accuracy remains modest, especially for small events; labels inherit heuristic biases.

e1c8f86668d3e37e430f187b7fd91d1643a0a0ff.goal: Argues that purely data-driven models generalize poorly in science and proposes integrating scientific theory into data science.
e1c8f86668d3e37e430f187b7fd91d1643a0a0ff.architecture: Conceptual framework and taxonomy (theory-guided data science) covering theory-guided model design, learning, refinement, hybrid models and data assimilation.
e1c8f86668d3e37e430f187b7fd91d1643a0a0ff.data: No new data; illustrative examples from turbulence, hydrology, climate science, materials and biomedicine.
e1c8f86668d3e37e430f187b7fd91d1643a0a0ff.result: Formalizes the TGDS paradigm and a taxonomy of ways to combine domain knowledge with ML, with illustrative examples.
e1c8f86668d3e37e430f187b7fd91d1643a0a0ff.open_work: The paper highlights research avenues for each theme, such as physics-consistent losses and hybrid physics-ML models.
e1c8f86668d3e37e430f187b7fd91d1643a0a0ff.issues: Conceptual; no quantitative benchmarks, so practical gains are not demonstrated.

051bc84485f0d9be02003e27e0ca67e9a06f2e4d.goal: Improves deep-learning precipitation nowcasting and sets up standard evaluation, since ConvLSTM is location-invariant and protocols were lacking.
051bc84485f0d9be02003e27e0ca67e9a06f2e4d.architecture: Trajectory GRU (TrajGRU), a recurrent model that learns location-variant recurrent connections via flow fields, in an encoder-forecaster structure.
051bc84485f0d9be02003e27e0ca67e9a06f2e4d.data: HKO-7 benchmark: multi-year Hong Kong Observatory radar echo dataset, with a weighted (balanced) loss and online/offline evaluation protocols.
051bc84485f0d9be02003e27e0ca67e9a06f2e4d.result: TrajGRU outperforms ConvLSTM, other deep models and optical-flow baselines on the benchmark, especially with the balanced loss emphasizing heavy rain.
051bc84485f0d9be02003e27e0ca67e9a06f2e4d.open_work: Better handling of heavy rain, longer horizons and reducing blurring, using the released benchmark.
051bc84485f0d9be02003e27e0ca67e9a06f2e4d.issues: Deterministic, MSE-type training still blurs; single radar domain; skill for intense convection remains limited.

71b9e91d1cf0c3c388194d3f76a8e19bb5cf93c2.goal: Downscales coarse Earth system model output to local scales for impact assessment using image super-resolution.
71b9e91d1cf0c3c388194d3f76a8e19bb5cf93c2.architecture: DeepSD: stacked super-resolution CNNs (SRCNN) applied in successive resolution steps, with auxiliary inputs such as elevation as extra channels.
71b9e91d1cf0c3c388194d3f76a8e19bb5cf93c2.data: Daily precipitation over the continental US (gridded observations, e.g., PRISM) at 1 degree upscaled to 1/8 degree; applied to CMIP5 models on NASA NEX.
71b9e91d1cf0c3c388194d3f76a8e19bb5cf93c2.result: DeepSD compares favorably to BCSD and three automated statistical downscaling methods for daily precipitation from 1 degree to 1/8 degree.
71b9e91d1cf0c3c388194d3f76a8e19bb5cf93c2.open_work: Applying to many ESMs and scenarios, adding uncertainty quantification and other variables.
71b9e91d1cf0c3c388194d3f76a8e19bb5cf93c2.issues: Deterministic output; performance for extremes and in a changed climate is uncertain; trained in a perfect-prognosis setting.

8ade8490efaf0a0d8ab346953272e126a120af0c.goal: Estimates causal networks from large, high-dimensional, nonlinear time series where standard methods lose power or yield false positives.
8ade8490efaf0a0d8ab346953272e126a120af0c.architecture: PCMCI: a causal discovery algorithm combining PC-style condition selection with momentary conditional independence tests, using linear (partial correlation) or nonlinear tests. Not deep learning.
8ade8490efaf0a0d8ab346953272e126a120af0c.data: Climate time series with known mechanisms, human heart data, and large synthetic datasets mimicking real data properties.
8ade8490efaf0a0d8ab346953272e126a120af0c.result: PCMCI outperforms state-of-the-art methods in detection power while controlling false positives.
8ade8490efaf0a0d8ab346953272e126a120af0c.open_work: Handling contemporaneous links, hidden confounders and nonstationarity in Earth-system data.
8ade8490efaf0a0d8ab346953272e126a120af0c.issues: Assumes causal sufficiency and stationarity; results depend on the chosen variables and test.

c14c26310a14036fbe780f8d9474f07346dee9c7.goal: Proposes reducing climate projection uncertainty by having Earth system model parameterizations learn from observations and high-resolution simulations.
c14c26310a14036fbe780f8d9474f07346dee9c7.architecture: Blueprint combining data assimilation and machine learning (e.g., ensemble Kalman inversion) to calibrate parameterizations by matching low-order statistics.
c14c26310a14036fbe780f8d9474f07346dee9c7.data: Illustration with a simple chaotic dynamical system (Lorenz 96 type); proposes global observations and targeted LES/cloud-resolving simulations.
c14c26310a14036fbe780f8d9474f07346dee9c7.result: Shows with a toy system that parameters can be learned from time-averaged statistics; outlines the framework and its opportunities.
c14c26310a14036fbe780f8d9474f07346dee9c7.open_work: Realizing the framework in a full ESM, designing targeted high-resolution simulations and quantifying uncertainty.
c14c26310a14036fbe780f8d9474f07346dee9c7.issues: Perspective with only a toy demonstration; scalability to real models is untested.

c2091b244ec71e9e1866c1e325113e7f5cd89f59.goal: Automates detection and classification of ocean mesoscale eddies from altimetry.
c2091b244ec71e9e1866c1e325113e7f5cd89f59.architecture: EddyNet: convolutional encoder-decoder (U-Net-like) with pixel-wise classification into non-eddy, anticyclonic and cyclonic classes.
c2091b244ec71e9e1866c1e325113e7f5cd89f59.data: CMEMS sea surface height maps with labels from a conventional eddy detection algorithm.
c2091b244ec71e9e1866c1e325113e7f5cd89f59.result: Produces pixel-wise eddy segmentation maps; code, data and weights are released. Quantitative accuracy not given in the abstract.
c2091b244ec71e9e1866c1e325113e7f5cd89f59.open_work: Extending to 3D eddy structure, temporal tracking and other ocean variables.
c2091b244ec71e9e1866c1e325113e7f5cd89f59.issues: Labels come from a traditional detector, so the network inherits its definitions; limited to gridded altimetry resolution.

d16aac741559ee9b3d0b79e4d4eebec22d1bdf12.goal: Tests whether modern ML methods improve statistical downscaling of daily and extreme precipitation from GCMs.
d16aac741559ee9b3d0b79e4d4eebec22d1bdf12.architecture: Comparison of perfect-prognosis methods (OLS, Elastic-Net, SVM, multi-task sparse structure learning, autoencoders) and a hybrid MSSL+BCSD approach.
d16aac741559ee9b3d0b79e4d4eebec22d1bdf12.data: Reanalysis predictors and gridded observed daily precipitation over the United States (details not confirmed).
d16aac741559ee9b3d0b79e4d4eebec22d1bdf12.result: No method is consistently best; L1 sparsity helps; MSSL+BCSD improves daily to annual predictability over BCSD but worsens extremes.
d16aac741559ee9b3d0b79e4d4eebec22d1bdf12.open_work: Developing methods that capture extremes and remain reliable under nonstationary climate.
d16aac741559ee9b3d0b79e4d4eebec22d1bdf12.issues: Limited set of methods and regions; perfect-prognosis evaluation does not test performance in future climates.

c3c537d10bb9132218b8a3d1afe7949b6e65d32d.goal: Improves identification of precipitating areas from geostationary satellites, a key step in satellite precipitation estimation.
c3c537d10bb9132218b8a3d1afe7949b6e65d32d.architecture: Deep neural network (stacked denoising autoencoder) using bispectral infrared and water vapor channel information.
c3c537d10bb9132218b8a3d1afe7949b6e65d32d.data: Geostationary satellite IR and water vapor imagery with radar-based precipitation as reference over the US (details not confirmed).
c3c537d10bb9132218b8a3d1afe7949b6e65d32d.result: Using both channels with deep learning improves rain/no-rain identification over the operational PERSIANN-CCS baseline. Numbers not reported here.
c3c537d10bb9132218b8a3d1afe7949b6e65d32d.open_work: Adding more channels and moving from rain detection to rain-rate estimation.
c3c537d10bb9132218b8a3d1afe7949b6e65d32d.issues: Regional study; depends on radar reference; abstract unavailable.

566d9637c465e4dfc1c1695ecc7155adbb54f45c.goal: Improves spatiotemporal predictive learning (video and radar sequence prediction) by better memorizing both spatial and temporal information.
566d9637c465e4dfc1c1695ecc7155adbb54f45c.architecture: PredRNN: stacked spatiotemporal LSTM (ST-LSTM) units with a zigzag memory flow across layers and time steps.
566d9637c465e4dfc1c1695ecc7155adbb54f45c.data: Moving MNIST, KTH human actions, and a radar echo dataset for precipitation nowcasting.
566d9637c465e4dfc1c1695ecc7155adbb54f45c.result: Reports state-of-the-art results on the three benchmarks at the time, outperforming ConvLSTM.
566d9637c465e4dfc1c1695ecc7155adbb54f45c.open_work: Better long-term prediction, reduced blur and deeper-in-time memory (addressed in PredRNN++ and later versions).
566d9637c465e4dfc1c1695ecc7155adbb54f45c.issues: Deterministic MSE training produces blurry long-range forecasts; radar evaluation is limited in scope. Abstract unavailable.

5e957fc9849abff8e3a606df05d94381ef565a8d.goal: Shows how AI and machine learning can support real-time forecaster decision-making for high-impact weather.
5e957fc9849abff8e3a606df05d94381ef565a8d.architecture: Review with examples, mainly tree-based methods (random forests, gradient boosted trees) and other ML used for diagnosing and predicting hazards.
5e957fc9849abff8e3a606df05d94381ef565a8d.data: Examples use NWP model output, radar and satellite observations for hazards such as severe hail, storm duration, precipitation and aviation turbulence.
5e957fc9849abff8e3a606df05d94381ef565a8d.result: ML methods improve over traditional approaches in several high-impact weather applications and can be used in real time.
5e957fc9849abff8e3a606df05d94381ef565a8d.open_work: Wider operational adoption, interpretability for forecasters, and integration with ensemble forecasts.
5e957fc9849abff8e3a606df05d94381ef565a8d.issues: Predates deep learning prevalence in the field; case-based evidence rather than systematic comparison. Abstract unavailable.

5903d43b6f3b3d620b79d67a6e9b28dbcc216ea5.goal: Predicts sea surface temperature by modelling both temporal evolution and spatial correlation of SST fields.
5903d43b6f3b3d620b79d67a6e9b28dbcc216ea5.architecture: CFCC-LSTM: fully connected LSTM combined with a convolution layer to capture spatial and temporal information.
5903d43b6f3b3d620b79d67a6e9b28dbcc216ea5.data: Satellite-based SST data over coastal seas of China (exact product not confirmed).
5903d43b6f3b3d620b79d67a6e9b28dbcc216ea5.result: The model outperforms comparison methods for short-range SST prediction. Specific errors not reported here.
5903d43b6f3b3d620b79d67a6e9b28dbcc216ea5.open_work: Longer lead times, larger domains and inclusion of atmospheric forcing.
5903d43b6f3b3d620b79d67a6e9b28dbcc216ea5.issues: Purely data-driven regional model; limited lead times. Abstract unavailable.

7fddb9e32ddc4c82d952a056a8d6e256b5b0539a.goal: Provides flow-dependent typhoon-induced SST cooling to atmosphere-only typhoon forecast models, which lack ocean feedback.
7fddb9e32ddc4c82d952a056a8d6e256b5b0539a.architecture: Neural network algorithms: a shallow single-layer network and a deep network (4x5 neuron matrix) separating atmospheric and oceanic factors in different layers.
7fddb9e32ddc4c82d952a056a8d6e256b5b0539a.data: Historical typhoon and ocean data (atmospheric factors such as winds, oceanic factors such as eddies); tested in four typhoon case simulations.
7fddb9e32ddc4c82d952a056a8d6e256b5b0539a.result: The deep algorithm gives a stable crescent-shaped cooling pattern and reduces maximum wind intensity errors by 60-70% in four cases versus atmosphere-only runs.
7fddb9e32ddc4c82d952a056a8d6e256b5b0539a.open_work: Testing on many more typhoons and in operational forecast systems.
7fddb9e32ddc4c82d952a056a8d6e256b5b0539a.issues: Only four case studies; very small network; compared against atmosphere-only runs rather than coupled models.

cd750a59358efcc61f0e5112b71e876cc0cc0204.goal: Uses ML to infer unresolved ocean processes: subgrid eddy momentum forcing for coarse models and subsurface flow from surface data.
cd750a59358efcc61f0e5112b71e876cc0cc0204.architecture: Convolutional neural networks, optionally constrained to conserve global momentum.
cd750a59358efcc61f0e5112b71e876cc0cc0204.data: Coarse-grained output from a high-resolution quasi-geostrophic ocean model (idealized double-gyre configuration).
cd750a59358efcc61f0e5112b71e876cc0cc0204.result: CNNs reproduce spatiotemporal variability of subgrid eddy forcing, generalize across dynamical regimes, work with 10-20% of the training data, and predict subsurface flow from surface fields.
cd750a59358efcc61f0e5112b71e876cc0cc0204.open_work: Implementing and testing the parameterization online in coarse-resolution ocean and climate models.
cd750a59358efcc61f0e5112b71e876cc0cc0204.issues: Offline, idealized QG setting; online stability and realism in primitive-equation models untested.

6117239f75255bc281051b0b5876102f820b337f.goal: Tests whether ML trained on explicit convection can replace convection parameterizations, a key source of climate model bias.
6117239f75255bc281051b0b5876102f820b337f.architecture: Deep neural network (Cloud Brain, CBRAIN) mapping column states to convective heating, moistening and radiative tendencies.
6117239f75255bc281051b0b5876102f820b337f.data: Superparameterized climate model (SPCAM, embedded 2D cloud-resolving models) in an aquaplanet with prescribed SSTs; as little as three months of training data.
6117239f75255bc281051b0b5876102f820b337f.result: CBRAIN skillfully predicts convective heating, moistening and radiative features, but reduces some of the superparameterization's variance.
6117239f75255bc281051b0b5876102f820b337f.open_work: Online coupling in the host GCM and representing stochastic variability.
6117239f75255bc281051b0b5876102f820b337f.issues: Offline evaluation only; aquaplanet; variance underestimated; deterministic.

f772c778135e095d7f77d6536b673958caa7c2df.goal: Forecasts high-dimensional chaotic systems in a reduced-order space using data alone.
f772c778135e095d7f77d6536b673958caa7c2df.architecture: LSTM networks in reduced-order space, and a hybrid mean stochastic model plus LSTM (MSM-LSTM) to ensure convergence to the invariant measure.
f772c778135e095d7f77d6536b673958caa7c2df.data: Time series from Lorenz 96, the Kuramoto-Sivashinsky equation and a prototype barotropic climate model.
f772c778135e095d7f77d6536b673958caa7c2df.result: LSTMs outperform Gaussian processes in short-term accuracy in all cases; the hybrid improves long-term statistical behaviour.
f772c778135e095d7f77d6536b673958caa7c2df.open_work: Scaling to more realistic, higher-dimensional systems and quantifying forecast uncertainty.
f772c778135e095d7f77d6536b673958caa7c2df.issues: Toy systems; reduced-order truncation; long-term forecasts can drift without the hybrid stochastic component.

22d76f68966f54d0ec36fd3381b2c0afea50766c.goal: Forecasts urban air quality (mainly PM2.5) from multivariate time series to support pollution early warning.
22d76f68966f54d0ec36fd3381b2c0afea50766c.architecture: Hybrid deep model combining 1D CNNs for local trend and spatial features with bidirectional LSTMs for temporal dependencies.
22d76f68966f54d0ec36fd3381b2c0afea50766c.data: Two real-world air quality datasets of pollutant and meteorological time series (Beijing-related data likely; not confirmed).
22d76f68966f54d0ec36fd3381b2c0afea50766c.result: The model forecasts PM2.5 with good accuracy and outperforms baseline methods. Numbers not given in the abstract.
22d76f68966f54d0ec36fd3381b2c0afea50766c.open_work: Longer forecast horizons, integration of meteorological forecasts and emissions.
22d76f68966f54d0ec36fd3381b2c0afea50766c.issues: Station time-series focus without explicit chemistry or transport; limited datasets.

45dd8b0c687f2d74a3986f9954bd1b2a2e093aa6.goal: Replaces heuristic subgrid parameterizations, especially for clouds and convection, with a neural network trained on explicit convection.
45dd8b0c687f2d74a3986f9954bd1b2a2e093aa6.architecture: Fully connected deep neural network predicting all subgrid heating, moistening and radiative tendencies from column states, coupled online in a GCM.
45dd8b0c687f2d74a3986f9954bd1b2a2e093aa6.data: Superparameterized Community Atmosphere Model (SPCAM) aquaplanet simulations with prescribed SSTs.
45dd8b0c687f2d74a3986f9954bd1b2a2e093aa6.result: Online multiyear simulations are stable and reproduce mean climate, precipitation extremes and the equatorial wave spectrum; energy is approximately conserved; generalizes to new SST patterns.
45dd8b0c687f2d74a3986f9954bd1b2a2e093aa6.open_work: Extending to real geography, ensuring stability and constraints, and handling out-of-distribution climates.
45dd8b0c687f2d74a3986f9954bd1b2a2e093aa6.issues: Fails for temperatures well outside the training range; aquaplanet; later work showed online instability for other network configurations.

ba48ca00f21b0a882133a1eadc3ee126195897d8.goal: Scales deep learning for pixel-level segmentation of extreme weather patterns in climate data to the largest supercomputers.
ba48ca00f21b0a882133a1eadc3ee126195897d8.architecture: Segmentation networks (Tiramisu and DeepLabv3+ variants) with improved software frameworks, input pipeline and distributed training algorithms.
ba48ca00f21b0a882133a1eadc3ee126195897d8.data: High-resolution CAM5 climate simulation output with heuristic labels for tropical cyclones and atmospheric rivers.
ba48ca00f21b0a882133a1eadc3ee126195897d8.result: DeepLabv3+ scales to 27,360 V100 GPUs at 325.8 PF/s sustained (90.7% efficiency); FP16 reaches 1.13 EF/s peak and 999 PF/s sustained; Gordon Bell Prize winner.
ba48ca00f21b0a882133a1eadc3ee126195897d8.open_work: Improving label quality and using segmentations for scientific analysis of extremes under climate change.
ba48ca00f21b0a882133a1eadc3ee126195897d8.issues: Focus is computing performance; labels from heuristic detectors; scientific accuracy evaluation is limited.

e775751e215e783da6b388fd604e83484a27e5e1.goal: Combines an imperfect knowledge-based model with machine learning to improve forecasts of chaotic systems.
e775751e215e783da6b388fd604e83484a27e5e1.architecture: Hybrid scheme coupling reservoir computing (echo state network) with an approximate physical model.
e775751e215e783da6b388fd604e83484a27e5e1.data: Simulated data from the Lorenz 63 system and the Kuramoto-Sivashinsky equation, with deliberately imperfect models.
e775751e215e783da6b388fd604e83484a27e5e1.result: The hybrid predicts accurately for much longer than either the reservoir alone or the imperfect model alone.
e775751e215e783da6b388fd604e83484a27e5e1.open_work: Applying the hybrid approach to weather prediction and other high-dimensional real systems.
e775751e215e783da6b388fd604e83484a27e5e1.issues: Low-dimensional or idealized tests; model error introduced by parameter perturbation; no noisy partial observations.

0a4d4f24f508f9df37e4a155e394f6f062951732.goal: Improves subseasonal (weeks 3-4 and 5-6) temperature and precipitation forecasts for western US water management, in the Subseasonal Climate Forecast Rodeo.
0a4d4f24f508f9df37e4a155e394f6f062951732.architecture: Ensemble of two nonlinear regression models: multitask feature selection over many predictors, and a weighted local linear regression with multitask nearest-neighbor features.
0a4d4f24f508f9df37e4a155e394f6f062951732.data: SubseasonalRodeo dataset of meteorological measurements and dynamical forecasts (including CFSv2), 2011-2018 evaluation.
0a4d4f24f508f9df37e4a155e394f6f062951732.result: Each model beats debiased CFSv2; the ensemble exceeds the top Rodeo competitor; combining with debiased CFSv2 improves its skill by 40-50% for temperature and 129-169% for precipitation.
0a4d4f24f508f9df37e4a155e394f6f062951732.open_work: Extending to other regions and leads, and using richer dynamical model ensembles.
0a4d4f24f508f9df37e4a155e394f6f062951732.issues: Absolute subseasonal skill remains low; evaluation limited to western US; relative skill gains can look large from low baselines.

9a43842478bf9d1aff71e964f584af4eeb196073.goal: Learns accurate coarse-grid discretizations of PDEs so that solutions remain accurate at much lower resolution.
9a43842478bf9d1aff71e964f584af4eeb196073.architecture: Neural networks that estimate spatial derivative coefficients, trained end to end within the numerical solver.
9a43842478bf9d1aff71e964f584af4eeb196073.data: High-resolution solutions of 1D nonlinear PDEs (Burgers, Korteweg-de Vries, Kuramoto-Sivashinsky) coarse-grained for training.
9a43842478bf9d1aff71e964f584af4eeb196073.result: Learned discretizations allow time integration at 4x to 8x coarser resolution than standard finite-difference methods.
9a43842478bf9d1aff71e964f584af4eeb196073.open_work: Extending to 2D/3D problems and atmospheric or oceanic flows.
9a43842478bf9d1aff71e964f584af4eeb196073.issues: Only 1D model equations; generalization to new regimes and higher dimensions not shown.

55a9a5c1a0b47d7e00c3291c31afef84135b4d9f.goal: Uses machine learning to predict climate model outputs across an ensemble spanning model resolutions, to reduce the cost of exploring resolution and parameters.
55a9a5c1a0b47d7e00c3291c31afef84135b4d9f.architecture: Machine learning regression models trained on ensemble members (specific method not confirmed).
55a9a5c1a0b47d7e00c3291c31afef84135b4d9f.data: A multiresolution climate model ensemble (likely perturbed-parameter runs at several resolutions); details not reported here.
55a9a5c1a0b47d7e00c3291c31afef84135b4d9f.result: Machine learning can predict ensemble outputs, suggesting cheaper exploration of high-resolution behaviour. Specifics not available.
55a9a5c1a0b47d7e00c3291c31afef84135b4d9f.open_work: Using such emulators for calibration and uncertainty quantification at high resolution.
55a9a5c1a0b47d7e00c3291c31afef84135b4d9f.issues: Abstract unavailable; details of model, variables and accuracy are not confirmed.

65b6c541ac4f1b57382fb4f95fe3cf4ccc8752be.goal: Predicts large spatiotemporally chaotic systems from data alone, without a physical model.
65b6c541ac4f1b57382fb4f95fe3cf4ccc8752be.architecture: Parallel reservoir computing: many local reservoirs, each predicting a spatial patch with overlapping neighbor inputs.
65b6c541ac4f1b57382fb4f95fe3cf4ccc8752be.data: Simulated data from the Kuramoto-Sivashinsky equation on large domains.
65b6c541ac4f1b57382fb4f95fe3cf4ccc8752be.result: The parallel scheme predicts the state for several Lyapunov times and reproduces long-term statistics, scaling to large systems.
65b6c541ac4f1b57382fb4f95fe3cf4ccc8752be.open_work: Application to weather and other real, partially observed spatiotemporal systems.
65b6c541ac4f1b57382fb4f95fe3cf4ccc8752be.issues: Idealized 1D system with full noise-free observations. Abstract unavailable.

2f86f718bffd472adb44587df2ac91b45c730b0c.goal: Produces probabilistic forecasts of locally extreme precipitation, which raw ensemble forecasts handle poorly.
2f86f718bffd472adb44587df2ac91b45c730b0c.architecture: Random forests trained on ensemble forecast predictors, per region, giving probabilities of exceeding return-period thresholds.
2f86f718bffd472adb44587df2ac91b45c730b0c.data: GEFS reforecast data as predictors, with observed extreme precipitation (relative to return-period thresholds) over the contiguous US as targets.
2f86f718bffd472adb44587df2ac91b45c730b0c.result: Random forest forecasts are skillful and reliable, outperforming raw ensemble guidance and competitive with or better than operational human forecasts at short leads.
2f86f718bffd472adb44587df2ac91b45c730b0c.open_work: Using convection-allowing model inputs and extending to longer leads and sub-daily accumulations.
2f86f718bffd472adb44587df2ac91b45c730b0c.issues: Rare-event sample size limits training; regional dependence; tied to one ensemble system. Abstract unavailable.

c62c44af1e5c8e552a377c82db228741d0c62149.goal: Statistical postprocessing of ensemble forecasts to correct systematic errors and produce calibrated probabilistic forecasts, replacing distributional regression with prespecified link functions.
c62c44af1e5c8e552a377c82db228741d0c62149.architecture: Fully connected neural network that outputs parameters of a Gaussian predictive distribution, trained by minimizing CRPS, with station embeddings and auxiliary predictors.
c62c44af1e5c8e552a377c82db228741d0c62149.data: ECMWF ensemble 2-m temperature forecasts (48-h lead) at about 500 German surface stations, with training on 2007-2015 data and testing on 2016.
c62c44af1e5c8e552a377c82db228741d0c62149.result: The NN with auxiliary predictors and station embeddings significantly outperforms EMOS and other benchmarks (about 9% CRPS improvement over local EMOS) at lower computational cost; feature importance gives physical insight.
c62c44af1e5c8e552a377c82db228741d0c62149.open_work: Extension to other variables (e.g. precipitation, wind), non-Gaussian or distribution-free outputs, multivariate/spatial dependence, and longer training archives.
c62c44af1e5c8e552a377c82db228741d0c62149.issues: Assumes a Gaussian predictive distribution suited to temperature; single variable and lead time; univariate postprocessing ignores spatial and inter-variable correlations.

f7a062bc0c39672c327df0042866dc328e700d2b.goal: Predict the uncertainty (expected skill) of medium-range forecasts from the initial atmospheric state without running a costly ensemble.
f7a062bc0c39672c327df0042866dc328e700d2b.architecture: Convolutional neural network trained on past forecasts that maps the initial large-scale state to a scalar confidence measure relative to the seasonal norm.
f7a062bc0c39672c327df0042866dc328e700d2b.data: Past ECMWF ensemble forecasts and analyses (reforecast-type archive) used to define forecast error/spread targets; specifics beyond this are not in the abstract.
f7a062bc0c39672c327df0042866dc328e700d2b.result: The CNN is less skillful than an ensemble at predicting uncertainty but is very cheap and beats several alternatives that do not require numerical forecasts.
f7a062bc0c39672c327df0042866dc328e700d2b.open_work: Larger training archives (e.g. long reforecast sets) and extension to spatially resolved or variable-specific uncertainty.
f7a062bc0c39672c327df0042866dc328e700d2b.issues: Performance is limited by the small number of past forecasts available; outputs only a scalar confidence, not a full spatial uncertainty field.

fe19b2d910a17e12da23f9c72d19ac32592a22ca.goal: Argue that subseasonal-to-seasonal (S2S) prediction should incorporate modern statistical and machine learning methods alongside dynamical models.
fe19b2d910a17e12da23f9c72d19ac32592a22ca.architecture: Opinion article with an illustrative unsupervised-learning seasonal forecast example and a summary of ML methods applicable to climate prediction; not a new model.
fe19b2d910a17e12da23f9c72d19ac32592a22ca.data: Seasonal forecast examples and real-time dynamical forecasts versus observations for winter 2017/2018, including a mid-winter polar vortex disruption.
fe19b2d910a17e12da23f9c72d19ac32592a22ca.result: An unsupervised learning example beats dynamical systems in a seasonal case, and statistical forecasts better predicted surface impacts of the 2018 polar vortex disruption than dynamical models, which were largely insensitive to vortex variability.
fe19b2d910a17e12da23f9c72d19ac32592a22ca.open_work: Develop hybrid dynamical-statistical S2S systems and test ML methods systematically on long hindcasts.
fe19b2d910a17e12da23f9c72d19ac32592a22ca.issues: Evidence is anecdotal (single season, selected examples) rather than a systematic verification; opinion piece.

c9519577759d35b078309c3e0b3bd85f3a10018d.goal: Statistical downscaling of precipitation from coarse climate predictors to local scale, as suggested by the title.
c9519577759d35b078309c3e0b3bd85f3a10018d.architecture: Long short-term memory (LSTM) recurrent neural network for precipitation downscaling; architectural details not available.
c9519577759d35b078309c3e0b3bd85f3a10018d.data: Not reported (abstract unavailable); likely reanalysis or GCM predictors with observed precipitation for an Indian region, but this is not confirmed.
c9519577759d35b078309c3e0b3bd85f3a10018d.open_work: Comparison with other downscaling approaches and application to climate projections would follow naturally.
c9519577759d35b078309c3e0b3bd85f3a10018d.issues: Details cannot be verified without the abstract; typical downscaling caveats (stationarity assumption, extremes underestimation) likely apply.

0c0b4d93456bddfe1b22f557b6e0d457b4167b4d.goal: Compare machine learning techniques for downscaling reanalysis data to monthly station precipitation across climate regimes.
0c0b4d93456bddfe1b22f557b6e0d457b4167b4d.architecture: Four ML methods compared: genetic programming, artificial neural networks, support vector machines and relevance vector machines, built per station and calendar month.
0c0b4d93456bddfe1b22f557b6e0d457b4167b4d.data: Reanalysis predictors and monthly precipitation at 48 stations in Victoria, Australia (wet, intermediate, dry regimes); calibration 1950-1991, validation 1992-2014.
0c0b4d93456bddfe1b22f557b6e0d457b4167b4d.result: All methods capture the mean better than variability, underestimate the standard deviation and maxima, overestimate low-to-mid percentiles and underestimate high percentiles; RVM/ANN recommended for floods, RVM for droughts, polynomial kernels best for SVM/RVM.
0c0b4d93456bddfe1b22f557b6e0d457b4167b4d.open_work: Bias correction of extremes and application to GCM projections for future precipitation.
0c0b4d93456bddfe1b22f557b6e0d457b4167b4d.issues: Monthly resolution only; systematic underestimation of extremes; stationarity of predictor-precipitation relationships under climate change is untested.

7310355d4a5041930db8f6ba210ddaf5deb44e81.goal: Learn a data-driven subgrid closure for two-dimensional (Kraichnan) turbulence without heuristic assumptions.
7310355d4a5041930db8f6ba210ddaf5deb44e81.architecture: Artificial neural network mapping local stencils of vorticity and streamfunction plus two eddy-viscosity kernel inputs to the subgrid vorticity source term.
7310355d4a5041930db8f6ba210ddaf5deb44e81.data: Snapshots of high-fidelity direct numerical simulation of 2D decaying turbulence, coarse-grained to give subgrid targets.
7310355d4a5041930db8f6ba210ddaf5deb44e81.result: A priori PDF-based validation and a posteriori decaying turbulence runs show kinetic energy spectra consistent with the reference; a posteriori error must be included in model selection.
7310355d4a5041930db8f6ba210ddaf5deb44e81.open_work: Extension to 3D and geophysical flows, other Reynolds numbers, and more systematic a posteriori-aware training.
7310355d4a5041930db8f6ba210ddaf5deb44e81.issues: Idealized 2D setting; a priori skill does not guarantee a posteriori accuracy; generalization beyond training regime not established.

9d15c8680a03f27264648f3865f589cd2a45a546.goal: Test whether a deep neural network can emulate the full dynamics of a simple general circulation model for both weather-like forecasts and climate runs.
9d15c8680a03f27264648f3865f589cd2a45a546.architecture: Convolutional encoder-decoder style neural network predicting the full model state ahead, iterated autoregressively for long runs.
9d15c8680a03f27264648f3865f589cd2a45a546.data: Long simulation output from a simplified GCM (PUMA, dry dynamics without seasonal cycle) used for training and testing.
9d15c8680a03f27264648f3865f589cd2a45a546.result: The network predicts the model state several time steps ahead and, iterated from arbitrary states, produces a stable climate run with similar statistics and no long-term drift, without built-in conservation.
9d15c8680a03f27264648f3865f589cd2a45a546.open_work: Move to more complex models (moisture, seasonal cycle) and eventually real atmospheric data; study of the sources of stability.
9d15c8680a03f27264648f3865f589cd2a45a546.issues: Simple, idealized model world with no seasonal cycle; forecast skill degrades quickly; results may not transfer to realistic atmospheres.

8b2046ca20e066db1daa56e8e0b1031442137658.goal: Estimate tropical cyclone intensity directly from satellite imagery as an objective alternative to the subjective Dvorak technique.
8b2046ca20e066db1daa56e8e0b1031442137658.architecture: Deep convolutional neural network regressing (or classifying) intensity from infrared satellite images of tropical cyclones.
8b2046ca20e066db1daa56e8e0b1031442137658.data: Geostationary infrared hurricane images matched with best-track intensities (Atlantic and Pacific basins); exact period not available here.
8b2046ca20e066db1daa56e8e0b1031442137658.result: Reported RMSE of roughly 10 kt relative to best-track intensity, competitive with existing objective techniques; numbers should be checked against the paper.
8b2046ca20e066db1daa56e8e0b1031442137658.open_work: Adding temporal information, multiple channels and other basins; operational testing.
8b2046ca20e066db1daa56e8e0b1031442137658.issues: Abstract unavailable; best-track labels are themselves uncertain (partly Dvorak-based); relatively small sample of intense storms.

3bb4485fb618e1accd4bef6d259ebd27d97764e4.goal: Test how ML convection parameterizations behave when coupled to a GCM and whether they can simulate climate change and extremes.
3bb4485fb618e1accd4bef6d259ebd27d97764e4.architecture: Random forest (ensemble of decision trees) trained to emulate a conventional moist convection scheme; predicting averages of training samples guarantees energy conservation and nonnegative precipitation.
3bb4485fb618e1accd4bef6d259ebd27d97764e4.data: Output from an idealized aquaplanet GCM with a conventional convection scheme, in control and warm climates.
3bb4485fb618e1accd4bef6d259ebd27d97764e4.result: Coupled GCM runs stably and reproduces climate statistics including precipitation extremes; climate change is captured if training includes both climates or only the warm climate, but not with control-only training.
3bb4485fb618e1accd4bef6d259ebd27d97764e4.open_work: Training on high-resolution or cloud-resolving data rather than a conventional scheme; realistic GCM configurations.
3bb4485fb618e1accd4bef6d259ebd27d97764e4.issues: Idealized setting emulating an existing scheme; poor extrapolation to unseen climates; random forests are memory-intensive.

6f3f1c92b0361a399064a87a4f6292a56a621cfa.goal: Improve short-term tropical cyclone intensity forecasts, including rapid intensification, by postprocessing HWRF output.
6f3f1c92b0361a399064a87a4f6292a56a621cfa.architecture: Feed-forward neural network using the operational current intensity estimate and HWRF-derived predictors, constrained to 6-h-old model data.
6f3f1c92b0361a399064a87a4f6292a56a621cfa.data: 2014-2016 HWRF reforecasts for Atlantic and eastern Pacific storms for training and cross-validation; real-time 2017 data for out-of-sample testing; best track for verification.
6f3f1c92b0361a399064a87a4f6292a56a621cfa.result: Cross-validation shows lower MAE than HWFI at 3-57 h, but in 2017 HWFI was better at leads up to 24 h and similar later; the FFNN produced 4 times as many RI hits and higher Atlantic Brier skill than HWFI and SHIPS-RII.
6f3f1c92b0361a399064a87a4f6292a56a621cfa.open_work: Retraining for newer HWRF versions, longer training sets and probabilistic intensity outputs.
6f3f1c92b0361a399064a87a4f6292a56a621cfa.issues: Short training period tied to a specific HWRF version; more RI false alarms; cross-validation gains did not fully hold in real-time testing.

6ec8d2aca4785b47b6f6f285e6aeec66dac5a4c1.goal: Detect clouds in optical satellite imagery using spatial context, reducing misclassification over bright surfaces such as snow and ice.
6ec8d2aca4785b47b6f6f285e6aeec66dac5a4c1.architecture: RS-Net, a U-Net based convolutional segmentation network; also trained with noisy Fmask labels.
6ec8d2aca4785b47b6f6f285e6aeec66dac5a4c1.data: Landsat 8 Biome and SPARCS cloud-mask datasets, plus Fmask-generated annotations.
6ec8d2aca4785b47b6f6f285e6aeec66dac5a4c1.result: State-of-the-art performance especially over snow/ice; RGB-only models perform well; training on Fmask labels yields better masks than Fmask itself; classifying a full Landsat 8 scene takes about 18 s.
6ec8d2aca4785b47b6f6f285e6aeec66dac5a4c1.open_work: Application to small satellites with limited bands and to other sensors.
6ec8d2aca4785b47b6f6f285e6aeec66dac5a4c1.issues: Evaluated on limited labeled datasets; cloud shadow and thin cloud handling not detailed in the abstract.

9a76c750b4bc9692adfc0e5acf4b9470318334a3.goal: Predict short- and mid-term daily SST fields while capturing spatial and temporal correlations.
9a76c750b4bc9692adfc0e5acf4b9470318334a3.architecture: ConvLSTM-based spatiotemporal deep learning model trained end-to-end.
9a76c750b4bc9692adfc0e5acf4b9470318334a3.data: 36 years of daily satellite-derived SST over a subarea of the East China Sea.
9a76c750b4bc9692adfc0e5acf4b9470318334a3.result: Outperforms persistence, linear SVR and two LSTM baselines on multiple statistics.
9a76c750b4bc9692adfc0e5acf4b9470318334a3.open_work: Larger domains, more predictors (e.g. atmospheric forcing) and longer lead times.
9a76c750b4bc9692adfc0e5acf4b9470318334a3.issues: Small regional domain; baselines are relatively weak and no comparison with dynamical ocean forecasts; data-only model lacks physical constraints.

ea8c89c824a9654fcbf69ddc098be309e7691732.goal: Produce high-resolution daily PM2.5 estimates across the contiguous US for health and epidemiology studies.
ea8c89c824a9654fcbf69ddc098be309e7691732.architecture: Ensemble of neural network, random forest and gradient boosting combined by a geographically weighted generalized additive model; separate model for uncertainty.
ea8c89c824a9654fcbf69ddc098be309e7691732.data: Satellite AOD, meteorology, land use, elevation, chemical transport model output, reanalyses and monitor PM2.5, 2000-2015.
ea8c89c824a9654fcbf69ddc098be309e7691732.result: 10-fold cross-validated R2 of 0.86 for daily and 0.89 for annual PM2.5 at 1 km; good performance up to 60 ug/m3; downscaled to 100 m with uncertainty estimates.
ea8c89c824a9654fcbf69ddc098be309e7691732.open_work: Explore other ensemble formats to merge estimates from different models or groups.
ea8c89c824a9654fcbf69ddc098be309e7691732.issues: Weaker performance at very high concentrations; cross-validation may overstate skill in monitor-sparse areas; 100 m downscaling relies only on land use.

0bdd9c714582904c2dd31c2175f221a6a36ba5d0.goal: Test whether CNNs trained only on historical data can forecast gridded 500-hPa geopotential height without physics.
0bdd9c714582904c2dd31c2175f221a6a36ba5d0.architecture: Deep convolutional neural networks (including convolutional LSTM variants) forecasting one or two fields iteratively in time steps.
0bdd9c714582904c2dd31c2175f221a6a36ba5d0.data: Climate Forecast System Reanalysis (CFSR) Northern Hemisphere grids (about 2.5 deg), with training on earlier decades and testing on later years.
0bdd9c714582904c2dd31c2175f221a6a36ba5d0.result: Up to 3 days CNNs beat persistence, climatology and barotropic vorticity models but not an operational full-physics model (GFS); adding 700-300 hPa thickness helps; realistic states up to 14 days.
0bdd9c714582904c2dd31c2175f221a6a36ba5d0.open_work: More variables and levels, global grids, and use of CNN efficiency for large ensembles.
0bdd9c714582904c2dd31c2175f221a6a36ba5d0.issues: Coarse resolution and very few variables; well behind operational NWP; trained on reanalysis.

57d599ecf2ef6cbdc0ee2f58c5e786f854e9ab5c.goal: Explore mesoscale organization of trade-wind shallow cumulus at scale by combining human labeling and deep learning.
57d599ecf2ef6cbdc0ee2f58c5e786f854e9ab5c.architecture: Crowdsourced labeling of four patterns (Sugar, Flower, Fish, Gravel), then deep learning object detection/segmentation models to automate detection.
57d599ecf2ef6cbdc0ee2f58c5e786f854e9ab5c.data: About 10,000 MODIS visible satellite images over trade-wind regions labeled by 67 scientists into almost 50,000 cloud clusters.
57d599ecf2ef6cbdc0ee2f58c5e786f854e9ab5c.result: Deep learning reproduces human labeling well enough to build global climatologies; the patterns partly overlap with open/closed cells but differ in important ways and relate to distinct large-scale environments.
57d599ecf2ef6cbdc0ee2f58c5e786f854e9ab5c.open_work: Studying the physical drivers and radiative effects of the patterns and their representation in models; dataset released for further work.
57d599ecf2ef6cbdc0ee2f58c5e786f854e9ab5c.issues: Subjective pattern definitions with notable inter-labeler disagreement; labels limited to selected regions.

9f8cbe9f8856752b65a8dd399265d714ce5acb3c.goal: Objectively identify synoptic-scale warm and cold fronts in gridded data.
9f8cbe9f8856752b65a8dd399265d714ce5acb3c.architecture: Convolutional neural network producing front probability grids followed by a novel postprocessing that converts probabilities to front objects.
9f8cbe9f8856752b65a8dd399265d714ce5acb3c.data: 1000-mb wind, temperature, humidity, wet-bulb potential temperature and geopotential height from the North American Regional Reanalysis; labels from WPC human-drawn fronts.
9f8cbe9f8856752b65a8dd399265d714ce5acb3c.result: At a 250-km matching distance, POD 0.73, success ratio 0.65 and CSI 0.52, far exceeding a traditional numerical frontal analysis baseline.
9f8cbe9f8856752b65a8dd399265d714ce5acb3c.open_work: Front climatologies and quantifying frontal spread across NWP ensemble members.
9f8cbe9f8856752b65a8dd399265d714ce5acb3c.issues: Human-analyzed labels are subjective and inconsistent; single pressure level; regional (North America) domain.

5027a03ff0330ae12db99c30db9e1fe907af6faf.goal: Extend skillful ENSO forecasts beyond about one year lead, where dynamical models lose skill.
5027a03ff0330ae12db99c30db9e1fe907af6faf.architecture: Convolutional neural network predicting the Nino3.4 index and ENSO type from SST and heat content anomalies, using transfer learning; heatmaps used for interpretation.
5027a03ff0330ae12db99c30db9e1fe907af6faf.data: Trained on CMIP5 historical simulations then fine-tuned on reanalysis (1871-1973, e.g. SODA); validated on 1984-2017 observations.
5027a03ff0330ae12db99c30db9e1fe907af6faf.result: All-season correlation skill for Nino3.4 remains above 0.5 up to about 17 months lead, exceeding state-of-the-art dynamical forecast systems, and the CNN better predicts the zonal pattern (EP vs CP) of El Nino.
5027a03ff0330ae12db99c30db9e1fe907af6faf.open_work: Improving spring predictability barrier performance, probabilistic forecasts, and understanding the precursors identified by the CNN.
5027a03ff0330ae12db99c30db9e1fe907af6faf.issues: Short observational validation record with few ENSO events; potential leakage between training and validation through decadal variability; deterministic outputs only.

ed53d03140c59c18dedd27bb2740467a02988b71.goal: Make neural network emulators of physical systems respect analytic constraints such as conservation laws.
ed53d03140c59c18dedd27bb2740467a02988b71.architecture: Constraints enforced either via the loss function (soft penalty) or via architecture with constraint layers that compute residual outputs to satisfy conservation exactly.
ed53d03140c59c18dedd27bb2740467a02988b71.data: Convective parameterization emulation trained on output from an aquaplanet climate model with superparameterization (SPCAM).
ed53d03140c59c18dedd27bb2740467a02988b71.result: Architectural constraints enforce mass and energy conservation to within machine precision without degrading performance and reduce errors in outputs most affected by the constraints.
ed53d03140c59c18dedd27bb2740467a02988b71.open_work: Extending to other constraints, testing online coupled stability, and generalization to different climates.
ed53d03140c59c18dedd27bb2740467a02988b71.issues: Only applies to constraints that can be written analytically; offline evaluation; does not guarantee stability or generalization.

201a40c301612d2af97b0f0bff6b95f981b9af9d.goal: Develop flexible, distribution-free probabilistic postprocessing of ensemble forecasts.
201a40c301612d2af97b0f0bff6b95f981b9af9d.architecture: Neural network mapping ensemble predictors to coefficients of Bernstein polynomial quantile functions, trained with quantile loss and modern optimizers.
201a40c301612d2af97b0f0bff6b95f981b9af9d.data: About 2 years of ensemble wind speed forecasts at 125 Norwegian stations, lead time +60 h.
201a40c301612d2af97b0f0bff6b95f981b9af9d.result: Improvement of nearly 1% in quantile skill score compared with two quantile regression methods; main appeal is versatility.
201a40c301612d2af97b0f0bff6b95f981b9af9d.open_work: Application to other variables and lead times and to longer training data.
201a40c301612d2af97b0f0bff6b95f981b9af9d.issues: Modest gains; short training period and single lead time; univariate, station-wise postprocessing.

0a72a2f0e3a803043edee36a48f71786b4b378b9.goal: Improve daily precipitation estimation via statistical downscaling from dynamically resolved variables as an alternative to precipitation parameterizations.
0a72a2f0e3a803043edee36a48f71786b4b378b9.architecture: Convolutional neural network learning precipitation-related features from surrounding resolved fields; architectures compared and interpreted.
0a72a2f0e3a803043edee36a48f71786b4b378b9.data: Reanalysis dynamical fields as predictors and observed daily precipitation at 14 grid points across the contiguous US.
0a72a2f0e3a803043edee36a48f71786b4b378b9.result: With enough data, CNN beats reanalysis precipitation and downscaling by linear regression, nearest neighbor, random forest and fully connected networks.
0a72a2f0e3a803043edee36a48f71786b4b378b9.open_work: Using insights to improve precipitation parameterizations and integrating into NWP models.
0a72a2f0e3a803043edee36a48f71786b4b378b9.issues: Only 14 locations; performance depends on data quantity; point-wise models rather than a spatially coherent field.

7b983cfa013c532e8316e894ecb78d3cf3aa48b1.goal: Promote and organize data-driven causal inference beyond correlation analysis for Earth system science.
7b983cfa013c532e8316e894ecb78d3cf3aa48b1.architecture: Perspective reviewing causal inference frameworks (Granger causality, nonlinear state-space methods, causal network learning such as PCMCI, etc.) and launching the causeme.net benchmark platform.
7b983cfa013c532e8316e894ecb78d3cf3aa48b1.data: Illustrative Earth system examples and synthetic benchmark datasets on causeme.net.
7b983cfa013c532e8316e894ecb78d3cf3aa48b1.result: Identifies generic application cases and methodological challenges (e.g. nonlinearity, time delays, unobserved confounders, nonstationarity) and initiates a community benchmark.
7b983cfa013c532e8316e894ecb78d3cf3aa48b1.open_work: Methods robust to the identified challenges and broader benchmarking on realistic data.
7b983cfa013c532e8316e894ecb78d3cf3aa48b1.issues: Perspective, not a single method evaluation; causal conclusions depend on assumptions that are often hard to verify in observational data.

beca0d55255eb2b8f2434e9491d703831d9f52af.goal: Predict severe hail probability from storm-scale model fields and interpret what the deep learning model learns.
beca0d55255eb2b8f2434e9491d703831d9f52af.architecture: Convolutional neural network compared with logistic regression on spatial-mean or PCA inputs; interpretation via feature importance and feature optimization.
beca0d55255eb2b8f2434e9491d703831d9f52af.data: Storm-centered patches from NCAR convection-allowing ensemble runs, 3 May-3 June 2016; target is Thompson hail size diagnostic exceeding 25 mm in the next hour.
beca0d55255eb2b8f2434e9491d703831d9f52af.result: CNN significantly outperforms all baselines in Brier skill score and ROC AUC; interpretation reveals physically consistent features (steep lapse rates, shear favoring wide updrafts) and storm modes.
beca0d55255eb2b8f2434e9491d703831d9f52af.open_work: Verification against observed hail and longer, multi-season datasets.
beca0d55255eb2b8f2434e9491d703831d9f52af.issues: Target is a model diagnostic, not observed hail; one month of data; results tied to one model configuration.

88c75d92fea9c839bd1eda2bd6da9b45d602b035.goal: Discuss how modern AI/ML can transform satellite remote sensing and NWP and what challenges remain.
88c75d92fea9c839bd1eda2bd6da9b45d602b035.architecture: Review and perspective covering ML for quality control, retrievals, data fusion, forward/inverse problems, data assimilation and prediction.
88c75d92fea9c839bd1eda2bd6da9b45d602b035.data: Examples from NOAA satellite remote sensing and NWP applications.
88c75d92fea9c839bd1eda2bd6da9b45d602b035.result: Argues ML can accelerate data exploitation and prediction by complementing existing systems and, where appropriate, replacing NWP chain components.
88c75d92fea9c839bd1eda2bd6da9b45d602b035.open_work: Operational integration, handling new data streams (SmallSats, IoT), and validation of ML components.
88c75d92fea9c839bd1eda2bd6da9b45d602b035.issues: Perspective with illustrative examples rather than systematic evaluation.

8a86102560106a3c64cb9062fd877539811f33c0.goal: High-resolution (1 km), short-term (1 h) precipitation nowcasting from radar.
8a86102560106a3c64cb9062fd877539811f33c0.architecture: U-Net convolutional neural network treating nowcasting as image-to-image translation.
8a86102560106a3c64cb9062fd877539811f33c0.data: NEXRAD radar (MRMS) precipitation imagery over the continental US.
8a86102560106a3c64cb9062fd877539811f33c0.result: Performs favorably versus optical flow, persistence and the HRRR one-hour forecast, measured with precision/recall at several thresholds.
8a86102560106a3c64cb9062fd877539811f33c0.open_work: Longer lead times, additional inputs (satellite, NWP), and probabilistic outputs.
8a86102560106a3c64cb9062fd877539811f33c0.issues: Very short lead time; deterministic predictions tend to blur; evaluation over a limited period.

3dd56c89e166dd7018ecfa24bfe25c4ee4f4c0c1.goal: Build stochastic, data-driven subgrid parameterizations that represent uncertainty in unresolved processes.
3dd56c89e166dd7018ecfa24bfe25c4ee4f4c0c1.architecture: Conditional generative adversarial network producing stochastic subgrid forcing, with different input noise configurations.
3dd56c89e166dd7018ecfa24bfe25c4ee4f4c0c1.data: Output of the two-scale Lorenz '96 model.
3dd56c89e166dd7018ecfa24bfe25c4ee4f4c0c1.result: Some GAN configurations outperform a bespoke polynomial stochastic baseline at weather and climate time scales, reproducing spatiotemporal correlations and regimes; good forecast skill correlates with good climate.
3dd56c89e166dd7018ecfa24bfe25c4ee4f4c0c1.open_work: Scaling to more realistic models and higher-dimensional subgrid processes.
3dd56c89e166dd7018ecfa24bfe25c4ee4f4c0c1.issues: Toy model; GAN training is unstable and sensitive to configuration; not all configurations beat the baseline.

1c8991facd0db78aefefab9762c2114f141ceba4.goal: Argue for broader use of ML and AI to understand the climate system and support adaptation.
1c8991facd0db78aefefab9762c2114f141ceba4.architecture: Perspective covering ML for teleconnection discovery, analysis of Earth system model output and enhanced warnings of extreme events.
1c8991facd0db78aefefab9762c2114f141ceba4.data: No new data; refers to observations and ESM simulations.
1c8991facd0db78aefefab9762c2114f141ceba4.result: Recommends a parallel emphasis on ML/AI to exploit existing data and simulations alongside ESM development.
1c8991facd0db78aefefab9762c2114f141ceba4.open_work: Concrete demonstrations of ML-discovered teleconnections and AI-based early warning systems.

a9cbbef8f4426329d0687025b34287c35bdd8b38.goal: Review the interface between machine learning and the physical sciences.
a9cbbef8f4426329d0687025b34287c35bdd8b38.architecture: Broad review covering ML basics, statistical physics of learning, and applications in particle physics, cosmology, quantum many-body physics, quantum computing, chemistry and materials, plus ML hardware.
a9cbbef8f4426329d0687025b34287c35bdd8b38.result: Summarizes successes, domain-specific methodology and challenges across physics fields.
a9cbbef8f4426329d0687025b34287c35bdd8b38.open_work: Cross-fertilization between fields and new computing architectures for ML.
a9cbbef8f4426329d0687025b34287c35bdd8b38.issues: Does not cover atmospheric or ocean sciences specifically; relevant mainly as general background.

0fb08674557a325d3e3081e5bada27a16962d0cb.goal: Make ML models in meteorology interpretable so forecasters and scientists can trust and learn from them.
0fb08674557a325d3e3081e5bada27a16962d0cb.architecture: Synthesis of model interpretation and visualization methods: permutation importance, forward/backward selection, saliency maps, class-activation maps, backward optimization and novelty detection.
0fb08674557a325d3e3081e5bada27a16962d0cb.data: Applied to tornado, hail, winter precipitation type and convective storm mode prediction datasets at several scales.
0fb08674557a325d3e3081e5bada27a16962d0cb.result: Demonstrates that these techniques reveal physically meaningful relationships learned by traditional ML and deep learning models; serves as a toolbox.
0fb08674557a325d3e3081e5bada27a16962d0cb.open_work: Quantitative evaluation of interpretation methods and their reliability.
0fb08674557a325d3e3081e5bada27a16962d0cb.issues: Interpretation methods can disagree and be misleading with correlated predictors; mostly qualitative demonstrations.

4a184a793b06c847afe74aca062e2c996d2dfe0b.goal: Nowcast lightning occurrence from single-site, commonly available surface observations.
4a184a793b06c847afe74aca062e2c996d2dfe0b.architecture: Machine learning classifier (boosted decision trees in the paper) using four surface variables: station pressure, air temperature, relative humidity and wind speed.
4a184a793b06c847afe74aca062e2c996d2dfe0b.data: Surface weather station data with lightning location system observations for validation, from stations in Switzerland and elsewhere.
4a184a793b06c847afe74aca062e2c996d2dfe0b.result: Statistically significant skill up to 30 min lead; outperforms persistence, electrostatic field threshold and CAPE-threshold baselines; feature importance is physically consistent.
4a184a793b06c847afe74aca062e2c996d2dfe0b.open_work: Further data mining of lightning dependencies and application to other regions and longer leads.
4a184a793b06c847afe74aca062e2c996d2dfe0b.issues: Short lead time; site-specific; limited predictors cannot represent storm dynamics aloft.

ae56e5922d6719bfdb712f9349899f61bc088755.goal: Improve satellite-based precipitation rate estimation using deep learning on geostationary imagery.
ae56e5922d6719bfdb712f9349899f61bc088755.architecture: Convolutional neural network (encoder-decoder) using infrared and water vapor channels from GOES.
ae56e5922d6719bfdb712f9349899f61bc088755.data: Summers 2012 and 2013 over central CONUS at 0.08 deg and hourly scale; NCEP Stage IV gauge-radar as reference.
ae56e5922d6719bfdb712f9349899f61bc088755.result: PERSIANN-CNN beats PERSIANN-CCS and PERSIANN-SDAE by 54% and 23% in CSI and reduces RMSE by 37% and 14%.
ae56e5922d6719bfdb712f9349899f61bc088755.open_work: Extension to other seasons, regions and additional channels; operational implementation.
ae56e5922d6719bfdb712f9349899f61bc088755.issues: Evaluated only for warm-season central CONUS; IR/WV channels sense cloud tops, limiting skill for some rain types.

5d79c430c7c5f727823b5bed8093f62d96b7eeb2.goal: Use neural network interpretation as a primary scientific tool to discover meaningful relationships in geoscience data.
5d79c430c7c5f727823b5bed8093f62d96b7eeb2.architecture: Neural networks interpreted with backward optimization and layerwise relevance propagation (LRP), projecting decisions back to input space.
5d79c430c7c5f727823b5bed8093f62d96b7eeb2.data: Climate fields such as SST anomalies for ENSO and other modes of variability (observational and model data).
5d79c430c7c5f727823b5bed8093f62d96b7eeb2.result: The interpretation methods reliably recover physically known climate patterns, suggesting they can support discovery.
5d79c430c7c5f727823b5bed8093f62d96b7eeb2.open_work: Combining interpretable networks with new scientific hypotheses.
5d79c430c7c5f727823b5bed8093f62d96b7eeb2.issues: Demonstrations on known patterns; relevance maps depend on method choice and need careful validation.

d86084808994ac54ef4840ae65295f3c0ec4decd.goal: Solve forward and inverse problems for nonlinear PDEs using neural networks that respect physical laws.
d86084808994ac54ef4840ae65295f3c0ec4decd.architecture: Physics-informed neural networks (PINNs): networks trained with PDE residuals via automatic differentiation in continuous-time and discrete-time (implicit Runge-Kutta) forms.
d86084808994ac54ef4840ae65295f3c0ec4decd.data: Classical benchmark problems: Burgers, Schrodinger, Allen-Cahn, Navier-Stokes, Korteweg-de Vries and shallow-water waves.
d86084808994ac54ef4840ae65295f3c0ec4decd.result: Accurate data-efficient solutions and identification of PDE parameters from sparse data across the benchmarks.
d86084808994ac54ef4840ae65295f3c0ec4decd.open_work: Scaling to high-dimensional, multiscale and chaotic problems; training robustness.
d86084808994ac54ef4840ae65295f3c0ec4decd.issues: Training can be difficult for stiff or multiscale problems; computational cost versus classical solvers; geophysical applications not demonstrated here.

aab6a6c1cd95b3dc412f3cb4e45a1635faea3f12.goal: Make a neural network parameterization trained on coarse-grained cloud-resolving model output stable when coupled to a GCM.
aab6a6c1cd95b3dc412f3cb4e45a1635faea3f12.architecture: Neural network predicting residual heating and moistening in 160-km columns from coarse-resolution column state; linearized response analysis to diagnose instability.
aab6a6c1cd95b3dc412f3cb4e45a1635faea3f12.data: Near-global cloud-resolving simulation (SAM) with 4-km grid coarse-grained to 160 km.
aab6a6c1cd95b3dc412f3cb4e45a1635faea3f12.result: Coupled runs crash within days due to exploiting synchrony with upper-level (above 10 km) variables; removing these inputs stabilizes simulations, which beat a coarse run without parameterization though the mean state drifts.
aab6a6c1cd95b3dc412f3cb4e45a1635faea3f12.open_work: Remove drift, ensure long-term stability, and develop systematic stability diagnostics.
aab6a6c1cd95b3dc412f3cb4e45a1635faea3f12.issues: Slow mean-state drift; stability achieved by ad hoc input removal; near-global aquaplanet setting.

998039a4876edc440e0cabb0bc42239b0eb29644.goal: Map where machine learning can help mitigate greenhouse gas emissions and support adaptation to climate change, to steer ML researchers toward high-impact problems.
998039a4876edc440e0cabb0bc42239b0eb29644.architecture: Broad survey and position paper organized by application domain (electricity systems, transport, buildings, industry, land use, climate prediction, societal adaptation, etc.), flagging each idea by impact and maturity.
998039a4876edc440e0cabb0bc42239b0eb29644.data: No new data; reviews published work across domains and points to relevant datasets.
998039a4876edc440e0cabb0bc42239b0eb29644.result: Identifies many high-impact problems where ML can fill gaps, including a section on climate prediction (emulation, parameterization, extremes), and frames research and business opportunities.
998039a4876edc440e0cabb0bc42239b0eb29644.open_work: Calls for interdisciplinary collaboration with domain experts; specific open problems are listed per domain, e.g. data-driven parameterizations and downscaling for climate modeling.
998039a4876edc440e0cabb0bc42239b0eb29644.issues: Very broad scope, so atmospheric and ocean modeling receive limited depth; recommendations are qualitative and predate the 2022+ wave of ML weather models.

7a62be741c7da5c9fd0bcd3d4871914bd016a48b.goal: Objectively identify dynamically similar regions of the global ocean, to understand which dynamical balances dominate where.
7a62be741c7da5c9fd0bcd3d4871914bd016a48b.architecture: Unsupervised K-means clustering of the standardized terms of the barotropic vorticity equation.
7a62be741c7da5c9fd0bcd3d4871914bd016a48b.data: 20-year mean of the ECCO (Estimating the Circulation and Climate of the Ocean) state estimate at 1° resolution.
7a62be741c7da5c9fd0bcd3d4871914bd016a48b.result: Finds five robust regimes: Cluster 1 (43% of ocean) with stress torques balanced by bottom pressure and nonlinear torques; Cluster 2 (24.8%) beta vs bottom pressure torque; Cluster 3 (14.6%) quasi-Sverdrupian; Cluster 4 (6.9%) baroclinic; Cluster 5 mainly Southern Ocean.
7a62be741c7da5c9fd0bcd3d4871914bd016a48b.open_work: Extend the analysis beyond the barotropic vorticity framework where residual nonlinear regions appear, and examine time-varying regimes or higher-resolution products.
7a62be741c7da5c9fd0bcd3d4871914bd016a48b.issues: Uses a time mean at 1° resolution, so eddy-driven and transient dynamics are only partly represented; residual dominantly nonlinear regions (rough Southern Ocean topography, western boundaries) are poorly described; K-means requires choosing the number of clusters.

988dac58628869d3dc725c690f877704cd03add7.goal: Estimate tropical cyclone intensity objectively from satellite passive microwave imagery, which sees inner-core structure under clouds.
988dac58628869d3dc725c690f877704cd03add7.architecture: Convolutional neural network (DeepMicroNet) with probabilistic output, able to work from partial scans and tolerant of imprecise storm-center fixes.
988dac58628869d3dc725c690f877704cd03add7.data: Passive microwave images at 37 GHz and 85-92 GHz from multiple sensors, trained against global best-track intensities; evaluated on two independent years and against aircraft reconnaissance-aided best track.
988dac58628869d3dc725c690f877704cd03add7.result: RMSE of 14.3 kt against all independent best track, 10.6 kt against reconnaissance-aided best track, and 9.6 kt using only higher-resolution TMI and AMSR-E; the 85-92 GHz band contributes most.
988dac58628869d3dc725c690f877704cd03add7.open_work: Expand training data, use more advanced architectures, and better characterize performance for the strongest storms.
988dac58628869d3dc725c690f877704cd03add7.issues: Too few category-5 cases for conclusive results at high intensities; the model reproduces known best-track biases because it is trained on best track; microwave overpasses are infrequent.

b0388982f2d209eb069f095f0dae874fee86e028.goal: Nowcast precipitation growth and decay in the Lagrangian frame over the Swiss Alps, testing whether orography makes growth and decay more predictable.
b0388982f2d209eb069f095f0dae874fee86e028.architecture: Feed-forward artificial neural networks with predictors of location, mesoscale motion vectors, freezing level and time of day, plus persistence; prediction intervals from a combination of quantile decision trees and ANNs.
b0388982f2d209eb069f095f0dae874fee86e028.data: 10-year archive of composite weather radar images over Switzerland.
b0388982f2d209eb069f095f0dae874fee86e028.result: ANNs reproduce long-term growth and decay climatology; adding recent growth/decay and intensity cuts RMSE by 20-30% versus persistence in mountainous regions, depending on flow direction.
b0388982f2d209eb069f095f0dae874fee86e028.open_work: Integrate the growth/decay predictions and their uncertainty into operational extrapolation nowcasting systems and further address conditional bias.
b0388982f2d209eb069f095f0dae874fee86e028.issues: Intrinsic predictability of growth and decay is low, so real-time skill is modest; deterministic ML predictions suffer conditional bias; results are specific to the Alpine radar domain.

0cf89214d27004c815c50d88e0d462ff7dfd7f67.goal: Extract forced climate change signals from internal variability and model uncertainty without explicit signal-noise separation.
0cf89214d27004c815c50d88e0d462ff7dfd7f67.architecture: Shallow artificial neural network trained to predict the year of a temperature or precipitation map, interpreted with layerwise relevance propagation to obtain indicator patterns.
0cf89214d27004c815c50d88e0d462ff7dfd7f67.data: Large multimodel climate simulations (CMIP-class) under historical and future scenarios, applied to observed surface temperature maps.
0cf89214d27004c815c50d88e0d462ff7dfd7f67.result: The ANN identifies spatial indicator patterns of forced change and can date maps; forced patterns are detectable from the 1960s onward in simulated and observed temperature.
0cf89214d27004c815c50d88e0d462ff7dfd7f67.open_work: Apply the approach to other variables and detection-attribution problems and to deeper diagnosis of model-observation differences.
0cf89214d27004c815c50d88e0d462ff7dfd7f67.issues: Indicator patterns are nonlinear mixtures of signal and noise and depend on the training ensemble; performance on observations relies on models capturing real forced patterns.

bed7c7a0ce014eca3d621decaf524380490c6087.goal: Reconstruct continuous sea surface height from sparse altimetry and infer unobserved deep ocean currents from SSH.
bed7c7a0ce014eca3d621decaf524380490c6087.architecture: Convolutional neural networks with residual learning for spatiotemporal SSH interpolation and deep-current estimation.
bed7c7a0ce014eca3d621decaf524380490c6087.data: Synthetic observations from an idealized two-layer quasigeostrophic model of baroclinic ocean turbulence.
bed7c7a0ce014eca3d621decaf524380490c6087.result: Residual CNNs outperform linear and dynamical interpolation for SSH reconstruction and provide skillful estimates of deep mesoscale currents, suggesting SSH eddy patterns carry information about the deep flow.
bed7c7a0ce014eca3d621decaf524380490c6087.open_work: Diversify training physics, use transfer learning and dynamically aware loss functions before applying to real satellite altimetry.
bed7c7a0ce014eca3d621decaf524380490c6087.issues: Proof of concept on highly idealized QG physics only; transfer to real ocean with its additional processes and observation errors is untested.

6ac4cd629771c0cc6e82b01c3a9b9b5f3c2f5c42.goal: Improve radar-based precipitation nowcasting for severe convective weather using deep learning.
6ac4cd629771c0cc6e82b01c3a9b9b5f3c2f5c42.architecture: ConvLSTM with a star-shape bridge layer to pass features across time steps, a rain-oriented loss inspired by the critical success index, and group normalization.
6ac4cd629771c0cc6e82b01c3a9b9b5f3c2f5c42.data: Radar echo dataset; region and period not reported in the abstract.
6ac4cd629771c0cc6e82b01c3a9b9b5f3c2f5c42.result: The model outperforms ConvLSTM trained with cross-entropy loss and conventional extrapolation; specific scores are not given in the abstract.
6ac4cd629771c0cc6e82b01c3a9b9b5f3c2f5c42.open_work: Test on longer lead times and other regions, and compare with newer nowcasting architectures and probabilistic approaches.
6ac4cd629771c0cc6e82b01c3a9b9b5f3c2f5c42.issues: Deterministic output likely blurs at longer lead times; evaluation details and dataset size are not reported in the abstract.

596da2ae4443ce033cd48032dc7a3492351267e0.goal: Reduce GCM precipitation and circulation biases by replacing moist physics (convection and clouds) with a deep learning parameterization.
596da2ae4443ce033cd48032dc7a3492351267e0.architecture: Residual convolutional neural network (ResCu) over the vertical column, including moist static energy conservation and past history of atmospheric states, convection and clouds.
596da2ae4443ce033cd48032dc7a3492351267e0.data: One year of SPCAM superparameterized GCM output for training, an independent year for testing; single-column model cases for midlatitude continental and tropical monsoon convection.
596da2ae4443ce033cd48032dc7a3492351267e0.result: ResCu reproduces SPCAM time mean and variance of heating, drying and cloud water, outperforms other network types, and in single-column prognostic tests gives smaller temperature and moisture biases than conventional schemes.
596da2ae4443ce033cd48032dc7a3492351267e0.open_work: Couple ResCu into a full 3D GCM and test long-term stability and climate simulation.
596da2ae4443ce033cd48032dc7a3492351267e0.issues: Only single-column prognostic tests, not full GCM coupling; trained on one year of SPCAM, so inherits its biases and may not generalize to other climates.

e2fdfd6a0c0bae89e0f1b6b12fd076e9a197cced.goal: Downscale short-range near-surface (100 m) wind forecasts quickly from coarse to high resolution over complex terrain.
e2fdfd6a0c0bae89e0f1b6b12fd076e9a197cced.architecture: Comparison of four CNN architectures against multilinear regression, plus a proposed U-Net-based DeepRU model; tests adding atmospheric predictors and static fields like topography and land-sea mask.
e2fdfd6a0c0bae89e0f1b6b12fd076e9a197cced.data: Short-range forecasts from ERA5 initial conditions at 31 km as input, ECMWF HRES 9 km forecasts as target, over the Alpine region.
e2fdfd6a0c0bae89e0f1b6b12fd076e9a197cced.result: DeepRU infers situation-dependent wind structures that other models miss; inference takes under 10 ms on a GPU versus minutes to hours for higher-resolution simulation.
e2fdfd6a0c0bae89e0f1b6b12fd076e9a197cced.open_work: Extend to other variables, levels, and regions, and to probabilistic downscaling.
e2fdfd6a0c0bae89e0f1b6b12fd076e9a197cced.issues: Target is a model forecast (HRES), not observations; deterministic CNNs may smooth small-scale variability.
