ded50f9ed2ffbd7aee593398d7066b8d1f7be113.goal: Test whether purely data-driven deep learning can produce deterministic and ensemble 24 h weather forecasts.
ded50f9ed2ffbd7aee593398d7066b8d1f7be113.architecture: Conditional deep convolutional generative adversarial network, with Monte Carlo dropout to generate ensembles.
ded50f9ed2ffbd7aee593398d7066b8d1f7be113.data: Four years of ERA5 reanalysis over Europe for training; 2019 for testing; Z500, 2 m temperature and total precipitation.
ded50f9ed2ffbd7aee593398d7066b8d1f7be113.result: Good agreement with reanalysis for Z500 and 2 m temperature but failure for precipitation; MC dropout ensembles improve skill and provide uncertainty estimates.
ded50f9ed2ffbd7aee593398d7066b8d1f7be113.open_work: Extend to longer lead times, more variables, and better-calibrated ensemble generation.
ded50f9ed2ffbd7aee593398d7066b8d1f7be113.issues: Short training period, regional domain and 24 h lead only; precipitation not captured; MC dropout spread is not necessarily calibrated.

34cd8289bbef0b8a877e677b688c6784b7951e1d.goal: Improve quantitative precipitation estimation over China by merging satellite, gauge and infrared data while using spatial and temporal correlations together.
34cd8289bbef0b8a877e677b688c6784b7951e1d.architecture: CNN-LSTM fusion model: CNN extracts spatial features of satellite, gauge and thermal infrared data; LSTM captures time dependence.
34cd8289bbef0b8a877e677b688c6784b7951e1d.data: TRMM 3B42 V7, thermal infrared imagery, and 796 rain gauges in China; produces a daily 0.05° dataset for 2001-2005.
34cd8289bbef0b8a877e677b688c6784b7951e1d.result: Outperforms CNN, LSTM and MLP alone; reduces TRMM RMSE by 17.0% and MAE by 14.7%, raising correlation to 0.72, including for gauge-sparse regions.
34cd8289bbef0b8a877e677b688c6784b7951e1d.open_work: Extend to newer satellite products (e.g. IMERG), longer periods, and sub-daily resolution.
34cd8289bbef0b8a877e677b688c6784b7951e1d.issues: Evaluation against gauges that also inform the merge needs careful independence; product covers only 2001-2005; extremes may be underestimated.

1f5d4e0278bd6f9dff2685df53593e05ef35a973.goal: Speed up radiative transfer in weather and climate models without sacrificing accuracy, especially with many greenhouse gases.
1f5d4e0278bd6f9dff2685df53593e05ef35a973.architecture: Neural networks replacing gas optics in the RTE+RRTMGP scheme, implemented in Fortran with BLAS batched inference, combined with a refactored radiative transfer solver.
1f5d4e0278bd6f9dff2685df53593e05ef35a973.data: Training data from carefully constructed atmospheric profiles spanning a wide range of conditions; validated against line-by-line benchmark calculations.
1f5d4e0278bd6f9dff2685df53593e05ef35a973.result: NN gas optics is 1-6 times faster; clear-sky longwave and shortwave fluxes 3.5 and 1.8 times faster on Intel; heating-rate errors typically below 0.1 K/day and TOA forcing errors below 0.5 W/m2.
1f5d4e0278bd6f9dff2685df53593e05ef35a973.open_work: Extend to cloudy-sky computations, GPU platforms and online testing in full models.
1f5d4e0278bd6f9dff2685df53593e05ef35a973.issues: Clear-sky only in the reported speedups; gains depend on hardware and software; accuracy outside the training distribution is not guaranteed.

d618d5e30e2f03671b8d39783ddf65350ce71be6.goal: Super-resolve global climate model wind and solar outputs to scales needed for renewable energy resource assessment under climate scenarios.
d618d5e30e2f03671b8d39783ddf65350ce71be6.architecture: Fully convolutional generative adversarial super-resolution network, trainable on small domains and applicable to arbitrarily sized inputs.
d618d5e30e2f03671b8d39783ddf65350ce71be6.data: High-resolution wind (NREL WIND Toolkit) and solar (NSRDB) data for training; applied to CMIP5 / IPCC AR5 climate scenario output.
d618d5e30e2f03671b8d39783ddf65350ce71be6.result: Achieves up to 50x resolution enhancement; outputs are robust to input noise, reproduce turbulent spectra and solar irradiance statistics, and remain consistent with coarse fields.
d618d5e30e2f03671b8d39783ddf65350ce71be6.open_work: Apply to more variables and scenarios and assess impacts on energy-system planning decisions.
d618d5e30e2f03671b8d39783ddf65350ce71be6.issues: GAN outputs may hallucinate fine-scale detail; training on present-day high-resolution data assumes the coarse-to-fine relationship holds under future climates.

f0220a0c209ef677dc8662998558acc628f03d56.goal: Assess whether deep neural networks can emulate cloud superparameterization in a realistic-geography climate model, toward hybrid models.
f0220a0c209ef677dc8662998558acc628f03d56.architecture: Feed-forward deep neural network with formally optimized hyperparameters (about 250 trials), applied locally in space and time.
f0220a0c209ef677dc8662998558acc628f03d56.data: Offline output from the superparameterized Community Atmosphere Model (SPCAM) with real geography at 15-minute sampling.
f0220a0c209ef677dc8662998558acc628f03d56.result: Explains over 70% of temporal variance in the mid-to-upper troposphere; weaker in the tropical marine boundary layer due to fast stochastic convection; skillful on diurnal to synoptic scales with some precipitation distortion.
f0220a0c209ef677dc8662998558acc628f03d56.open_work: Combine positivity constraints with tuning for precipitation, and couple the emulator online in hybrid climate models.
f0220a0c209ef677dc8662998558acc628f03d56.issues: Offline evaluation only, with no online stability test; deterministic network struggles with stochastic convective signals.

79fe2fd9b85b5183cfcdf7c1b3fce24b33656f5a.goal: Enable Bayesian parameter estimation with uncertainty when the forward model is expensive, noisy and has no derivatives, as in climate model calibration.
79fe2fd9b85b5183cfcdf7c1b3fce24b33656f5a.architecture: Three-step Calibrate-Emulate-Sample: ensemble Kalman sampling for calibration, Gaussian process emulation of the parameter-to-data map using those runs, then MCMC sampling with the emulator.
79fe2fd9b85b5183cfcdf7c1b3fce24b33656f5a.data: Test problems in the paper include an idealized GCM convection-parameter problem and simpler inverse problems; not a data-driven training study.
79fe2fd9b85b5183cfcdf7c1b3fce24b33656f5a.result: Provides approximate Bayesian posteriors with few forward model evaluations; EKS places training points where posterior mass is concentrated, making emulation efficient.
79fe2fd9b85b5183cfcdf7c1b3fce24b33656f5a.open_work: Scale to high-dimensional parameters and data, and apply to full climate model parameterization calibration.
79fe2fd9b85b5183cfcdf7c1b3fce24b33656f5a.issues: Posterior is approximate and depends on emulator quality; GP emulators scale poorly to high dimensions.

3cff0f359b48c933289dc7a8aa5e1ba56e830187.goal: Perform statistical downscaling without paired low/high-resolution training data, and enable sampling of synthetic fields.
3cff0f359b48c933289dc7a8aa5e1ba56e830187.architecture: ClimAlign: unsupervised generative domain alignment using normalizing flows adapted from variational inference.
3cff0f359b48c933289dc7a8aa5e1ba56e830187.data: Two datasets of daily gridded temperature and precipitation at 1° (low) and finer (high) resolution; exact products not stated in the abstract.
3cff0f359b48c933289dc7a8aa5e1ba56e830187.result: Predictive performance comparable to supervised statistical downscaling methods while allowing conditional and unconditional sampling of the joint distribution.
3cff0f359b48c933289dc7a8aa5e1ba56e830187.open_work: Test on more variables and climate model output, and examine physical consistency and extremes.
3cff0f359b48c933289dc7a8aa5e1ba56e830187.issues: Evaluation on limited datasets; unsupervised alignment may not preserve physically meaningful correspondences; extremes and nonstationarity not addressed.

b6c041c9703ac42c25a1d6696faae51afcf79ff2.goal: Detect externally forced climate change from a single day of global weather rather than from decades of data.
b6c041c9703ac42c25a1d6696faae51afcf79ff2.architecture: Statistical learning (regularized linear regression, ridge-type) linking spatial patterns of daily temperature and humidity to global climate metrics, trained on climate model simulations; observations projected onto the fingerprint.
b6c041c9703ac42c25a1d6696faae51afcf79ff2.data: CMIP5 climate model simulations for training; observational daily temperature and humidity datasets for detection.
b6c041c9703ac42c25a1d6696faae51afcf79ff2.result: Forced climate change is detected from any single day in the observed record since early 2012 and from any year since 1999, robust even when the global mean trend is removed.
b6c041c9703ac42c25a1d6696faae51afcf79ff2.open_work: Use the framework for communicating regional weather events in a climate context and for extending detection to other variables.
b6c041c9703ac42c25a1d6696faae51afcf79ff2.issues: Depends on climate models correctly representing internal variability; detection is global, not attributing individual local events.

db0562f8c4d1aa024919ca01e09542baabe93af4.goal: Learn ML parametrizations of unresolved processes from sparse, noisy observations rather than from dense high-resolution simulations.
db0562f8c4d1aa024919ca01e09542baabe93af4.architecture: Two-step hybrid: ensemble Kalman filter data assimilation estimates the full state with a truncated model, then a neural network learns model error (unresolved tendency) as a function of state; the NN is added to the truncated model.
db0562f8c4d1aa024919ca01e09542baabe93af4.data: Two-scale Lorenz model and MAOOAM, a reduced-order coupled ocean-atmosphere model, with synthetic noisy and sparse observations.
db0562f8c4d1aa024919ca01e09542baabe93af4.result: The hybrid model forecasts better than the truncated model in both systems and reproduces the attractor significantly better.
db0562f8c4d1aa024919ca01e09542baabe93af4.open_work: Apply to higher-dimensional and realistic models and iterate DA and learning jointly.
db0562f8c4d1aa024919ca01e09542baabe93af4.issues: Demonstrated only in low-order toy models; performance depends on the observation network and DA quality.

a24c181f054e35e8caf4fff78949f20569cb11b2.goal: Correct systematic biases in NWP forecasts of next-day maximum and minimum temperatures in urban Seoul, relevant for heat waves and tropical nights.
a24c181f054e35e8caf4fff78949f20569cb11b2.architecture: Random forest, support vector regression, artificial neural network, and a multi-model ensemble of them.
a24c181f054e35e8caf4fff78949f20569cb11b2.data: LDAPS (Korean local NWP) forecasts with 14 output variables, station observations of daily Tmax/Tmin and five auxiliary predictors in Seoul.
a24c181f054e35e8caf4fff78949f20569cb11b2.result: For Tmax, RMSE drops from 2.08 to 1.55-1.66 °C and R2 rises from 0.69 to 0.75-0.78; for Tmin, RMSE from 1.43 to 0.98-1.02 °C; the ensemble generalizes best in leave-one-station-out tests.
a24c181f054e35e8caf4fff78949f20569cb11b2.open_work: Extend to other cities, longer lead times and specific extreme-heat evaluation.
a24c181f054e35e8caf4fff78949f20569cb11b2.issues: Single city and short lead; extreme-temperature performance is not isolated; models must be retrained when the NWP system changes.

e6b8844c299a8bd0359e098dfb9e5cd91d4c8fdd.goal: Advance purely data-driven medium-range weather prediction and set a stronger WeatherBench baseline.
e6b8844c299a8bd0359e098dfb9e5cd91d4c8fdd.architecture: Deep residual convolutional neural network (ResNet) predicting directly at each lead time, pretrained on climate model output and fine-tuned on reanalysis.
e6b8844c299a8bd0359e098dfb9e5cd91d4c8fdd.data: WeatherBench ERA5 at 5.625°, with pretraining on CMIP6 historical simulations; geopotential, temperature and precipitation up to 5 days.
e6b8844c299a8bd0359e098dfb9e5cd91d4c8fdd.result: Outperforms earlier WeatherBench submissions and is comparable to a physical model run at similar coarse resolution (e.g. Z500 RMSE around 268 m2/s2 at 3 days and about 500 at 5 days); learned correlations look physically reasonable.
e6b8844c299a8bd0359e098dfb9e5cd91d4c8fdd.open_work: Scaling experiments suggest higher resolution and more data could improve skill further.
e6b8844c299a8bd0359e098dfb9e5cd91d4c8fdd.issues: Coarse 5.625° resolution; far behind operational IFS; deterministic forecasts blur at longer leads.

b116780dca967dc6b7fcf90687bd6a836476eaef.goal: Predict next-hour tornado occurrence for individual storms using deep learning on 3D radar and sounding data.
b116780dca967dc6b7fcf90687bd6a836476eaef.architecture: Convolutional neural networks on storm-centered 3D radar images plus Rapid Refresh proximity soundings, with hyperparameter experiments.
b116780dca967dc6b7fcf90687bd6a836476eaef.data: Multiradar composites MYRORSS and GridRad (separate models) with Rapid Refresh soundings; independent test data.
b116780dca967dc6b7fcf90687bd6a836476eaef.result: AUC above 0.9 for both; CSI of 0.31 (GridRad, 3.52% event frequency) and 0.17 (MYRORSS, 0.24%); errors concentrate in nontornadic rotating supercells and tornadic QLCS cells.
b116780dca967dc6b7fcf90687bd6a836476eaef.open_work: Implement in real-time forecasting and improve handling of QLCS tornadoes and rotating nontornadic supercells.
b116780dca967dc6b7fcf90687bd6a836476eaef.issues: Rare-event imbalance limits CSI; tornado reports used as labels have known reporting biases; performance varies strongly with dataset.

120e02f8c51b8bf55402334a5d9bbd20490cb0b2.goal: Improve ensemble forecasts and reduce cost by post-processing a reduced subset of ensemble members with deep learning.
120e02f8c51b8bf55402334a5d9bbd20490cb0b2.architecture: Deep neural networks (convolutional, U-Net/ResNet-style) post-processing a subset of ensemble trajectories to produce calibrated mean and spread.
120e02f8c51b8bf55402334a5d9bbd20490cb0b2.data: Global ECMWF ensemble reforecast-type data with ERA5 as reference (variables such as Z500 and T850 per the paper).
120e02f8c51b8bf55402334a5d9bbd20490cb0b2.result: Over 14% relative improvement in CRPS on global data, larger gains in selected extreme cases, and comparable skill to the full ensemble with fewer members.
120e02f8c51b8bf55402334a5d9bbd20490cb0b2.open_work: Use saved computational cost to run ensembles at higher resolution and extend to more variables.
120e02f8c51b8bf55402334a5d9bbd20490cb0b2.issues: Evaluation of extremes rests on select case studies; spread is learned rather than dynamically generated; tied to the specific ensemble system.

c07f8152968e1c1fa94dc63f839bfcc5690c3551.goal: Develop a generalizable deep learning downscaling of daily maximum and minimum 2 m temperature in complex terrain.
c07f8152968e1c1fa94dc63f839bfcc5690c3551.architecture: UNet modified into UNet-Autoencoder with an extra high-resolution elevation output branch, enabling semisupervised fine-tuning in unseen domains.
c07f8152968e1c1fa94dc63f839bfcc5690c3551.data: PRISM 4 km and 0.25° coarsened data with elevation; trained on south and central-western US 2015-2018; tested 2018-2019 including the unseen northwestern US.
c07f8152968e1c1fa94dc63f839bfcc5690c3551.result: Original UNet lacks fine detail when transferred; UNet-AE reduces MAE by more than 10% relative to UNet.
c07f8152968e1c1fa94dc63f839bfcc5690c3551.open_work: Apply to other variables (Part II covers precipitation) and to downscaling actual model output.
c07f8152968e1c1fa94dc63f839bfcc5690c3551.issues: Target is PRISM, itself an interpolated product; inputs are coarsened PRISM rather than real GCM or reanalysis output; short training period.

d8a935946ca186d798c6b71422b9a84389a3bd70.goal: Downscale daily precipitation over complex terrain in western North America with deep learning.
d8a935946ca186d798c6b71422b9a84389a3bd70.architecture: UNet and a proposed Nest-UNet with deep-layer aggregation and nested skip connections; inputs include low-resolution precipitation, high-resolution precipitation climatology and elevation.
d8a935946ca186d798c6b71422b9a84389a3bd70.data: PRISM data from 0.25° to 4 km; training on south and central-western US 2015-2018, testing 2018-2019 on all domains; station observations for comparison.
d8a935946ca186d798c6b71422b9a84389a3bd70.result: Both UNets generalize across regions and beat the BCSD baseline with lower error and finer textures; Nest-UNet shares the most information with stations and PRISM.
d8a935946ca186d798c6b71422b9a84389a3bd70.open_work: Test with actual climate or NWP model inputs and assess extremes and probabilistic outputs.
d8a935946ca186d798c6b71422b9a84389a3bd70.issues: Deterministic output may underrepresent extremes; inputs are coarsened PRISM rather than model output; short training period.

ebe1dba2ee56687eebe1577d657b269c5dfda101.goal: Make GOES-R observations usable in precipitating scenes for convective-scale data assimilation by converting them to synthetic radar reflectivity.
ebe1dba2ee56687eebe1577d657b269c5dfda101.architecture: Convolutional neural network mapping ABI radiances and GLM lightning to radar reflectivity, interpreted with channel/spatial withholding, layerwise relevance propagation and synthetic inputs.
ebe1dba2ee56687eebe1577d657b269c5dfda101.data: GOES-16 ABI radiances and GLM lightning with collocated MRMS radar reflectivity over the central and eastern US.
ebe1dba2ee56687eebe1577d657b269c5dfda101.result: Spatial context in CNNs gives a major improvement over pixel-by-pixel methods; skill at high reflectivity comes from radiance gradients and lightning, with lightning pinpointing strong echoes.
ebe1dba2ee56687eebe1577d657b269c5dfda101.open_work: Assimilate the synthetic reflectivity in convective-scale models and extend to regions without radar.
ebe1dba2ee56687eebe1577d657b269c5dfda101.issues: Trained where radar exists, so performance in data-sparse regions is unverified; high reflectivity is rare and harder to capture.

72bd57cd1d9ac72a2ba1685b870243895181e5c2.goal: Objectively discover shallow trade-wind cloud organization regimes from satellite images, given their importance for climate sensitivity.
72bd57cd1d9ac72a2ba1685b870243895181e5c2.architecture: Unsupervised neural network (triplet-loss convolutional embedding, Tile2Vec-style) followed by clustering of the embeddings.
72bd57cd1d9ac72a2ba1685b870243895181e5c2.data: 10,000 GOES-16 satellite images over the tropical Atlantic in boreal winter.
72bd57cd1d9ac72a2ba1685b870243895181e5c2.result: Discovers a hierarchy of organization regimes across scales, with sub-clusters having distinct radiative properties, without hand-labeled data.
72bd57cd1d9ac72a2ba1685b870243895181e5c2.open_work: Study environmental conditions and transitions between regimes, and compare models to observations through emergent cloud structures.
72bd57cd1d9ac72a2ba1685b870243895181e5c2.issues: Clusters require physical interpretation; trained on one region and season; links to climate sensitivity remain indirect.

c6ae33747ccefff4722c437bc340f3170e5fc8b1.goal: Turn a deterministic neural network weather forecast into an ensemble with a useful spread-error relationship.
c6ae33747ccefff4722c437bc340f3170e5fc8b1.architecture: Comparison of four ensemble methods for a CNN forecast model: random initial perturbations, retraining, MC dropout, and singular vector initial perturbations.
c6ae33747ccefff4722c437bc340f3170e5fc8b1.data: Reanalysis data at coarse resolution (ERA5-based per the paper) for training and testing.
c6ae33747ccefff4722c437bc340f3170e5fc8b1.result: All ensemble means beat the unperturbed forecast, with retraining giving the largest improvement; NN skill remains systematically below state-of-the-art NWP.
c6ae33747ccefff4722c437bc340f3170e5fc8b1.open_work: Combine methods and apply to stronger NN forecast models for better calibration.
c6ae33747ccefff4722c437bc340f3170e5fc8b1.issues: Base model is weak relative to NWP; coarse resolution; spread calibration is method-dependent.

b31e4e9d6ba87a8e709d743b1e96a18c8dd0bbf6.goal: Provide practical guidance for evaluating, tuning and interpreting neural networks applied to meteorological imagery.
b31e4e9d6ba87a8e709d743b1e96a18c8dd0bbf6.architecture: Tutorial and perspective covering receptive fields, meteorological performance measures, and interpretation via synthetic experiments and layerwise relevance propagation, for classification and image-to-image tasks.
b31e4e9d6ba87a8e709d743b1e96a18c8dd0bbf6.data: Illustrated with examples such as satellite-to-radar translation (GOES to synthetic reflectivity).
b31e4e9d6ba87a8e709d743b1e96a18c8dd0bbf6.result: Frames interpretation as an iterative, meteorologist-driven discovery process with hypothesis testing; highlights underused strategies.
b31e4e9d6ba87a8e709d743b1e96a18c8dd0bbf6.open_work: Develop community best practices and interpretation tools for image-to-image networks.
b31e4e9d6ba87a8e709d743b1e96a18c8dd0bbf6.issues: Guidance rather than systematic benchmarking; examples drawn from a limited set of applications.

1505809876b6ea15ac7142fb152c6d818cef88dc.goal: Produce probabilistic Day 1-3 severe weather forecasts over CONUS analogous to SPC convective outlooks.
1505809876b6ea15ac7142fb152c6d818cef88dc.architecture: Random forests with separate models for tornado, hail and severe wind (Day 1) and regional models, using spatiotemporal fields such as CAPE, CIN and shear.
1505809876b6ea15ac7142fb152c6d818cef88dc.data: GEFS reforecast ensemble 2003-2012 for training; testing April 2012-December 2016 against storm reports and SPC outlooks.
1505809876b6ea15ac7142fb152c6d818cef88dc.result: RF outlooks are calibrated, slightly underperform SPC at Day 1 but significantly outperform at Days 2 and 3; blends with SPC beat SPC alone at all lead days.
1505809876b6ea15ac7142fb152c6d818cef88dc.open_work: Operational integration and use of higher-resolution or convection-allowing inputs.
1505809876b6ea15ac7142fb152c6d818cef88dc.issues: Coarse GEFS/R inputs; storm reports have population and reporting biases; feature importance is not physical causation.

5d43dd7f5bed226db9028194fb5a9431e7fe5169.goal: Forecast tropical cyclone track and intensity with ML by combining diverse data sources.
5d43dd7f5bed226db9028194fb5a9431e7fe5169.architecture: Hurricast: multimodal framework using deep encoder-decoder (CNN/GRU/transformer) feature extraction from spatial-temporal reanalysis fields, combined with statistical features in gradient-boosted trees.
5d43dd7f5bed226db9028194fb5a9431e7fe5169.data: Historical storm data (best track) and reanalysis fields; evaluation in North Atlantic and Eastern Pacific for 2016-2019 at 24 h lead.
5d43dd7f5bed226db9028194fb5a9431e7fe5169.result: Comparable mean absolute error and skill to operational models at 24 h, computed in seconds; adding Hurricast to a consensus could improve over NHC official forecasts.
5d43dd7f5bed226db9028194fb5a9431e7fe5169.open_work: Extend to longer lead times, other basins, and operational real-time inputs.
5d43dd7f5bed226db9028194fb5a9431e7fe5169.issues: Only 24 h lead evaluated; reliance on reanalysis inputs differs from operational availability; rapid intensification not specifically addressed.

38018254d806f18352f2f3702380c18403aeef35.goal: Identify reliable regional indicator patterns of forced climate change amid internal variability and model differences.
38018254d806f18352f2f3702380c18403aeef35.architecture: ANN trained to predict the year from annual-mean temperature or precipitation maps, visualized with layerwise relevance propagation and backward optimization; designed so indicators vary in time.
38018254d806f18352f2f3702380c18403aeef35.data: CMIP5 forced climate model simulations; observations used to compare with simulated patterns.
38018254d806f18352f2f3702380c18403aeef35.result: Produces time-evolving indicator patterns of forced change, compared with signal-to-noise and multilinear regression; backward optimization highlights where model-observation disagreements matter most.
38018254d806f18352f2f3702380c18403aeef35.open_work: Apply to other variables and use the indicators for model evaluation and detection.
38018254d806f18352f2f3702380c18403aeef35.issues: Patterns depend on the model ensemble and ANN design; LRP explanations can be method-dependent.

18b0ca3448bd9703bff86c375362b6ad34f797f7.goal: Survey how scientific knowledge is integrated with machine learning in engineering and environmental systems.
18b0ca3448bd9703bff86c375362b6ad34f797f7.architecture: Structured review and taxonomy of physics-guided ML and hybrid physics-ML methods (physics-guided loss, architecture, initialization, hybrid modeling, etc.) by application objective.
18b0ca3448bd9703bff86c375362b6ad34f797f7.data: No new data; reviews literature across disciplines including climate, hydrology and fluid dynamics.
18b0ca3448bd9703bff86c375362b6ad34f797f7.result: Provides a taxonomy that reveals knowledge gaps and possible method crossovers between disciplines.
18b0ca3448bd9703bff86c375362b6ad34f797f7.open_work: Identifies opportunities for transferring techniques across fields and for further hybrid model development.
18b0ca3448bd9703bff86c375362b6ad34f797f7.issues: Broad scope, so atmospheric and ocean applications receive limited depth; the field has evolved rapidly since publication.

a4782e1224121185e11bfa5926717e8f8cff8f0f.goal: Explains why neural-network convection parameterizations become unstable when coupled to atmospheric dynamics and provides diagnostics to interpret and stabilize them.
a4782e1224121185e11bfa5926717e8f8cff8f0f.architecture: Interpretability tools for NN parameterizations: nonlinear sensitivity to lower-tropospheric stability and mid-tropospheric moisture, plus linearized response functions coupled to simplified gravity-wave dynamics for spectral stability analysis.
a4782e1224121185e11bfa5926717e8f8cff8f0f.data: Two sets of NNs, one trained on superparameterized CAM (SPCAM) output and one on a near-global cloud-resolving model (GCRM).
a4782e1224121185e11bfa5926717e8f8cff8f0f.result: Both NNs predict stronger heating/drying in moist, unstable environments, consistent with observations. Instability arises when coupled NNs support unstable propagating gravity waves with phase speeds above 5 m/s; standing unstable modes are not catastrophic.
a4782e1224121185e11bfa5926717e8f8cff8f0f.open_work: Use the diagnostics routinely during training or as constraints to design NNs that are stable online by construction, and test in full GCMs.
a4782e1224121185e11bfa5926717e8f8cff8f0f.issues: Linearized gravity-wave analysis is a simplified framework and may miss nonlinear instability routes; the stability fixes are incremental rather than guaranteed.

9e20f6874feaaf7c9994f9875b1d9cab17a2fd59.goal: Learns fast surrogate simulators for mesh-based physical simulations, which are costly and require per-system tuning.
9e20f6874feaaf7c9994f9875b1d9cab17a2fd59.architecture: MeshGraphNets: graph neural network encoder-processor-decoder that passes messages on the simulation mesh (mesh-space and world-space edges) and learns to adapt mesh resolution during rollout.
9e20f6874feaaf7c9994f9875b1d9cab17a2fd59.data: Simulated trajectories from conventional solvers for aerodynamics (incompressible and compressible flow), structural mechanics and cloth.
9e20f6874feaaf7c9994f9875b1d9cab17a2fd59.result: Accurately predicts dynamics across domains, generalizes to larger and more complex state spaces at test time, and runs 1-2 orders of magnitude faster than the source simulator.
9e20f6874feaaf7c9994f9875b1d9cab17a2fd59.open_work: Extension to larger 3D systems and longer horizons; the GNN-on-mesh design later underpins global weather models such as GraphCast.
9e20f6874feaaf7c9994f9875b1d9cab17a2fd59.issues: Not an atmospheric application; trained on the simulator it emulates, so accuracy is bounded by it, and long rollouts can still accumulate error.

4ec6cc7201d2f6c8618ee4ce84e473a124c7b1f2.goal: Uses physics-informed deep learning to revisit variational data assimilation by jointly learning the dynamical prior and the solver of the assimilation problem.
4ec6cc7201d2f6c8618ee4ce84e473a124c7b1f2.architecture: End-to-end differentiable variational DA framework: a trainable dynamical/prior model plus a learned (recurrent, gradient-based) solver for the variational cost, trained supervised or unsupervised via automatic differentiation.
4ec6cc7201d2f6c8618ee4ce84e473a124c7b1f2.data: Idealized experiments with Lorenz-63 and Lorenz-96 systems with partial, noisy observations.
4ec6cc7201d2f6c8618ee4ce84e473a124c7b1f2.result: Significant gains over classical gradient-based minimization of the variational cost in reconstruction accuracy and optimization cost; variational models based on the true ODEs are not always the best-performing priors.
4ec6cc7201d2f6c8618ee4ce84e473a124c7b1f2.open_work: Scale to high-dimensional geophysical problems (e.g., satellite sea surface fields) and explore learned assimilation models for operational design.
4ec6cc7201d2f6c8618ee4ce84e473a124c7b1f2.issues: Demonstrated only on low-dimensional toy systems; supervised training requires ground-truth states rarely available in practice.

e732758fc8139e028d413c9921bcb2cb15fb3e9d.goal: Builds a general learned simulator for complex particle-based physics (fluids, rigid and deformable materials).
e732758fc8139e028d413c9921bcb2cb15fb3e9d.architecture: Graph Network-based Simulators (GNS): particles as graph nodes, encoder-processor-decoder with learned message passing, trained on single-step predictions with input noise injection.
e732758fc8139e028d413c9921bcb2cb15fb3e9d.data: Particle-based simulations of fluids (water, sand, goop), rigid solids and deformable materials from various physics solvers.
e732758fc8139e028d413c9921bcb2cb15fb3e9d.result: Generalizes from single-step training with thousands of particles to thousands of rollout steps, new initial conditions and at least 10x more particles; long-term accuracy depends mainly on the number of message-passing steps and noise injection.
e732758fc8139e028d413c9921bcb2cb15fb3e9d.open_work: Apply to inverse problems and larger-scale scientific simulations.
e732758fc8139e028d413c9921bcb2cb15fb3e9d.issues: Not an atmospheric study; Lagrangian particle setting differs from gridded geophysical models, and no physical conservation is enforced.

8f28211a2170ac109ecce513cd726fee200e2386.goal: Argues that ML emulation of weather (initial-value problem) and climate (boundary-value problem) models should be approached differently, and surveys climate model emulation.
8f28211a2170ac109ecce513cd726fee200e2386.architecture: Perspective/review of climate-model emulation, including statistical emulators of steady-state responses and their use in parameter estimation and inverse problems. Not a new ML method.
8f28211a2170ac109ecce513cd726fee200e2386.data: No new data; draws on existing climate-model emulation literature.
8f28211a2170ac109ecce513cd726fee200e2386.result: Concludes that emulating full atmospheric dynamics is often unnecessary for climate questions, and that recent ML advances offer new opportunities despite limited training data and nonlinearity.
8f28211a2170ac109ecce513cd726fee200e2386.open_work: Develop emulators that handle limited training samples, provide uncertainty, and address inverse problems such as parameter calibration.
8f28211a2170ac109ecce513cd726fee200e2386.issues: Opinion piece without quantitative evaluation; the field has since moved quickly (e.g., autoregressive climate emulators).

088488af28a93fac590827e538a1ebc0cea26e6f.goal: Develops a neural weather model for short-range precipitation forecasting that can beat NWP at high resolution with low latency.
088488af28a93fac590827e538a1ebc0cea26e6f.architecture: MetNet: convolutional LSTM encoder plus axial self-attention over a large input patch (about 1 million km2), conditioned on lead time, producing a probabilistic (categorical) precipitation map.
088488af28a93fac590827e538a1ebc0cea26e6f.data: Radar (MRMS) and GOES-16 satellite inputs over the continental United States; precipitation targets at 1 km and 2-minute resolution.
088488af28a93fac590827e538a1ebc0cea26e6f.result: Outperforms operational NWP (HRRR) at lead times up to 7-8 hours across precipitation thresholds, with forecasts produced in seconds.
088488af28a93fac590827e538a1ebc0cea26e6f.open_work: Extend lead time and add more inputs (later MetNet-2/3 incorporate NWP-like states and longer horizons).
088488af28a93fac590827e538a1ebc0cea26e6f.issues: Skill advantage over NWP vanishes beyond about 8 hours; evaluated over CONUS only; outputs are marginal probabilities per pixel, not spatially coherent ensembles.

ff6bbdb436e0ced811e7f0d2e07c452f5004da55.goal: Identifies opportunities and obstacles for AI in Earth and environmental sciences, especially satellite data exploitation and NWP at NOAA.
ff6bbdb436e0ced811e7f0d2e07c452f5004da55.architecture: Community report synthesizing the first NOAA workshop on AI for satellite Earth observations and NWP (April 2019), including discussions and polling. Not a new ML method.
ff6bbdb436e0ced811e7f0d2e07c452f5004da55.data: Input from more than 400 participants across public, academic and private sectors.
ff6bbdb436e0ced811e7f0d2e07c452f5004da55.result: Describes paths to use AI on massive satellite and in situ data volumes for NWP and reports recommendations for scientists and decision-makers.
ff6bbdb436e0ced811e7f0d2e07c452f5004da55.open_work: Implement recommendations on infrastructure, training, data readiness and operational transition of AI tools.
ff6bbdb436e0ced811e7f0d2e07c452f5004da55.issues: Workshop-based opinion and polling rather than quantitative evidence; recommendations predate the 2022+ wave of ML weather models.

7c64cd071155b68fe4d5b69e8afc868d441c08e6.goal: Tests whether long-term regional temperature responses to forcing can be predicted from short-term climate model simulations, to cut scenario computation costs.
7c64cd071155b68fe4d5b69e8afc868d441c08e6.architecture: Statistical learning (ridge regression and Gaussian process regression) mapping short-term temperature responses to long-term response patterns across forcing scenarios.
7c64cd071155b68fe4d5b69e8afc868d441c08e6.data: An existing ensemble of GCM simulations with different forcing perturbations (greenhouse gases, aerosols), providing paired short- and long-term responses.
7c64cd071155b68fe4d5b69e8afc868d441c08e6.result: ML predictions of long-term regional temperature change patterns outperform simple baselines (e.g., pattern scaling) and reveal early indicators of long-term responses.
7c64cd071155b68fe4d5b69e8afc868d441c08e6.open_work: Use larger multi-model datasets and data sharing between institutes to build stronger climate response emulators.
7c64cd071155b68fe4d5b69e8afc868d441c08e6.issues: Small training set of scenarios from limited models; emulator only reproduces modelled responses and is not validated against observations.

1b454a75e3d5608d7105f8022bfbc11a84baf5dc.goal: Provides a curated, co-registered dataset of storm events to support deep learning in radar and satellite meteorology.
1b454a75e3d5608d7105f8022bfbc11a84baf5dc.architecture: Benchmark dataset (SEVIR) with baseline deep learning models for tasks such as nowcasting and synthetic weather radar generation from satellite.
1b454a75e3d5608d7105f8022bfbc11a84baf5dc.data: More than 10,000 events, each 4 hours at 5-minute steps over 384 km x 384 km patches across the US, with GOES-16 visible and infrared channels, NEXRAD vertically integrated liquid, and GLM lightning.
1b454a75e3d5608d7105f8022bfbc11a84baf5dc.result: Supplies standardized data and baseline results (e.g., U-Net style models) that became a widely used nowcasting benchmark.
1b454a75e3d5608d7105f8022bfbc11a84baf5dc.open_work: Benchmark more advanced generative and probabilistic nowcasting models and expand coverage beyond the US.
1b454a75e3d5608d7105f8022bfbc11a84baf5dc.issues: US-only, event-centred sampling biases toward storms; abstract unavailable here, so details are from knowledge of the paper.

b27f82b84ffd0894f649279946354acc760d2bb4.goal: Develops a lightweight neural network for precipitation nowcasting that uses the latest observations.
b27f82b84ffd0894f649279946354acc760d2bb4.architecture: SmaAt-UNet: U-Net with convolutional block attention modules and depthwise-separable convolutions to reduce parameters.
b27f82b84ffd0894f649279946354acc760d2bb4.data: Radar precipitation maps over the Netherlands (KNMI); also a cloud cover dataset in the paper.
b27f82b84ffd0894f649279946354acc760d2bb4.result: Accuracy comparable to other examined models (including standard U-Net) with only a quarter of the trainable parameters.
b27f82b84ffd0894f649279946354acc760d2bb4.open_work: Probabilistic outputs, longer lead times and evaluation on extremes.
b27f82b84ffd0894f649279946354acc760d2bb4.issues: Deterministic MSE-trained output likely blurs at longer leads; single region evaluated.

db425c12be68367ccfc9eee5dddd2a2f1a4cfb74.goal: Learns a subgrid parameterization from high-resolution simulations that is stable when coupled and examines performance across grid spacings.
db425c12be68367ccfc9eee5dddd2a2f1a4cfb74.architecture: Random forest parameterization predicting subgrid tendencies/fluxes from coarse-grained high-resolution output.
db425c12be68367ccfc9eee5dddd2a2f1a4cfb74.data: Coarse-grained output of a 3D high-resolution idealized atmospheric model (SAM on an equatorial beta-plane), at several coarse-graining factors.
db425c12be68367ccfc9eee5dddd2a2f1a4cfb74.result: Coupled coarse simulations are stable and reproduce the high-resolution climate; performance is best at smaller horizontal grid spacings.
db425c12be68367ccfc9eee5dddd2a2f1a4cfb74.open_work: Learn from emerging global high-resolution (storm-resolving) simulations and test in realistic GCM settings.
db425c12be68367ccfc9eee5dddd2a2f1a4cfb74.issues: Idealized domain; random forests are memory-heavy; generalization to warmer climates not tested here.

9c9cb4d686369e23385813e9320810afe7015335.goal: Reviews statistical postprocessing of weather forecasts and its challenges in a big-data, high-resolution ensemble era.
9c9cb4d686369e23385813e9320810afe7015335.architecture: Review spanning bias correction, distribution-adjusting methods (EMOS, BMA, quantile regression), multivariate dependence reconstruction, ML methods and operational practice.
9c9cb4d686369e23385813e9320810afe7015335.data: No new data; synthesizes literature and operational experience at national meteorological services.
9c9cb4d686369e23385813e9320810afe7015335.result: Identifies key challenges: km-scale ensembles with huge data volumes, preserving space-time correlations, model upgrades, blending forecasts, and research-to-operations transfer.
9c9cb4d686369e23385813e9320810afe7015335.open_work: Develop methods that scale, maintain multivariate coherence, and remain robust to NWP model changes.
9c9cb4d686369e23385813e9320810afe7015335.issues: Review; ML methods are covered but the field has evolved quickly since publication.

e269810a7115aef4a0d2c14f1474991eaa639403.goal: Evaluates CNN-based statistical downscaling of daily temperature and precipitation across China and compares with established methods.
e269810a7115aef4a0d2c14f1474991eaa639403.architecture: CNN models with different configurations mapping large-scale reanalysis predictors to high-resolution grids, compared with GLM, BCSD and BCCI quantile-mapping methods.
e269810a7115aef4a0d2c14f1474991eaa639403.data: ERA-Interim predictors and high-resolution gridded observations over China; calibration 1979-1999, validation 2000-2017.
e269810a7115aef4a0d2c14f1474991eaa639403.result: CNN adds value over ERA-Interim in seasonal means, seasonal cycle and extreme percentiles and beats GLM for precipitation; bias-correction methods remain best for biases and temporal correlation.
e269810a7115aef4a0d2c14f1474991eaa639403.open_work: Apply to GCM projections and improve temporal correlation and precipitation extremes.
e269810a7115aef4a0d2c14f1474991eaa639403.issues: Perfect-prognosis setting with reanalysis predictors; extrapolation tested only within a modestly warmer period.

b501bc13f3a5166a5e622b5fafe084396c77df13.goal: Develops stochastic, temporally consistent super-resolution (downscaling) of atmospheric fields that produces ensembles.
b501bc13f3a5166a5e622b5fafe084396c77df13.architecture: Recurrent conditional GAN (convolutional GRU-based generator and discriminator) generating ensembles of high-resolution image sequences from low-resolution sequences.
b501bc13f3a5166a5e622b5fafe084396c77df13.data: Swiss radar precipitation (MeteoSwiss) and GOES-16-derived cloud optical thickness.
b501bc13f3a5166a5e622b5fafe084396c77df13.result: Generates realistic, temporally consistent sequences; rank statistics indicate near-correct ensemble spread; fully convolutional generator applies to larger domains and longer sequences.
b501bc13f3a5166a5e622b5fafe084396c77df13.open_work: Apply to downscaling of model output (rather than coarsened observations) and to other variables.
b501bc13f3a5166a5e622b5fafe084396c77df13.issues: Trained on artificially coarsened observations, so performance on real model output is untested; GAN training stability and mode collapse are general risks.

cac3eda036b01ff0c0c6babab25fb77dd8633afb.goal: Systematically assesses ML approaches for sub-seasonal (2 weeks to 2 months) temperature forecasting, a difficult and understudied range.
cac3eda036b01ff0c0c6babab25fb77dd8633afb.architecture: Comparison of 10 ML methods including linear models, XGBoost, and deep learning models (e.g., LSTM, CNN-type encoder-decoders).
cac3eda036b01ff0c0c6babab25fb77dd8633afb.data: A new sub-seasonal dataset over the contiguous US with atmospheric, oceanic and land variables, released with code.
cac3eda036b01ff0c0c6babab25fb77dd8633afb.result: Well-chosen ML models such as XGBoost capture some sub-seasonal predictability and beat climatology; deep learning models barely match the best results.
cac3eda036b01ff0c0c6babab25fb77dd8633afb.open_work: Better feature representation and architectures; comparison with dynamical S2S models.
cac3eda036b01ff0c0c6babab25fb77dd8633afb.issues: Limited observational sample; skill measured relative to climatology rather than operational S2S systems.

5b8b3566ee19bb81a61c43dcaf13b17fbcd2430f.goal: Improves monthly ENSO index prediction (Nino 3.4 and SOI) at leads of 1-12 months.
5b8b3566ee19bb81a61c43dcaf13b17fbcd2430f.architecture: Hybrid EEMD-TCN: ensemble empirical mode decomposition splits each index into subcomponents, each forecast by a temporal convolutional network, then recombined.
5b8b3566ee19bb81a61c43dcaf13b17fbcd2430f.data: Nino 3.4 and SOI reanalysis indices; training 1871-1973, testing 1984-2019.
5b8b3566ee19bb81a61c43dcaf13b17fbcd2430f.result: EEMD-TCN beats TCN, LSTM and EEMD-LSTM at all leads; Nino 3.4 is more predictable than SOI, and worst-case (12-month SOI) correlation is 0.64.
5b8b3566ee19bb81a61c43dcaf13b17fbcd2430f.open_work: Add spatial predictors and compare with dynamical and other ML ENSO models (e.g., CNN-based).
5b8b3566ee19bb81a61c43dcaf13b17fbcd2430f.issues: Applying EEMD to the full series before splitting can leak future information into the test period; univariate index-only approach.

c83c465a770e5072445afee85b12ce82f0c36891.goal: Documents ERA5, ECMWF's fifth-generation global reanalysis replacing ERA-Interim.
c83c465a770e5072445afee85b12ce82f0c36891.architecture: Non-ML: 4D-Var data assimilation with IFS Cy41r2 at about 31 km, hourly output, plus a 10-member ensemble (3-hourly, half resolution) for uncertainty.
c83c465a770e5072445afee85b12ce82f0c36891.data: Global observations from 1950 onwards (paper focuses on 1979 onwards); atmosphere, land surface and ocean waves.
c83c465a770e5072445afee85b12ce82f0c36891.result: Re-forecasts gain up to one day of skill over ERA-Interim; better tropospheric fit to radiosondes and much better wave heights; correlation with GPCP monthly precipitation rises from 67% to 77%.
c83c465a770e5072445afee85b12ce82f0c36891.open_work: Complete the back extension to 1950 and address stratospheric and other known biases.
c83c465a770e5072445afee85b12ce82f0c36891.issues: No improvement in stratospheric fit; ensemble spread reflects observing-system changes. As the main training set for ML weather models, its biases propagate into them.

ced4e0d0493bfbd3b73daf36a796f9e6c63221c5.goal: Speeds up and improves detection of tropical and extratropical cyclone regions in large meteorological datasets.
ced4e0d0493bfbd3b73daf36a796f9e6c63221c5.architecture: Four U-Net image-segmentation models trained with labels from IBTrACS or a heuristic detection method.
ced4e0d0493bfbd3b73daf36a796f9e6c63221c5.data: GFS total precipitable water and GOES water vapor radiance imagery.
ced4e0d0493bfbd3b73daf36a796f9e6c63221c5.result: ROI detection accuracy of 80-99%, Dice 0.51-0.76, Tversky 0.56-0.74; the extratropical U-Net runs 3x faster than the heuristic and finds ROIs missed by heuristics and hand-labelling.
ced4e0d0493bfbd3b73daf36a796f9e6c63221c5.open_work: Operational real-time use and improved labels.
ced4e0d0493bfbd3b73daf36a796f9e6c63221c5.issues: Moderate overlap scores; 'missed' detections beyond labels are hard to verify objectively.

b61d003c99d410bdbc946e02b29ca155a77c88d5.goal: Builds a neural-network subgrid parameterization that is stable, physically consistent and cheap, improving on random forests.
b61d003c99d410bdbc946e02b29ca155a77c88d5.architecture: Neural networks predicting subgrid fluxes (rather than tendencies) to enforce physical constraints such as conservation, tested with various architectures and reduced numerical precision.
b61d003c99d410bdbc946e02b29ca155a77c88d5.data: Coarse-grained high-resolution idealized atmospheric simulation (SAM) with accurately computed subgrid terms.
b61d003c99d410bdbc946e02b29ca155a77c88d5.result: Coupled simulations are stable and replicate the high-resolution climate with accuracy similar to a random forest while using far less memory; stable across resolutions and architectures, and reduced precision does not degrade results.
b61d003c99d410bdbc946e02b29ca155a77c88d5.open_work: Extend to global and realistic configurations and to climate change generalization.
b61d003c99d410bdbc946e02b29ca155a77c88d5.issues: Idealized domain; evaluation against the same high-resolution model used for training.

fcbb249016782b000dbc659958c5325f38f58b87.goal: Provides a common benchmark for data-driven medium-range (3-5 day) global weather forecasting to enable fair comparisons.
fcbb249016782b000dbc659958c5325f38f58b87.architecture: Benchmark dataset with evaluation metrics (latitude-weighted RMSE, mainly Z500 and T850) and baselines: persistence, climatology, linear regression, CNNs, and IFS physical models at coarse resolutions.
fcbb249016782b000dbc659958c5325f38f58b87.data: ERA5 regridded to 5.625, 2.8125 and 1.40625 degrees, 1979-2018, with 2017-2018 as test years.
fcbb249016782b000dbc659958c5325f38f58b87.result: Simple deep learning baselines trail operational IFS by a wide margin, establishing a reference point for later models.
fcbb249016782b000dbc659958c5325f38f58b87.open_work: Higher-resolution, probabilistic evaluation and more variables (later addressed by WeatherBench 2).
fcbb249016782b000dbc659958c5325f38f58b87.issues: Coarse resolution and few headline variables; deterministic RMSE favours smooth forecasts.

2da241817a2f598d7317431432300e05819a8a2d.goal: Compares ways of combining ML and data assimilation to learn corrections to a physical model's error, offline and online.
2da241817a2f598d7317431432300e05819a8a2d.architecture: Hybrid surrogate models with a neural-network correction added either to the model resolvent (integrated step) or inside the tendencies (requires adjoint); online learning formulated as a weak-constraint 4D-Var variant.
2da241817a2f598d7317431432300e05819a8a2d.data: Two-scale Lorenz model with sparse, noisy observations.
2da241817a2f598d7317431432300e05819a8a2d.result: Both corrections give similar long-range forecast accuracy, but tendency correction is much better in DA experiments; online learning extracts all information from sparse, noisy observations.
2da241817a2f598d7317431432300e05819a8a2d.open_work: Implement in operational systems (e.g., IFS) where adjoints exist.
2da241817a2f598d7317431432300e05819a8a2d.issues: Toy model; the tendency correction needs an adjoint of the physical model.

b4e3d64771a63f6990bdce638b1e062f83395a96.goal: Argues for building digital twins of Earth to inform climate adaptation and mitigation decisions in the green transition.
b4e3d64771a63f6990bdce638b1e062f83395a96.architecture: Perspective on combining km-scale Earth system simulation, observations, data assimilation, ML and exascale computing into interactive information systems (linked to the EU Destination Earth initiative). Not a new ML method.
b4e3d64771a63f6990bdce638b1e062f83395a96.result: Outlines the vision, required computing and data infrastructure, and the role of ML for emulation and processing.
b4e3d64771a63f6990bdce638b1e062f83395a96.open_work: Realize the infrastructure, international coordination and user interaction the vision requires.
b4e3d64771a63f6990bdce638b1e062f83395a96.issues: Vision paper without quantitative results; abstract not available here, so content is from knowledge of the paper.

427fe0e6e2e2d6f927c62e80c75706e02c2a747f.goal: Provides an efficient token mixer for vision transformers on high-resolution inputs, where self-attention scales quadratically.
427fe0e6e2e2d6f927c62e80c75706e02c2a747f.architecture: Adaptive Fourier Neural Operator (AFNO): token mixing as a global convolution in the Fourier domain with block-diagonal channel mixing, adaptive weight sharing and soft-thresholded frequency modes.
427fe0e6e2e2d6f927c62e80c75706e02c2a747f.data: Computer vision benchmarks such as few-shot segmentation and Cityscapes segmentation.
427fe0e6e2e2d6f927c62e80c75706e02c2a747f.result: Quasi-linear complexity and linear memory; outperforms other efficient attention mechanisms, handling sequences of 65k tokens.
427fe0e6e2e2d6f927c62e80c75706e02c2a747f.open_work: Applications to scientific data; AFNO became the backbone of FourCastNet for global weather forecasting.
427fe0e6e2e2d6f927c62e80c75706e02c2a747f.issues: Evaluated only on vision tasks here; FFT-based mixing assumes periodic, regular grids, which is awkward for the sphere.

9d5898bd57e3ea50c08444e68ffa6dc00ad6ebb5.goal: Transfers a deep learning radar nowcasting model trained in one region to another with different precipitation characteristics and little data.
9d5898bd57e3ea50c08444e68ffa6dc00ad6ebb5.architecture: CNN-based convective nowcasting model, transferred by fine-tuning and by maximum mean discrepancy (MMD) domain adaptation.
9d5898bd57e3ea50c08444e68ffa6dc00ad6ebb5.data: Radar data near Beijing (source) and Guangzhou (target), with varying amounts of target samples.
9d5898bd57e3ea50c08444e68ffa6dc00ad6ebb5.result: Transfer learning models improve nowcasting skill in the target region; the effect of target sample size is quantified.
9d5898bd57e3ea50c08444e68ffa6dc00ad6ebb5.open_work: Extend to more regions and model architectures.
9d5898bd57e3ea50c08444e68ffa6dc00ad6ebb5.issues: Two-region study; quantitative gains not reported in the abstract.

8695a3e5f6deb61a93237f51bca1083122335d47.goal: Reviews how machine learning can advance physical oceanography across observations, theory and numerical modelling.
8695a3e5f6deb61a93237f51bca1083122335d47.architecture: Review of ML tools (supervised, unsupervised, interpretable ML) applied to in situ and satellite observations, theoretical discovery, parameterizations, model bias correction and data assimilation.
8695a3e5f6deb61a93237f51bca1083122335d47.result: Identifies ocean-specific challenges (sparse, surface-limited observations, wide range of timescales, coastlines) and areas of imminent potential.
8695a3e5f6deb61a93237f51bca1083122335d47.open_work: Advance ML parameterizations, ML-aided data assimilation and interpretable ML for discovery.
8695a3e5f6deb61a93237f51bca1083122335d47.issues: Review; risks of ML in oceanography are noted but not quantified.

c8fc3da2d6a0a7f05e716fa3c06fc7c813c9c049.goal: Asks whether deep learning could fully replace numerical weather models and data assimilation.
c8fc3da2d6a0a7f05e716fa3c06fc7c813c9c049.architecture: Review and discussion of deep learning concepts and their fit to weather data properties. Not a new model.
c8fc3da2d6a0a7f05e716fa3c06fc7c813c9c049.result: Concludes that replacing NWP is not inconceivable but requires fundamental breakthroughs.
c8fc3da2d6a0a7f05e716fa3c06fc7c813c9c049.open_work: Physical constraints, uncertainty quantification, handling of extremes and end-to-end DL from observations.
c8fc3da2d6a0a7f05e716fa3c06fc7c813c9c049.issues: Pre-2022 perspective; ML global models have since matched or beaten NWP on many metrics, though still relying on reanalysis-based training.

bee988a9083c45a41a8881273ac95b43cfd45228.goal: Maps the global distribution of abnormal mesoscale eddies (warm cyclonic, cold anticyclonic) by combining SSH and SST observations.
bee988a9083c45a41a8881273ac95b43cfd45228.architecture: Deep learning framework fusing satellite SSH and SST to detect and classify eddies; architecture details not given in the abstract.
bee988a9083c45a41a8881273ac95b43cfd45228.data: Global satellite SSH and SST data, 1996-2015.
bee988a9083c45a41a8881273ac95b43cfd45228.result: Abnormal eddies are about one third of all eddies, active along equatorial and unstable currents; seasonal contrasts by hemisphere; daily counts of normal (abnormal) eddies change by +9.68 (-11.80) per year.
bee988a9083c45a41a8881273ac95b43cfd45228.open_work: Investigate mechanisms behind abnormal eddies and their trends, including subsurface structure.
bee988a9083c45a41a8881273ac95b43cfd45228.issues: Depends on detection accuracy and SST signal quality; trends may be affected by changing satellite sampling.

311eada7ff03bf449e316bd7944929be3726fb32.goal: Makes ML parameterizations generalize across climate regimes they were not trained on.
311eada7ff03bf449e316bd7944929be3726fb32.architecture: Climate-invariant ML: physically motivated rescaling of inputs (e.g., specific humidity to relative humidity, temperature to buoyancy-based variables, scaled surface fluxes) and outputs so that mappings are similar across climates; applied to neural networks.
311eada7ff03bf449e316bd7944929be3726fb32.data: Three atmospheric models (including SPCAM and SAM-based configurations) under cold and warm climates and different configurations.
311eada7ff03bf449e316bd7944929be3726fb32.result: Maintains high offline accuracy across a wide range of climates and configurations, improving generalization and data efficiency over raw-variable models.
311eada7ff03bf449e316bd7944929be3726fb32.open_work: Test online coupled stability and generalization; find invariant transformations for more processes.
311eada7ff03bf449e316bd7944929be3726fb32.issues: Results are mainly offline; transformations are hand-crafted.

d18cac470cf564c5be41e56c9dea4fb8a866d95e.goal: Learns the propagator of a dynamical system from partial, noisy observations cheaply.
d18cac470cf564c5be41e56c9dea4fb8a866d95e.architecture: RAFDA: random feature map network trained sequentially within an ensemble Kalman filter data assimilation procedure, using delay coordinates via Takens embedding.
d18cac470cf564c5be41e56c9dea4fb8a866d95e.data: Low-dimensional chaotic test systems (e.g., Lorenz-63) with partial noisy observations.
d18cac470cf564c5be41e56c9dea4fb8a866d95e.result: RAFDA outperforms standard random feature maps trained on batch data in forecasting.
d18cac470cf564c5be41e56c9dea4fb8a866d95e.issues: Toy problems only; random feature models may need many features in high dimensions.

e1154e0cdddc3bbc5f04f5597fc5d8bfbb838300.goal: Improves ensemble precipitation forecasts through CNN-based statistical postprocessing (inferred from title).
e1154e0cdddc3bbc5f04f5597fc5d8bfbb838300.architecture: Convolutional neural network postprocessing of ensemble precipitation forecasts; details not available.
e1154e0cdddc3bbc5f04f5597fc5d8bfbb838300.data: Not reported (abstract unavailable); likely ensemble NWP precipitation forecasts and gridded observations.
e1154e0cdddc3bbc5f04f5597fc5d8bfbb838300.open_work: Not reported; natural extensions are probabilistic calibration and hydrological applications.
e1154e0cdddc3bbc5f04f5597fc5d8bfbb838300.issues: Cannot be assessed without the abstract; details should be checked in the paper.

fe53c733d893dda692cbf0332243b98f423d2c21.goal: Integrates data assimilation and machine learning into a combined framework, termed Data Learning (inferred from title).
fe53c733d893dda692cbf0332243b98f423d2c21.architecture: Combination of DA and ML methods; specific architecture not available.
fe53c733d893dda692cbf0332243b98f423d2c21.issues: Cannot be assessed without the abstract; details should be checked in the paper.

5ac2a3380bee09394f1bd35195bd7358ad9aec7d.goal: Discovers cloud regimes in satellite imagery without predefined classes, to support understanding of cloud feedbacks.
5ac2a3380bee09394f1bd35195bd7358ad9aec7d.architecture: Rotation-invariant cloud clustering (RICC): convolutional autoencoder with a rotation-invariant loss, followed by clustering in latent space.
5ac2a3380bee09394f1bd35195bd7358ad9aec7d.result: Clusters are physically reasonable, capture texture and spatial information, are cohesive and separable in latent space, and are insensitive to image orientation.
5ac2a3380bee09394f1bd35195bd7358ad9aec7d.open_work: Use clusters to study cloud dynamics, trends and feedbacks in climate contexts.
5ac2a3380bee09394f1bd35195bd7358ad9aec7d.issues: Unsupervised clusters are hard to validate objectively; evaluation relies on designed protocols rather than ground truth.

0f6ed076182282950002d3090e08107fb3eb25c1.goal: Downscales daily precipitation and temperature to local scale for impact assessment.
0f6ed076182282950002d3090e08107fb3eb25c1.architecture: Super Resolution Deep Residual Network (SRDRN): deep CNN with residual blocks and batch normalization, plus data augmentation for imbalanced and extreme precipitation.
0f6ed076182282950002d3090e08107fb3eb25c1.data: Synthetic experiments coarsening 4 km gridded data to 25, 50 and 100 km and downscaling back to 4 km; transfer to a second region.
0f6ed076182282950002d3090e08107fb3eb25c1.result: Captures spatial and temporal patterns and local extremes of precipitation and temperature; transfer learning to another region beats classic statistical downscaling.
0f6ed076182282950002d3090e08107fb3eb25c1.open_work: Apply to real GCM output and other Earth system variables.
0f6ed076182282950002d3090e08107fb3eb25c1.issues: Synthetic coarsening setup avoids GCM biases and representativeness mismatch; deterministic outputs give no uncertainty.

a0409889d3bd231f89def78ebf6b49d1b9990dda.goal: Surveys deep learning-based weather prediction (DLWP) as a supplement to numerical weather prediction, which faces gaps in physical understanding, observation use and computing cost.
a0409889d3bd231f89def78ebf6b49d1b9990dda.architecture: Literature review organized by neural network architecture, spatial and temporal scales, and datasets and benchmarks; compares DLWP with conventional NWP.
a0409889d3bd231f89def78ebf6b49d1b9990dda.data: No new data; covers published studies and the datasets and benchmarks they use.
a0409889d3bd231f89def78ebf6b49d1b9990dda.result: Summarizes the state of DLWP as of 2021, describing preliminary but promising results, and lists advantages and disadvantages relative to NWP.
a0409889d3bd231f89def78ebf6b49d1b9990dda.open_work: The authors list future research topics for DLWP; the review predates the 2022-2023 global ML forecast models.
a0409889d3bd231f89def78ebf6b49d1b9990dda.issues: Predates GraphCast, Pangu-Weather and similar models, so its picture of the state of the art is now outdated; the abstract gives no quantitative synthesis.

7ee91c24d75f47664f5555ec24d8ee97fbd213e9.goal: Improves subseasonal MJO prediction, which falls short of its potential predictability partly because of systematic errors in dynamical models.
7ee91c24d75f47664f5555ec24d8ee97fbd213e9.architecture: Deep learning bias correction that blends dynamical forecasts with observations to correct forecast MJO amplitude and phase (RMM-based indices) over lead times up to four weeks.
7ee91c24d75f47664f5555ec24d8ee97fbd213e9.data: Multi-model operational subseasonal reforecasts (S2S project models) and observed MJO indices.
7ee91c24d75f47664f5555ec24d8ee97fbd213e9.result: Over four weeks, the correction reduces multi-model errors in MJO amplitude by about 90% and in phase by about 77%. The largest gains are for events starting in the Indian Ocean and crossing the Maritime Continent.
7ee91c24d75f47664f5555ec24d8ee97fbd213e9.open_work: Extend the correction to real-time operational forecasts and to full fields rather than indices, and test how it affects downstream teleconnection skill.
7ee91c24d75f47664f5555ec24d8ee97fbd213e9.issues: Corrects the index rather than the model physics. Reforecast samples are limited, so overfitting is a risk, and the gains depend on stationary model bias.

5d46dde2b4ca13968d3c0d5b4226856cafc083dc.goal: Frames Earth surface forecasting as guided video prediction: predicting future satellite imagery conditioned on future weather, to capture localized impacts of extreme weather.
5d46dde2b4ca13968d3c0d5b4226856cafc083dc.architecture: Dataset and challenge for model intercomparison rather than a single model. Baselines include persistence and video prediction networks.
5d46dde2b4ca13968d3c0d5b4226856cafc083dc.data: Sentinel-2 imagery at 20 m, matched topography and mesoscale (1.28 km) E-OBS-style meteorological variables over Europe, packaged into about 32,000 samples.
5d46dde2b4ca13968d3c0d5b4226856cafc083dc.result: Releases a large ML-ready dataset with evaluation tracks (including out-of-distribution and seasonal tests), aiming at more than 50x finer resolution than numerical models.
5d46dde2b4ca13968d3c0d5b4226856cafc083dc.open_work: Develop models that exploit the weather conditioning, and link the forecasts to impacts such as crop yield, forest health and biodiversity.
5d46dde2b4ca13968d3c0d5b4226856cafc083dc.issues: Cloud contamination and gaps in optical imagery. The meteorological guidance comes from observations or reanalysis rather than real forecasts, so operational skill is untested.

c63f41d8863a58c27f29def2bbde355afe93c8c0.goal: Improves deep convection trigger functions in GCM convection schemes, whose deficiencies degrade climate simulations, for example the diurnal cycle of precipitation.
c63f41d8863a58c27f29def2bbde355afe93c8c0.architecture: XGBoost gradient-boosted tree classifier that predicts whether convection occurs from large-scale environmental variables. It is trained per site and jointly, and interpreted to extract physical insight.
c63f41d8863a58c27f29def2bbde355afe93c8c0.data: Long-term ARM constrained variational analysis forcing data at the Southern Great Plains (continental midlatitude) and Manaus (tropical) sites.
c63f41d8863a58c27f29def2bbde355afe93c8c0.result: F1 scores are 91% at SGP and 93% at MAO; the unified trigger reaches 91% with almost no degradation. It clearly outperforms dilute and undilute CAPE and dCAPE triggers and reduces overprediction of convection occurrence.
c63f41d8863a58c27f29def2bbde355afe93c8c0.open_work: Implement the ML trigger online in a GCM, test a global trigger, and use the insights to improve CAPE-based triggers.
c63f41d8863a58c27f29def2bbde355afe93c8c0.issues: Trained on only two sites, so global generalization is unproven. The evaluation is offline (single column), not coupled climate simulation.

12e6a9cc614fd5a2f90595126cc7b18864b6e00f.goal: Improves convective storm nowcasting beyond reflectivity extrapolation by adding polarimetric radar information on microphysics and dynamics.
12e6a9cc614fd5a2f90595126cc7b18864b6e00f.architecture: FURENet, a U-Net-style deep network with separate encoders for multiple input variables (reflectivity, KDP, ZDR) that are fused to predict future reflectivity.
12e6a9cc614fd5a2f90595126cc7b18864b6e00f.data: Polarimetric weather radar observations of convective storms in China (details not reported in the abstract).
12e6a9cc614fd5a2f90595126cc7b18864b6e00f.result: Using KDP and ZDR improves CSI by 13.2% at 30 min and 17.4% at 60 min lead time. Case studies show better forecasts of convective organization and initiation.
12e6a9cc614fd5a2f90595126cc7b18864b6e00f.open_work: Extend to longer lead times and other regions, and add other observations such as satellite or NWP fields.
12e6a9cc614fd5a2f90595126cc7b18864b6e00f.issues: Deterministic output, likely blurred at longer leads. Evaluation is limited to one region and short leads, and the case studies are few.

22c5691a06527e7551c0849648b0f3b690f8b4db.goal: Reduces the cost of data assimilation in the big-data era by performing assimilation in a low-dimensional learned latent space.
22c5691a06527e7551c0849648b0f3b690f8b4db.architecture: An autoencoder provides the latent space. An ensemble transform Kalman filter with model error (ETKF-Q) runs in that space, and a surrogate neural network propagates latent dynamics (ETKF-Q-L).
22c5691a06527e7551c0849648b0f3b690f8b4db.data: Synthetic experiments with an augmented Lorenz 96 system that has a known latent structure.
22c5691a06527e7551c0849648b0f3b690f8b4db.result: ETKF-Q-L lowers computational cost and gives better accuracy than the standard ETKF-Q on the test system.
22c5691a06527e7551c0849648b0f3b690f8b4db.open_work: Test on higher-dimensional, realistic geophysical models and on systems without a clean latent structure.
22c5691a06527e7551c0849648b0f3b690f8b4db.issues: The toy system is designed to have a latent structure, which favours the method; transfer to real NWP is undemonstrated.

4a84b3b67d37ccd4b7284bb6d1a0465baae2ed01.goal: Asks whether Earth system models should be learned from observations with ML or with data assimilation, and how the two fields can be unified.
4a84b3b67d37ccd4b7284bb6d1a0465baae2ed01.architecture: Conceptual paper that maps DA and ML onto a common Bayesian network framework, for example showing that 4D-Var is equivalent to a recurrent neural network. Not a new model.
4a84b3b67d37ccd4b7284bb6d1a0465baae2ed01.data: No new data; discussion grounded in operational DA practice (ECMWF) with real, sparse and indirect observations.
4a84b3b67d37ccd4b7284bb6d1a0465baae2ed01.result: Argues that DA treats uncertainty and prior physical knowledge more rigorously, while ML offers flexible learnable components. Bayesian networks give a practical framework to unify them.
4a84b3b67d37ccd4b7284bb6d1a0465baae2ed01.open_work: Build hybrid systems where DA learns model parameters or embedded ML components directly from observations.
4a84b3b67d37ccd4b7284bb6d1a0465baae2ed01.issues: Perspective without quantitative demonstration. Full Bayesian solutions are computationally infeasible, so approximations are needed.

de522d57115146da09995938c504418af2f2f2a4.goal: Improves probabilistic wind gust forecasts, which are important for severe weather warnings but rarely studied in ensemble postprocessing.
de522d57115146da09995938c504418af2f2f2a4.architecture: Compares eight methods: EMOS, member-by-member, isotonic distributional regression, gradient-boosted EMOS, quantile regression forests, and neural nets (distributional regression network, Bernstein quantile network, histogram estimation network).
de522d57115146da09995938c504418af2f2f2a4.data: Six years of COSMO-DE convection-permitting ensemble forecasts from the German Weather Service, plus hourly observations at 175 German surface stations.
de522d57115146da09995938c504418af2f2f2a4.result: All methods calibrate the raw ensemble. Additional predictors give significant gains, and locally adaptive neural networks perform best while learning physically consistent diurnal-cycle relations.
de522d57115146da09995938c504418af2f2f2a4.open_work: Extend to spatially and temporally coherent multivariate postprocessing, and to forecasts of extreme gusts and warnings.
de522d57115146da09995938c504418af2f2f2a4.issues: Point forecasts at stations only. Results are for one ensemble system and region, and rare extreme gusts are few in the sample.

b62544d43edd402c23127b9e8c28d0f5b6b33db2.goal: Accelerates fluid simulations without losing accuracy by embedding ML inside traditional numerical solvers rather than replacing them.
b62544d43edd402c23127b9e8c28d0f5b6b33db2.architecture: End-to-end trained, differentiable CFD solver (JAX) with learned interpolation and learned correction components inside a finite-volume scheme.
b62544d43edd402c23127b9e8c28d0f5b6b33db2.data: Two-dimensional turbulent flows (for example forced Kolmogorov flow) from high-resolution direct numerical simulation and large-eddy simulation.
b62544d43edd402c23127b9e8c28d0f5b6b33db2.result: Matches baseline solvers at 8 to 10x finer resolution in each dimension, giving 40 to 80x speedups. Stays stable over long runs and generalizes to new forcings and Reynolds numbers.
b62544d43edd402c23127b9e8c28d0f5b6b33db2.open_work: Extend to 3D flows, more complex geometries, and atmospheric or climate models.
b62544d43edd402c23127b9e8c28d0f5b6b33db2.issues: Demonstrated only on 2D idealized turbulence. Requires differentiable solvers and gains may shrink for 3D or multi-physics flows.

0b1ad90fecf83d0b2354e4d91dcee20a0c9ddc6d.goal: Enables objective evaluation of explainable AI (XAI) attribution methods for geoscience, where ground-truth attributions are usually unknown.
0b1ad90fecf83d0b2354e4d91dcee20a0c9ddc6d.architecture: Framework that builds synthetic regression benchmarks from additively separable functions, giving a known ground-truth attribution. A fully connected network is trained, and XAI heatmaps (gradient-based, LRP variants and others) are compared with the ground truth.
0b1ad90fecf83d0b2354e4d91dcee20a0c9ddc6d.data: Synthetic dataset with climate-like spatial inputs (for example SST-like anomaly fields) and outputs generated from known functions.
0b1ad90fecf83d0b2354e4d91dcee20a0c9ddc6d.result: Shows where specific XAI methods perform well or poorly against the known attribution, which makes XAI assessment less subjective.
0b1ad90fecf83d0b2354e4d91dcee20a0c9ddc6d.open_work: Extend benchmarks to non-additive functions, classification tasks and more complex architectures such as CNNs.
0b1ad90fecf83d0b2354e4d91dcee20a0c9ddc6d.issues: Additive separability is a simplifying assumption, and real geophysical relations are often non-additive and interacting.

0a507887c9002caa67f1e8b48e7002486dea8c30.goal: Quantifies how much Arctic sea ice variability causally affects midlatitude winter climate, separating cause from effect.
0a507887c9002caa67f1e8b48e7002486dea8c30.architecture: Non-ML study: regression analysis applied to observations and to large initial-condition ensembles of multiple climate models, in coupled and AMIP (prescribed sea ice/SST) configurations.
0a507887c9002caa67f1e8b48e7002486dea8c30.data: Observations and reanalysis plus large ensembles from several climate models, coupled and AMIP-style.
0a507887c9002caa67f1e8b48e7002486dea8c30.result: Coupled models reproduce the observed sea ice and temperature links, but these are absent or much weaker in AMIP runs forced only by sea ice. Statistical links are inflated by circulation driving sea ice, so the causal effect is much weaker.
0a507887c9002caa67f1e8b48e7002486dea8c30.open_work: Clarify whether models underestimate the true response, and refine estimates of the stratospheric pathway.
0a507887c9002caa67f1e8b48e7002486dea8c30.issues: Relies on models simulating the coupling correctly. Members span only 35 years, and internal variability makes individual estimates noisy.

417f4aed101b24b735c527be928f85b45087c968.goal: Tests whether CNN-based perfect-prognosis downscaling can be trusted for future climate projections, given its black-box nature and possible extrapolation artifacts.
417f4aed101b24b735c527be928f85b45087c968.architecture: Deep CNNs for downscaling temperature and precipitation over Europe, compared with generalized linear models. The authors examine whether the downscaled climate change signal preserves the raw GCM delta.
417f4aed101b24b735c527be928f85b45087c968.data: Reanalysis predictors (ERA-Interim) and gridded observations (E-OBS) over Europe for training; GCM historical and future scenario output for application.
417f4aed101b24b735c527be928f85b45087c968.result: Compared with GLMs, CNNs depart less from the raw GCM climate change signal at the end of the century and give more spatially homogeneous patterns, so projections are more plausible.
417f4aed101b24b735c527be928f85b45087c968.open_work: Test the other perfect prognosis assumption (GCM reproduction of predictors), and use more GCMs and scenarios.
417f4aed101b24b735c527be928f85b45087c968.issues: Plausibility judged by consistency with the GCM signal rather than a ground truth. A limited set of GCMs is used, and extrapolation remains unverifiable.

aff4cce1ca00e61060f35b6a414b23a98c6eaf48.goal: Introduces a theme issue on ML for weather and climate modelling and outlines motivations, opportunities and challenges arising from a 2019 Oxford workshop.
aff4cce1ca00e61060f35b6a414b23a98c6eaf48.architecture: Perspective and editorial. It categorizes ML uses as 'hard', 'medium' and 'soft' AI, according to how deeply ML replaces or augments physics-based components.
aff4cce1ca00e61060f35b6a414b23a98c6eaf48.result: Provides a framing of opportunities (emulation, parametrization, postprocessing, data assimilation) and challenges for ML in weather and climate prediction.
aff4cce1ca00e61060f35b6a414b23a98c6eaf48.open_work: Points to the articles in the theme issue and to community efforts on benchmarks, trust and hybrid modelling.
aff4cce1ca00e61060f35b6a414b23a98c6eaf48.issues: Short introductory piece without new results; the abstract gives few specifics.

656912df970aa5f1701e6bd0103052c2d20fb5c5.goal: Improves tropical cyclone intensity and wind-radii estimation from satellite infrared imagery by adding physical knowledge to deep learning.
656912df970aa5f1701e6bd0103052c2d20fb5c5.architecture: DeepTCNet, a CNN augmented with auxiliary physical information (TC fullness) for single-task learning and with auxiliary tasks (intensity and wind radii) for multi-task learning.
656912df970aa5f1701e6bd0103052c2d20fb5c5.data: Infrared satellite imagery of North Atlantic tropical cyclones with best-track intensity and wind-radii labels.
656912df970aa5f1701e6bd0103052c2d20fb5c5.result: Fullness augmentation improves intensity estimation by 12%, and multi-task learning improves wind radii by 6-9%. Intensity skill is 39% better than ADT on average and similar to SATCON; wind radii are 32% better than MTCSWA.
656912df970aa5f1701e6bd0103052c2d20fb5c5.open_work: Extend to other basins and add microwave imagery and other inputs.
656912df970aa5f1701e6bd0103052c2d20fb5c5.issues: North Atlantic only. Labels come from best-track data with their own uncertainty, and fullness information may not be available in real time.

53c9f3c34d8481adaf24df3b25581ccf1bc53f5c.goal: Reviews how physical laws and domain knowledge can be built into machine learning to give data-efficient, generalizable models of physical systems.
53c9f3c34d8481adaf24df3b25581ccf1bc53f5c.architecture: Review of physics-informed ML: observational, inductive and learning biases; physics-informed neural networks (PINNs); operator learning (for example DeepONet); and related software.
53c9f3c34d8481adaf24df3b25581ccf1bc53f5c.data: No new data; draws on applications across fluid dynamics, materials, biophysics and other fields.
53c9f3c34d8481adaf24df3b25581ccf1bc53f5c.result: Argues that adding physics through data, architecture or loss constraints improves accuracy, generalization and handling of noisy or incomplete data and of inverse problems.
53c9f3c34d8481adaf24df3b25581ccf1bc53f5c.open_work: Identifies challenges in scalability, training of PINNs for multiscale and high-dimensional problems, uncertainty quantification and theory.
53c9f3c34d8481adaf24df3b25581ccf1bc53f5c.issues: General physics review, not specific to atmosphere or ocean. Abstract unavailable, so the summary relies on knowledge of the paper.

86c03f6a3ae8d04d6451197a230b34d2551218a7.goal: Addresses off-the-shelf ML models that violate physical laws and generalize poorly, by surveying ways to incorporate physics into ML for weather and climate.
86c03f6a3ae8d04d6451197a230b34d2551218a7.architecture: Survey that groups physics-informed ML approaches into broad categories (for example physics-based losses, architectural constraints and hybrid modelling), illustrated with 10 case studies.
86c03f6a3ae8d04d6451197a230b34d2551218a7.data: Varies by case study: emulation, downscaling and forecasting tasks using simulation and observational data.
86c03f6a3ae8d04d6451197a230b34d2551218a7.result: Physics-informed approaches improve physical consistency, reduce training time, improve data efficiency and generalize better.
86c03f6a3ae8d04d6451197a230b34d2551218a7.open_work: Identifies scientific, diagnostic, computational and resource challenges for robust, reliable physics-informed ML.
86c03f6a3ae8d04d6451197a230b34d2551218a7.issues: Case studies are mostly the authors' own and differ widely in setting, so their benefits are not directly comparable.

2086a93116d8e9af99d8311e80d1eaec3970333c.goal: Provides a benchmark dataset for data-driven global precipitation forecasting, aimed at extreme precipitation in the developing world.
2086a93116d8e9af99d8311e80d1eaec3970333c.architecture: Multimodal benchmark dataset plus PyRain, a data-processing library, with baseline neural network models for medium-range precipitation forecasting.
2086a93116d8e9af99d8311e80d1eaec3970333c.data: Simulated satellite data (SimSat), selected ERA5 reanalysis variables and IMERG precipitation.
2086a93116d8e9af99d8311e80d1eaec3970333c.result: Releases the dataset and library and reports baseline results for two medium-range forecasting tasks; the abstract does not give quantitative skill.
2086a93116d8e9af99d8311e80d1eaec3970333c.open_work: Use real satellite observations and probabilistic models, and improve skill for extremes.
2086a93116d8e9af99d8311e80d1eaec3970333c.issues: Uses simulated rather than real satellite imagery. Baselines are coarse, and skill relative to NWP is not established in the abstract.

f99de990f791799df398fcd38034c4b395d9b7e0.goal: Improves precipitation nowcasting (up to two hours) by avoiding the blurring of deterministic deep learning and the limits of advection methods for nonlinear events.
f99de990f791799df398fcd38034c4b395d9b7e0.architecture: Deep Generative Model of Rainfall (DGMR): a conditional GAN with spatial and temporal discriminators that produces ensembles of radar precipitation fields.
f99de990f791799df398fcd38034c4b395d9b7e0.data: UK radar composite (roughly 2016-2019) for training and evaluation, with additional tests on US radar.
f99de990f791799df398fcd38034c4b395d9b7e0.result: Gives realistic, skillful probabilistic nowcasts at 5-90 min leads over regions up to 1536 x 1280 km. In an evaluation by more than 50 Met Office meteorologists, it ranked first in 89% of cases.
f99de990f791799df398fcd38034c4b395d9b7e0.open_work: Extend lead times, improve heavy-rain skill further and integrate with NWP for longer horizons.
f99de990f791799df398fcd38034c4b395d9b7e0.issues: CSI gains over baselines are modest for some thresholds. Skill drops at long leads, and GAN ensembles may be under-dispersed or poorly calibrated in some regimes.
