b130e4f60b4a061c0ed1fa5066c9f34807cd381d.architecture: Review of ML and deep learning predictions, causal discovery, explainable AI, and hybrid AI-climate model approaches.
b130e4f60b4a061c0ed1fa5066c9f34807cd381d.data: Not applicable; based on published studies.
b130e4f60b4a061c0ed1fa5066c9f34807cd381d.result: AI shows potential for predicting extremes and linking them to drivers; hybrid approaches improve skill; best practices are proposed.
b130e4f60b4a061c0ed1fa5066c9f34807cd381d.open_work: Data curation, uncertainty, generalizability, and reproducibility of methods and workflows.
b130e4f60b4a061c0ed1fa5066c9f34807cd381d.issues: Review-level; extremes are rare, so sample sizes are small in many reviewed studies.

b8b45b166cfa905f9bdcc4dd032ae37e1ee08bbd.goal: Tests whether AI weather models can forecast extreme tropical cyclones stronger than anything in their training data (gray swans).
b8b45b166cfa905f9bdcc4dd032ae37e1ee08bbd.architecture: AI weather model (FourCastNet-type) retrained with Category 3-5 tropical cyclones removed from the training set.
b8b45b166cfa905f9bdcc4dd032ae37e1ee08bbd.data: ERA5 reanalysis with strong cyclones removed for training; tested on Category 5 storms.
b8b45b166cfa905f9bdcc4dd032ae37e1ee08bbd.result: The model cannot accurately forecast unseen Category 5 cyclones, but it can learn strong storms in one basin and forecast them in another.
b8b45b166cfa905f9bdcc4dd032ae37e1ee08bbd.open_work: Methods to improve extrapolation to rare extremes, such as physics constraints or synthetic data.
b8b45b166cfa905f9bdcc4dd032ae37e1ee08bbd.issues: One model architecture; coarse reanalysis underestimates TC intensity anyway.

5a7b77e68b50d2b830ad4fd73c1dbdc3cc6ea10b.goal: Avoids the computational cost and error accumulation of autoregressive diffusion ensembles at fine temporal resolution.
5a7b77e68b50d2b830ad4fd73c1dbdc3cc6ea10b.architecture: Continuous Ensemble Forecasting: diffusion model conditioned on lead time that samples temporally consistent trajectories in parallel, optionally combined with autoregressive rollouts.
5a7b77e68b50d2b830ad4fd73c1dbdc3cc6ea10b.data: ERA5 global reanalysis; the resolution is not reported in the abstract.
5a7b77e68b50d2b830ad4fd73c1dbdc3cc6ea10b.result: Competitive global forecasting with good probabilistic properties and arbitrary fine temporal resolution without loss of accuracy.
5a7b77e68b50d2b830ad4fd73c1dbdc3cc6ea10b.open_work: Scaling to higher resolution and operational settings.
5a7b77e68b50d2b830ad4fd73c1dbdc3cc6ea10b.issues: Evaluation details not given in the abstract; likely coarse resolution.

f12110407568e11614a4bec8a9d4a303c2c72458.goal: Removes ML forecasts' dependence on reanalyses and physics-based data assimilation by learning directly from observations.
f12110407568e11614a4bec8a9d4a303c2c72458.architecture: Neural network that ingests raw observations and forecasts future observations at arbitrary locations, working entirely in observation space.
f12110407568e11614a4bec8a9d4a303c2c72458.data: Raw historical observations, e.g., SYNOP surface data and satellite observations; no reanalysis used.
f12110407568e11614a4bec8a9d4a303c2c72458.result: Preliminary 12-hour forecasts show the network learns time evolution of physical processes in real observations.
f12110407568e11614a4bec8a9d4a303c2c72458.open_work: Longer lead times, more observation types, and extension to the full Earth system.
f12110407568e11614a4bec8a9d4a303c2c72458.issues: Preliminary; short lead times only; observation coverage gaps; no comparison with operational NWP reported.

4bde0db61de2bd22a788b31e736aa86d24febd0e.goal: Surveys how deep learning is used for spatiotemporal forecasting across Earth system science domains and what challenges remain.
4bde0db61de2bd22a788b31e736aa86d24febd0e.architecture: Literature review of 69 studies covering common DL architectures (CNNs, RNN/LSTMs, transformers, graph networks, hybrids), technical innovations and applications.
4bde0db61de2bd22a788b31e736aa86d24febd0e.data: Published studies spanning climate and weather prediction, disasters, air quality, hydrology, renewable energy, oceanography and environmental monitoring.
4bde0db61de2bd22a788b31e736aa86d24febd0e.result: DL handles spatiotemporal data well, with growing efforts to integrate physics, improve explainability, adapt architectures to domains and quantify uncertainty.
4bde0db61de2bd22a788b31e736aa86d24febd0e.open_work: Calls for interpretable hybrid DL-physics models, better generalization via domain adaptation and transfer learning, and advances in uncertainty quantification and missing-data handling.
4bde0db61de2bd22a788b31e736aa86d24febd0e.issues: Broad multi-domain scope with a modest sample of 69 studies, so coverage of atmospheric and ocean ML (e.g. recent global weather models) is necessarily shallow.

244d8dc93c0af56a4f9db9b474d5b3ed1793a995.goal: Produces global atmospheric initial conditions by data assimilation with a machine learning model, replacing costly variational/ensemble DA.
244d8dc93c0af56a4f9db9b474d5b3ed1793a995.architecture: Denoising diffusion model whose backbone is the pretrained GraphCast graph neural network; sparse observations and a forecast background guide the sampling.
244d8dc93c0af56a4f9db9b474d5b3ed1793a995.data: ERA5 reanalysis at 0.25°, with simulated sparse observations drawn from ERA5 (under 0.96% of grid points) and GraphCast 48-hour forecasts as background.
244d8dc93c0af56a4f9db9b474d5b3ed1793a995.result: Generates assimilated global states consistent with observations at 0.25°, the highest resolution for ML DA at the time; forecasts from these analyses lose at most 24 h of lead time versus ERA5 initial conditions.
244d8dc93c0af56a4f9db9b474d5b3ed1793a995.open_work: Applying the method to real, heterogeneous observations (satellite radiances, in situ) and to autoregressive DA cycling for building reanalyses.
244d8dc93c0af56a4f9db9b474d5b3ed1793a995.issues: Observations are simulated from ERA5 rather than real instrument data, so observation operators, errors and biases are idealized; skill still trails operational DA.

a9421144966e1c9e70f28e28092e03e70ad97717.goal: Reduces the cost of regional downscaling of large climate projection ensembles while keeping the skill of physics-based regional models, to better sample regional uncertainty.
a9421144966e1c9e70f28e28092e03e70ad97717.architecture: Two-stage hybrid: a regional climate model (WRF) downscales GCM output to an intermediate resolution, then a conditional diffusion model generates the final high-resolution fields.
a9421144966e1c9e70f28e28092e03e70ad97717.data: CMIP6 GCM projections downscaled with WRF over the western United States; the diffusion model is trained on high-resolution WRF simulations.
a9421144966e1c9e70f28e28092e03e70ad97717.result: The hybrid matches or approaches full dynamical downscaling skill, captures extremes and compound events better than statistical baselines, and cuts cost substantially, enabling downscaling of multi-model ensembles.
a9421144966e1c9e70f28e28092e03e70ad97717.open_work: Extending to more regions, variables and GCMs and using the larger ensembles for impact-oriented risk assessment.
a9421144966e1c9e70f28e28092e03e70ad97717.issues: Still requires a coarse RCM run for every GCM member; trained on a single RCM, so inherits WRF biases; generalization to unseen climates depends on the physics-based intermediate stage.

69dd86c29164206434e916546d4ed7b2d9749a7d.goal: Reviews machine learning for regional climate downscaling, motivated by the cost of dynamical downscaling and doubts about empirical methods in future climates.
69dd86c29164206434e916546d4ed7b2d9749a7d.architecture: Review of ML downscaling approaches (perfect prognosis and RCM emulators), training strategies, and a proposed evaluation framework specific to ML downscaling.
69dd86c29164206434e916546d4ed7b2d9749a7d.data: Published downscaling studies using GCM, RCM and observational datasets; no new model is trained.
69dd86c29164206434e916546d4ed7b2d9749a7d.result: Synthesizes how ML can emulate dynamical models or learn perfect-prognosis relationships, identifies training strategies that mitigate extrapolation issues, and proposes a transparent evaluation framework.
69dd86c29164206434e916546d4ed7b2d9749a7d.open_work: Testing out-of-distribution performance in future climates, representation of extremes, and adoption of standardized evaluation protocols.
69dd86c29164206434e916546d4ed7b2d9749a7d.issues: Extrapolation to warmer climates and extreme events remains uncertain and cannot be fully verified with historical observations.

2eacf25564e7835ff71ffa2603c234fd1435a3ee.goal: Builds a data-driven global medium-range forecast model at kilometer-scale resolution beyond the 0.25° limit of reanalysis-trained models.
2eacf25564e7835ff71ffa2603c234fd1435a3ee.architecture: Transformer-based FengWu-family model that inherits knowledge from a pretrained low-resolution (0.25°) model and is adapted to 0.09° resolution.
2eacf25564e7835ff71ffa2603c234fd1435a3ee.data: Low-resolution pretraining on ERA5; high-resolution training on ECMWF operational analysis at about 0.09°. Hindcasts for 2022 and station observations used for evaluation.
2eacf25564e7835ff71ffa2603c234fd1435a3ee.result: Running at 0.09°, FengWu-GHR is reported superior to IFS-HRES in 2022 hindcasts and competitive against station observations and in extreme-event case studies.
2eacf25564e7835ff71ffa2603c234fd1435a3ee.open_work: Operational deployment, coupling with high-resolution data assimilation, and further resolution increases.
2eacf25564e7835ff71ffa2603c234fd1435a3ee.issues: High-resolution training data cover a short period; skill against own-type analysis may favor the model; effective resolution and small-scale realism are not fully demonstrated.

60a9f6431b94943b5272e187ce40861b4a4d0f4b.goal: Develops a deep-learning data assimilation framework that ingests satellite observations to improve analyses and forecasts of ML weather models.
60a9f6431b94943b5272e187ce40861b4a4d0f4b.architecture: Deep learning DA network that fuses a background field from the FuXi forecast model with satellite observations in feature space to produce an analysis increment.
60a9f6431b94943b5272e187ce40861b4a4d0f4b.data: Advanced Geosynchronous Radiation Imager (AGRI) radiances from Fengyun-4B, FuXi background forecasts, and ERA5 as reference.
60a9f6431b94943b5272e187ce40861b4a4d0f4b.result: Assimilating AGRI data consistently reduces analysis errors and significantly improves FuXi forecast performance; analysis increments are consistent with atmospheric physics.
60a9f6431b94943b5272e187ce40861b4a4d0f4b.open_work: Extending to additional observation types (microwave, conventional, polar orbiters) and cycling DA.
60a9f6431b94943b5272e187ce40861b4a4d0f4b.issues: Single geostationary instrument only; evaluated within the FuXi system against reanalysis rather than an operational DA comparison.

4e831b073e7e0fa6312bbc926a9a21dafb72d680.goal: Creates a machine learning ensemble forecast system that does not rely on NWP ensemble members and runs at higher resolution than prior ML ensembles.
4e831b073e7e0fa6312bbc926a9a21dafb72d680.architecture: Variational autoencoder-based model with flow-dependent perturbations, trained with a loss combining CRPS and KL divergence between predicted and target distributions.
4e831b073e7e0fa6312bbc926a9a21dafb72d680.data: ERA5 reanalysis at 0.25°, 5 upper-air variables on 13 pressure levels plus 13 surface variables; compared against ECMWF ensemble forecasts.
4e831b073e7e0fa6312bbc926a9a21dafb72d680.result: FuXi-ENS produces 6-hourly 15-day global ensembles and beats ECMWF ENS in CRPS for 98.1% of 360 variable and lead-time combinations.
4e831b073e7e0fa6312bbc926a9a21dafb72d680.open_work: Further development toward operational use, including better initial-condition perturbations and evaluation for extremes.
4e831b073e7e0fa6312bbc926a9a21dafb72d680.issues: Trained and verified against reanalysis, inheriting its biases; spread-skill and physical realism of individual members need scrutiny; comparisons are sensitive to verification choices.

2154b688bbae54ac2de1da0380e0b2b0d494c3e9.goal: Tests whether score-based generative data assimilation can map sparse weather-station observations to full km-scale atmospheric states.
2154b688bbae54ac2de1da0380e0b2b0d494c3e9.architecture: Unconditional diffusion model trained on analysis snapshots, combined with Score-based Data Assimilation (SDA) to condition on sparse observations at inference without retraining.
2154b688bbae54ac2de1da0380e0b2b0d494c3e9.data: High-Resolution Rapid Refresh (HRRR) analyses over a central US testbed, and surface weather station observations.
2154b688bbae54ac2de1da0380e0b2b0d494c3e9.result: Generated precipitation and wind fields show plausible structures such as gust fronts; assimilating 40 stations gives about 10% lower RMSE at withheld stations than the HRRR baseline.
2154b688bbae54ac2de1da0380e0b2b0d494c3e9.open_work: Combining stronger regional state generators with more in situ, ground-based and satellite data streams, and improving ensemble calibration.
2154b688bbae54ac2de1da0380e0b2b0d494c3e9.issues: Proof of concept with a small station network; ensemble DA estimates are under-dispersive; no time dimension or forecast cycling is shown.

9a90444d4dad86699e6703d3372ce3d88fe584d2.goal: Reduces the cost of large weather forecast ensembles by generating extra members with a generative model.
9a90444d4dad86699e6703d3372ce3d88fe584d2.architecture: SEEDS: a diffusion model conditioned on one or two operational ensemble members that samples many additional realistic members.
9a90444d4dad86699e6703d3372ce3d88fe584d2.data: GEFS reforecasts for emulation, with ERA5 reanalysis used as a target in the bias-correcting variant.
9a90444d4dad86699e6703d3372ce3d88fe584d2.result: Generated ensembles match physics-based ensembles in statistics and skill; the bias-correcting version gives more reliable probabilities and better extreme-event probabilities.
9a90444d4dad86699e6703d3372ce3d88fe584d2.open_work: Extension to higher resolution, more variables and climate projection ensembles for risk assessment.
9a90444d4dad86699e6703d3372ce3d88fe584d2.issues: Operates on a limited set of variables at coarse resolution; generated members depend on the seed members and cannot add information beyond them.

6bb97f553b0106b0a9a4c3cc266dda3afa0e9a5e.goal: Generates high-resolution meteorological data reflecting climate change from coarse GCM output, for energy-system planning (wind, solar, temperature).
6bb97f553b0106b0a9a4c3cc266dda3afa0e9a5e.architecture: Generative adversarial network super-resolution (the Sup3rCC approach), downscaling GCM fields in space and time.
6bb97f553b0106b0a9a4c3cc266dda3afa0e9a5e.data: CMIP6 GCM projections as input; high-resolution historical datasets (e.g. NREL wind and solar resource data) for training, over the contiguous United States.
6bb97f553b0106b0a9a4c3cc266dda3afa0e9a5e.result: Produces kilometer-scale, hourly meteorological data under future climate scenarios at much lower cost than dynamical downscaling. Abstract not available; specifics not verified here.
6bb97f553b0106b0a9a4c3cc266dda3afa0e9a5e.open_work: Broader validation for extremes and additional GCMs/scenarios; use in energy-system planning studies.
6bb97f553b0106b0a9a4c3cc266dda3afa0e9a5e.issues: GAN outputs can hallucinate fine-scale detail; extrapolation to future climates and fidelity of extremes are hard to verify.

185a2e866886584526414598454c32a44ec39775.goal: Shows that machine learning can emulate a km-scale convection-allowing model, a regime where deterministic DL had struggled.
185a2e866886584526414598454c32a44ec39775.architecture: StormCast: a generative diffusion model that autoregressively predicts 99 state variables with a 1-hour step, conditioned on 26 synoptic-scale variables.
185a2e866886584526414598454c32a44ec39775.data: HRRR 3-km operational model output over a central US domain, with coarse ERA5 fields as synoptic conditioning.
185a2e866886584526414598454c32a44ec39775.result: Competitive 1-6 hour forecast skill for composite radar reflectivity and physically realistic convective clusters, moist updrafts and cold pools.
185a2e866886584526414598454c32a44ec39775.open_work: Improving regional km-scale ML prediction, longer rollouts, data assimilation, and use for climate hazard dynamical downscaling.
185a2e866886584526414598454c32a44ec39775.issues: Regional domain with lateral and synoptic conditioning from reanalysis; trained to emulate HRRR, so it inherits HRRR biases; skill limited to short lead times.

9e21401b741cbf6969fe7dafa86d3dd4cff3c702.goal: Reviews machine learning for climate physics and for climate simulation, emphasizing generalizability in the small-data, nonstationary regime.
9e21401b741cbf6969fe7dafa86d3dd4cff3c702.architecture: Review covering supervised learning, unsupervised learning and equation discovery for (a) discovering climate physics and (b) emulating and parameterizing climate simulations.
9e21401b741cbf6969fe7dafa86d3dd4cff3c702.result: Argues physics-free ML works when data are abundant and stationary, but long-term future climate is a small-data regime where physics knowledge and interpretability are crucial.
9e21401b741cbf6969fe7dafa86d3dd4cff3c702.open_work: Closer collaboration across climate physics, ML theory and numerical analysis to build reliable ML climate models.

a92dc27ba04348cdf71682bfa77081d8a478b78f.goal: Reviews how machine learning advances understanding and prediction of the physical climate system.
a92dc27ba04348cdf71682bfa77081d8a478b78f.architecture: Review focused on ML for observational reconstruction, sub-grid-scale parameterization, causal analysis and weather-to-interannual prediction.
a92dc27ba04348cdf71682bfa77081d8a478b78f.result: ML has extended observational records, enabled learned parameterizations toward hybrid models, and improved predictions from weather to ENSO at much lower computational cost.
a92dc27ba04348cdf71682bfa77081d8a478b78f.open_work: Building physically consistent hybrid models and addressing challenges of applying ML to complex, nonstationary systems.
a92dc27ba04348cdf71682bfa77081d8a478b78f.issues: Review; claims of breaking predictability barriers depend on the cited studies and their evaluation setups.

47eebf7543660707621fe7a19887ee571b576c88.goal: Improves GCM precipitation, especially extremes and the diurnal cycle, by training a hybrid model directly on satellite precipitation observations.
47eebf7543660707621fe7a19887ee571b576c88.architecture: Hybrid differentiable GCM built on NeuralGCM: a dynamical core with learned physics trained end-to-end, at 2.8° resolution.
47eebf7543660707621fe7a19887ee571b576c88.data: Satellite-based precipitation (IMERG) as the precipitation target, with ERA5 for atmospheric state; compared to GCMs, ERA5 and a global cloud-resolving model.
47eebf7543660707621fe7a19887ee571b576c88.result: Lower precipitation biases, more realistic precipitation distribution and extremes, better diurnal cycle than GCMs, ERA5 and a cloud-resolving model, and better mid-range precipitation forecasts than the ECMWF ensemble.
47eebf7543660707621fe7a19887ee571b576c88.open_work: Training on more observational datasets, finer resolution, and evaluating performance under climate change.
47eebf7543660707621fe7a19887ee571b576c88.issues: Coarse 2.8° resolution; behavior in warmer climates untested; relies on satellite product accuracy, which has its own retrieval biases.

8de0851f088a9871c5749c6fe879fe0711df2670.goal: Examines the fidelity and physical consistency of leading ML weather models beyond headline skill scores.
8de0851f088a9871c5749c6fe879fe0711df2670.architecture: Diagnostic analysis (not a new ML model) of forecasts from Pangu-Weather, FourCastNet and GraphCast, e.g. spectra, balance relationships and small-scale structure.
8de0851f088a9871c5749c6fe879fe0711df2670.data: ML model forecasts initialized from ERA5/operational analyses, compared with ECMWF IFS forecasts and analyses.
8de0851f088a9871c5749c6fe879fe0711df2670.result: The ML models fail to reproduce sub-synoptic and mesoscale phenomena and lack the fidelity and physical consistency of physics-based models, affecting interpretation of their skill.
8de0851f088a9871c5749c6fe879fe0711df2670.open_work: Designing ML models that balance forecast skill with physical realism, and evaluation metrics that reward realism.
8de0851f088a9871c5749c6fe879fe0711df2670.issues: Evaluates early-generation deterministic models trained with MSE losses; newer probabilistic and generative models may address some issues.

05520f75437cd1a36d66d85b3855da3834c31876.goal: Builds a general-purpose foundation model for weather and climate that can be fine-tuned for multiple downstream tasks.
05520f75437cd1a36d66d85b3855da3834c31876.architecture: 2.3-billion-parameter transformer encoder-decoder with local and global attention, trained with a mixed masked-reconstruction and forecasting objective.
05520f75437cd1a36d66d85b3855da3834c31876.data: MERRA-2 reanalysis with 160 variables for pretraining; downstream tasks use task-specific datasets.
05520f75437cd1a36d66d85b3855da3834c31876.result: Fine-tuned on autoregressive forecasting, downscaling, gravity wave flux parameterization and extreme event estimation; weights and fine-tuning workflows are openly released.
05520f75437cd1a36d66d85b3855da3834c31876.open_work: More downstream tasks, higher resolution data, and systematic comparison with specialized models.
05520f75437cd1a36d66d85b3855da3834c31876.issues: Forecast skill is not shown to match leading specialized models; MERRA-2 resolution and biases limit the base model.

533d77c2dd250e18da88b269cbb221c4835f1365.goal: Develops a machine learning probabilistic weather model to outperform the best operational ensemble (ECMWF ENS).
533d77c2dd250e18da88b269cbb221c4835f1365.architecture: GenCast: a conditional diffusion model with a graph-transformer denoiser on an icosahedral mesh, generating stochastic 12-hourly autoregressive trajectories.
533d77c2dd250e18da88b269cbb221c4835f1365.data: ERA5 reanalysis at 0.25° (about 1979-2018 training; 2019 test), with ERA5 initial states and ENS as baseline.
533d77c2dd250e18da88b269cbb221c4835f1365.result: Ensemble 15-day forecasts for over 80 variables in 8 minutes; more skillful than ENS on 97.2% of 1,320 targets, with better extremes, tropical cyclone tracks and wind power forecasts.
533d77c2dd250e18da88b269cbb221c4835f1365.open_work: Operational use with operational analyses, finer time steps, and improved representation of initial-condition uncertainty.
533d77c2dd250e18da88b269cbb221c4835f1365.issues: Trained on reanalysis and initialized from ERA5 (and ERA5 EDA perturbations), so it inherits their biases; 12-hour step and 0.25° limit small-scale detail; sampling cost exceeds deterministic ML.

907df33a6575657b1b7d3b73870cae9f4603eb24.goal: Perspective on how machine learning can advance climate modelling and analysis of climate model output and observations.
907df33a6575657b1b7d3b73870cae9f4603eb24.architecture: Perspective/review spanning ML parameterizations, hybrid and fully data-driven emulators, and ML-based analysis and evaluation of climate data.
907df33a6575657b1b7d3b73870cae9f4603eb24.data: Draws on published studies; no new data. Abstract not available.
907df33a6575657b1b7d3b73870cae9f4603eb24.result: Argues ML can reduce long-standing climate model biases and uncertainties, especially through hybrid physics-ML approaches, while noting limitations.
907df33a6575657b1b7d3b73870cae9f4603eb24.open_work: Likely includes building stable hybrid models, physical consistency, interpretability, and robust generalization to future climates.
907df33a6575657b1b7d3b73870cae9f4603eb24.issues: Abstract not available; details inferred from title and general knowledge of this perspective.

c6a9f104f754e7d5e517df0def59596b4ecf2df1.goal: Tests whether ML weather models trained on present-day climate generalize to different climate states, a prerequisite for climate applications.
c6a9f104f754e7d5e517df0def59596b4ecf2df1.architecture: Evaluation of three state-of-the-art ML weather forecasting models run out of distribution; no new model is trained.
c6a9f104f754e7d5e517df0def59596b4ecf2df1.data: Initial conditions from climate simulations representing pre-industrial, present-day and 2.9 K warmer climates.
c6a9f104f754e7d5e517df0def59596b4ecf2df1.result: Models remain skillful across climates, but two drift colder in the warmer climate and two of three warm in the pre-industrial case, pulling toward the training climate.
c6a9f104f754e7d5e517df0def59596b4ecf2df1.open_work: Remedies for climate drift, including adding ocean, sea-ice and land-surface information and training on more diverse climate states.
c6a9f104f754e7d5e517df0def59596b4ecf2df1.issues: Short-range forecasts only; climate-state biases indicate incomplete generalization; missing boundary forcing in training data contributes to the biases.

b8f2d7dade2289b716144e0b7d168a4028dcc548.goal: Builds an AI emulator for the ocean component of a climate model that is skillful and stable for long climate simulations.
b8f2d7dade2289b716144e0b7d168a4028dcc548.architecture: Samudra: a modified ConvNeXt U-Net autoregressive emulator of full-depth ocean state.
b8f2d7dade2289b716144e0b7d168a4028dcc548.data: Output of the GFDL OM4 ocean model at multiple depth levels: sea surface height, horizontal velocities, temperature and salinity.
b8f2d7dade2289b716144e0b7d168a4028dcc548.result: No drift relative to truth, reproduces depth structure and interannual variability, stable for centuries and about 150 times faster than OM4.
b8f2d7dade2289b716144e0b7d168a4028dcc548.open_work: Capturing the correct magnitude of forcing trends while remaining stable, and coupling with atmospheric emulators.
b8f2d7dade2289b716144e0b7d168a4028dcc548.issues: Underestimates responses to forcing trends; emulates a single model so inherits its biases; atmospheric forcing is prescribed.

ee94ccfa644f950711f63e7331b5563111dac80e.goal: Emulates the embedded cloud-resolving model of a multiscale modeling framework (MMF) with ML to achieve stable, realistic hybrid climate simulations.
ee94ccfa644f950711f63e7331b5563111dac80e.architecture: U-Net neural network parameterization of subgrid processes with physical thermodynamic constraints for microphysics, coupled online to the host model.
ee94ccfa644f950711f63e7331b5563111dac80e.data: Embedded convection-permitting simulations from E3SM-MMF (ClimSim-type data) with coarse real geography, seasonality and land coupling.
ee94ccfa644f950711f63e7331b5563111dac80e.result: Stable for at least 5 years with zonal mean tropospheric temperature bias within 2 K, water vapor within 1 g/kg and precipitation RMSE of 0.96 mm/day; first realistic multi-year cloud condensate climatology.
ee94ccfa644f950711f63e7331b5563111dac80e.open_work: Reducing persistent regional biases through new strategies for online performance optimization.
ee94ccfa644f950711f63e7331b5563111dac80e.issues: Persistent regional biases; 5-year runs are short for climate; tested only in the present-day configuration.

6f2b679e23b5ebf9c6367725e7f853dae09c5662.goal: Builds a data-driven global eddy-resolving ocean forecasting system that matches or exceeds numerical operational systems.
6f2b679e23b5ebf9c6367725e7f853dae09c5662.architecture: XiHe: hierarchical transformer with a land-ocean mask mechanism and ocean-specific blocks capturing local information and global teleconnections.
6f2b679e23b5ebf9c6367725e7f853dae09c5662.data: 25 years of GLORYS12 daily reanalysis at 1/12° for training; evaluated with satellite and in situ observations and the IV-TT Class 4 framework for 2019-2020.
6f2b679e23b5ebf9c6367725e7f853dae09c5662.result: Outperforms PSY4, GIOPS, BLUElinK and FOAM on all tested variables; 60-day current forecasts beat PSY4 at 10 days; 10-day forecast in 0.35 s.
6f2b679e23b5ebf9c6367725e7f853dae09c5662.open_work: Coupling with data assimilation, more variables and depths, and longer-range forecasting.
6f2b679e23b5ebf9c6367725e7f853dae09c5662.issues: Initialized from reanalysis rather than real-time analysis; trained on GLORYS so inherits its biases; mesoscale eddy fidelity at long leads may smooth.

d4a0e56c8723108c1eccb4ed9c51b104a956bdab.goal: Reviews AI for detecting, modeling and understanding extreme weather and climate events.
d4a0e56c8723108c1eccb4ed9c51b104a956bdab.architecture: Review of AI methods for floods, droughts, wildfires, heatwaves and other extremes, with emphasis on explainability and reliability.
d4a0e56c8723108c1eccb4ed9c51b104a956bdab.result: Highlights challenges of limited and noisy data, real-time integration, and interpretable deployment, and how AI can help identify and explain extremes.
d4a0e56c8723108c1eccb4ed9c51b104a956bdab.open_work: Interdisciplinary development of practical, trustworthy AI for disaster readiness and risk reduction.
d4a0e56c8723108c1eccb4ed9c51b104a956bdab.issues: Broad scope; qualitative synthesis without quantitative benchmarks.

022f8043f61d3b31cd6bc7486307535d273e4a7b.goal: Builds a generative emulator of km-scale global climate that avoids the drift and instability of autoregressive emulators.
022f8043f61d3b31cd6bc7486307535d273e4a7b.architecture: cBottle: two-stage diffusion framework on the HEALPix grid, a coarse generator conditioned on SST and solar position followed by patch-based 16x super-resolution.
022f8043f61d3b31cd6bc7486307535d273e4a7b.data: Global 5 km climate simulations and reanalysis data on HEALPix grids.
022f8043f61d3b31cd6bc7486307535d273e4a7b.result: Samples full atmospheric states at 12.5M pixels and passes tests of diurnal-to-seasonal variability, modes of variability, tropical cyclone statistics and climate trends; supports zero-shot bias correction, downscaling, infilling and guided TC sampling.
022f8043f61d3b31cd6bc7486307535d273e4a7b.open_work: Extending toward a full foundation model and new guidance methods for user queries.
022f8043f61d3b31cd6bc7486307535d273e4a7b.issues: Samples lack temporal coherence since there is no autoregressive dynamics; depends on prescribed SST; limited by short km-scale training records.

7f2c2f4e87d0773cb1224a0e86e52dfc7db41c1a.goal: Replaces the entire NWP pipeline (data assimilation, forecasting, post-processing) with a single end-to-end ML system.
7f2c2f4e87d0773cb1224a0e86e52dfc7db41c1a.architecture: Aardvark Weather: an encoder that maps raw observations to a gridded state, a processor for forecasting, and decoders for local station forecasts, fine-tuned end to end.
7f2c2f4e87d0773cb1224a0e86e52dfc7db41c1a.data: Raw satellite, in situ and station observations as inputs; ERA5 as gridded training target (about 1.5° resolution).
7f2c2f4e87d0773cb1224a0e86e52dfc7db41c1a.result: Global forecasts beat an operational NWP baseline for some variables and lead times; station forecasts are skillful to 10 days, competing with post-processed NWP.
7f2c2f4e87d0773cb1224a0e86e52dfc7db41c1a.open_work: Higher resolution, more observations and variables, and customized models for end users.
7f2c2f4e87d0773cb1224a0e86e52dfc7db41c1a.issues: Coarse resolution; trained against ERA5 so still depends on NWP-derived targets; does not beat the best operational systems overall.

0cb14b9c804827734eb05d09ba22c80ec8fb07f2.goal: Develops an AI global ocean forecast system that resolves mesoscale eddies and outperforms numerical systems.
0cb14b9c804827734eb05d09ba22c80ec8fb07f2.architecture: WenHai: deep neural network with bulk formulae for momentum, heat and freshwater fluxes embedded, and architecture choices preserving eddy variability.
0cb14b9c804827734eb05d09ba22c80ec8fb07f2.data: Global eddy-resolving ocean reanalysis for training (GLORYS-type) and atmospheric forcing; evaluated against observations. Details not reported in the abstract.
0cb14b9c804827734eb05d09ba22c80ec8fb07f2.result: Outperforms a state-of-the-art eddy-resolving numerical GOFS and an AI GOFS for temperature and salinity profiles, SST, sea level anomaly and near-surface currents at 1-10 days.
0cb14b9c804827734eb05d09ba22c80ec8fb07f2.open_work: Coupling with data assimilation and atmospheric models, and extension to longer leads.
0cb14b9c804827734eb05d09ba22c80ec8fb07f2.issues: Depends on reanalysis for training and initialization; forcing from atmospheric fields required; 10-day horizon limits assessment of long-term stability.

621286cf80dc20bdd4f08d53d018a2dde9b1fa1d.goal: Improves ML ensemble weather forecasting with a simpler, scalable approach than diffusion models.
621286cf80dc20bdd4f08d53d018a2dde9b1fa1d.architecture: FGN: generates ensemble members via learned functional model perturbations (noise injected into model parameters) across an ensemble of constrained models, trained to minimize per-location CRPS.
621286cf80dc20bdd4f08d53d018a2dde9b1fa1d.data: Reanalysis-based global training data (ERA5 and operational analyses). Not detailed in the abstract.
621286cf80dc20bdd4f08d53d018a2dde9b1fa1d.result: Significantly outperforms state-of-the-art models (including GenCast) on deterministic and probabilistic metrics, gives skillful ensemble TC tracks, and captures joint spatial structure despite marginal-only training.
621286cf80dc20bdd4f08d53d018a2dde9b1fa1d.open_work: Further evaluation of multivariate and spatial coherence, and operational deployment.
621286cf80dc20bdd4f08d53d018a2dde9b1fa1d.issues: Trained only on marginal CRPS, so joint-structure fidelity needs careful verification; inherits reanalysis biases.

12dfe910f4950e8b908eb0a22b89949f8dbaa837.goal: Bias-correct and downscale hourly precipitation, where existing deep learning and statistical methods fail to reproduce small-scale features and extremes.
12dfe910f4950e8b908eb0a22b89949f8dbaa837.architecture: Customized deep learning model combining weighted loss functions, multitask learning and physically relevant atmospheric covariates; six scenarios compared against regular DL and quantile mapping.
12dfe910f4950e8b908eb0a22b89949f8dbaa837.data: MERRA-2 reanalysis as input and Stage IV radar precipitation as target, hourly, over the northern Gulf of Mexico coastal region.
12dfe910f4950e8b908eb0a22b89949f8dbaa837.result: Weighted loss functions give the largest gains over conventional losses and quantile mapping at hourly, daily and monthly scales and for extremes; multitask learning helps fine features of extremes; covariates also improve skill.
12dfe910f4950e8b908eb0a22b89949f8dbaa837.open_work: Transfer to other regions, climates and coarse model output (e.g. climate projections) and adding probabilistic outputs follow naturally.
12dfe910f4950e8b908eb0a22b89949f8dbaa837.issues: Single region and single reanalysis/observation pair; deterministic output; generalization to other climates or future conditions is not demonstrated.

affcf07c8894bb67afbccf4310b3bd9d3200bc96.goal: Achieve stable, multi-year climate simulations with ML parameterizations of moist physics and radiation in a realistically configured GCM rather than aquaplanets.
affcf07c8894bb67afbccf4310b3bd9d3200bc96.architecture: Residual deep neural networks (ResDNNs) emulating super-parameterization (SP) inside a hybrid ML-physical CAM5 GCM; ensembles selected by trial and error for accuracy and online stability.
affcf07c8894bb67afbccf4310b3bd9d3200bc96.data: Training data from super-parameterized CAM (SPCAM) simulations with real geography at 1.9 x 2.5 degree resolution; compared against CAM5 and SP in prognostic runs.
affcf07c8894bb67afbccf4310b3bd9d3200bc96.result: Stable simulations exceed 10 years, about 30x faster than SP; improves tropical land precipitation, extreme precipitation frequency and MJO propagation versus CAM5.
affcf07c8894bb67afbccf4310b3bd9d3200bc96.open_work: Improve skill over tropical oceans and reduce mean-state biases; find principled rather than trial-and-error routes to stability.
affcf07c8894bb67afbccf4310b3bd9d3200bc96.issues: Larger mean-state biases than CAM5 in tropopause and high-latitude temperature and tropical ocean precipitation; network selection by trial and error; target is SP, not observations.

f2c5489482920ef246738353e6b1663db9597727.goal: Automatically recognize atmospheric rivers in large climate datasets without resolution-dependent detection thresholds.
f2c5489482920ef246738353e6b1663db9597727.architecture: Topological data analysis extracts shape features of integrated water vapor fields, which feed a supervised machine-learning classifier.
f2c5489482920ef246738353e6b1663db9597727.data: CAM5.1 climate model output and MERRA-2 reanalysis.
f2c5489482920ef246738353e6b1663db9597727.result: Threshold-free method provides AR topology and statistics, applies across resolutions and scenarios without retuning, and is fast enough for large datasets.
f2c5489482920ef246738353e6b1663db9597727.open_work: Applying the method to evaluate model AR biases and AR changes under different climate scenarios.
f2c5489482920ef246738353e6b1663db9597727.issues: Labels depend on an existing reference detection; classification of AR presence rather than full pixel-level segmentation; accuracy figures are not reported in the abstract.

47ac3bc32e5a6c85def8ba7e89dd8963cf5b0686.goal: Test whether a deep-learning weather model (Pangu-Weather) encodes atmospheric dynamics or merely pattern-matches, to judge its use for basic science.
47ac3bc32e5a6c85def8ba7e89dd8963cf5b0686.architecture: No new model; Pangu-Weather is subjected to four classical dynamical experiments using localized perturbations added to steady time-averaged states.
47ac3bc32e5a6c85def8ba7e89dd8963cf5b0686.data: Time-averaged (e.g. winter-mean) background states derived from the reanalysis-based climate on which Pangu-Weather operates; perturbation experiments are idealized.
47ac3bc32e5a6c85def8ba7e89dd8963cf5b0686.result: Reproduces a Matsuno-Gill response to tropical heating, realistic extratropical cyclones and fronts, geostrophic adjustment in about 6 h, and hurricane genesis above about 4 hPa initial amplitude that vanishes with zero humidity.
47ac3bc32e5a6c85def8ba7e89dd8963cf5b0686.open_work: Using such models as fast tools for testing a wide range of dynamical hypotheses, and testing other ML models similarly.
47ac3bc32e5a6c85def8ba7e89dd8963cf5b0686.issues: Qualitative assessment for one model; perturbation responses may partly reflect training-data analogues; no conservation or balance diagnostics beyond the experiments shown.

c2119098c19e580522afac875ad871681424c40a.goal: Provide environmental scientists with practical methods to create and evaluate uncertainty estimates from neural networks.
c2119098c19e580522afac875ad871681424c40a.architecture: Tutorial/review of six NN uncertainty-quantification approaches plus four evaluation graphics and eight scores for judging uncertainty quality; Jupyter notebooks provided.
c2119098c19e580522afac875ad871681424c40a.data: Two demonstrations: vertical dewpoint profile estimation (regression) and convection prediction over Taiwan from Himawari-8 imagery (classification).
c2119098c19e580522afac875ad871681424c40a.result: Shows how the UQ methods and evaluation tools can be applied and compared on real regression and classification problems.
c2119098c19e580522afac875ad871681424c40a.open_work: Broader adoption and systematic comparison of UQ methods across environmental applications.
c2119098c19e580522afac875ad871681424c40a.issues: Tutorial scope; method rankings are demonstration-specific and not a general benchmark.

9f88a34b8be77366f9324efed86e80c3c6a45065.goal: Produce high-resolution Arctic sea ice cover data for navigation and research, beyond the km-scale resolution of radiometer and scatterometer products.
9f88a34b8be77366f9324efed86e80c3c6a45065.architecture: Modified U-Net classifiers combined in an integrated stacking ensemble to separate sea ice from open water in SAR imagery.
9f88a34b8be77366f9324efed86e80c3c6a45065.data: More than 28,000 Sentinel-1 EW HH/HV images from 2019; validation with visual interpretation, AMSR2 concentration and IMS ice cover.
9f88a34b8be77366f9324efed86e80c3c6a45065.result: 400 m product with 96.10% overall accuracy on 96 visually interpreted cases, 5.55% mean absolute difference from AMSR2 and 93.98% agreement with IMS; more detail in the marginal ice zone.
9f88a34b8be77366f9324efed86e80c3c6a45065.open_work: Extending the product to more years and to sea ice concentration or type rather than binary cover.
9f88a34b8be77366f9324efed86e80c3c6a45065.issues: Only one year; binary ice/water classification; validation sample of 96 cases is small; SAR ambiguities (wind-roughened water, melt) may cause errors.

69277327825f30437b1fb3bae3c0d2143b3af6fc.goal: Build fast ML emulators of atmospheric chemistry solvers that remain stable over long simulations.
69277327825f30437b1fb3bae3c0d2143b3af6fc.architecture: Neural network solver with recurrent training to limit error accumulation, plus reversible compression of chemical species (more than 80% reduction); random initial conditions for generality.
69277327825f30437b1fb3bae3c0d2143b3af6fc.data: Simulations from a reference atmospheric chemical mechanism solver, initialized with random conditions.
69277327825f30437b1fb3bae3c0d2143b3af6fc.result: About 260x speedup (about 1,900x on specialized hardware); stable beyond one week; 24 h ozone median error 2.7 ppb and below 19 ppb in 99% of cases; PM median error 16 ug/m3.
69277327825f30437b1fb3bae3c0d2143b3af6fc.open_work: Further improvements before the ML models can replace traditional chemistry solvers, including handling extreme concentration fluctuations and coupling to 3-D models.
69277327825f30437b1fb3bae3c0d2143b3af6fc.issues: Errors much larger in the remaining 1% of cases with extreme fluctuations; box-model setting; not yet a replacement for the reference solver.

a675252789063d0b5886fc8cef6e039f02b88bc9.goal: Improve estimates of surface ocean pCO2 and air-sea CO2 flux by combining mechanistic biogeochemical models with sparse observations.
a675252789063d0b5886fc8cef6e039f02b88bc9.architecture: LDEO-HPD: XGBoost learns the model-data pCO2 misfit from observed predictors, then corrects global ocean biogeochemical model fields.
a675252789063d0b5886fc8cef6e039f02b88bc9.data: Global ocean biogeochemical model output and surface pCO2 observations (SOCAT-type data), 1982-2018; evaluated against independent pCO2 observations.
a675252789063d0b5886fc8cef6e039f02b88bc9.result: Better agreement with independent pCO2 observations than other observation-based products; global uptake agrees with other products and the Global Carbon Budget 2020 within uncertainty.
a675252789063d0b5886fc8cef6e039f02b88bc9.open_work: Reducing uncertainty in poorly sampled regions such as the Southern Ocean and extending the record.
a675252789063d0b5886fc8cef6e039f02b88bc9.issues: Correction relies on sparse observations, so data-poor regions and periods remain uncertain; inherits structural features of the underlying models.

325d747033ba5e2df7e7c843d1d792c0f8787553.goal: Build a parsimonious deep-learning weather model that stays stable for very long autoregressive rollouts at modest cost.
325d747033ba5e2df7e7c843d1d792c0f8787553.architecture: DLWP-HPX: U-Net on the HEALPix mesh with inverted channel depth and gated recurrent units at each U-Net level; location-invariant convolutions.
325d747033ba5e2df7e7c843d1d792c0f8787553.data: ERA5 reanalysis, seven prognostic variables, 3-hourly, on a roughly 110 km HEALPix mesh.
325d747033ba5e2df7e7c843d1d792c0f8787553.result: At 1-week lead, skill is about one day behind Pangu-Weather, GraphCast and ECMWF HRES; no loss of spectral power after day 2; realistic 1-year rollouts with seasonal cycle.
325d747033ba5e2df7e7c843d1d792c0f8787553.open_work: Adding more variables, higher resolution and ocean coupling for subseasonal and climate applications.
325d747033ba5e2df7e7c843d1d792c0f8787553.issues: Coarser resolution and fewer variables than state-of-the-art models; deterministic; trained on reanalysis so inherits its biases.

fe7548193426a357c3c4274fd3c5ece227138916.goal: Perform fully data-driven state estimation by integrating ML surrogate models into the data assimilation cycle.
fe7548193426a357c3c4274fd3c5ece227138916.architecture: Recurrent neural networks (reservoir computing type) replace the forecast model, forecast error covariance, and tangent linear and adjoint models; DA updates the hidden/reservoir state; domain localization and parallelization for scaling.
fe7548193426a357c3c4274fd3c5ece227138916.data: Synthetic observations from chaotic test systems such as the Lorenz-96 model.
fe7548193426a357c3c4274fd3c5ece227138916.result: RNN-DA can estimate the system state for repeated initialization of short-term forecasts without a numerical model, and scales to higher dimensions with localization.
fe7548193426a357c3c4274fd3c5ece227138916.open_work: Application to realistic NWP-scale models and real observations.
fe7548193426a357c3c4274fd3c5ece227138916.issues: Demonstrated on idealized, low-dimensional systems with synthetic observations; robustness to model error and real observation networks untested.

764a11187cb5a8b1f12566b57068688e405a847c.goal: Provide a benchmark for extending data-driven weather emulators to subseasonal-to-seasonal (S2S) timescales.
764a11187cb5a8b1f12566b57068688e405a847c.architecture: ChaosBench: multi-channel benchmark with deterministic, probabilistic and physics-based metrics, and operational physics-based baselines; evaluates ViT/ClimaX, Pangu-Weather, GraphCast and FourCastNetV2.
764a11187cb5a8b1f12566b57068688e405a847c.data: ERA5 atmosphere plus ocean, sea-ice and land reanalyses spanning over 45 years; S2S forecasts from four national weather agencies as baselines.
764a11187cb5a8b1f12566b57068688e405a847c.result: Weather-scale ML models collapse to unskilled climatology at S2S leads; ensembles, error-propagation control and physics-informed models extend predictability somewhat.
764a11187cb5a8b1f12566b57068688e405a847c.open_work: Developing coupled Earth-system emulators and probabilistic methods that retain skill at S2S leads.
764a11187cb5a8b1f12566b57068688e405a847c.issues: Benchmark findings depend on chosen metrics and baselines; ML models evaluated largely as designed for weather scales rather than retrained for S2S.

31ec3801f8f702330d63b2375eeba37165d67998.goal: Explain why climate models underestimate precipitation variance by learning the effect of convective organization on precipitation.
31ec3801f8f702330d63b2375eeba37165d67998.architecture: Neural network that implicitly learns a low-dimensional organization metric from high-resolution fields, combined with coarse-scale variables to predict precipitation.
31ec3801f8f702330d63b2375eeba37165d67998.data: High-resolution cloud-resolving simulation output, coarse-grained to climate-model scales.
31ec3801f8f702330d63b2375eeba37165d67998.result: The learned organization metric explains precipitation stochasticity almost entirely, could replace a stochastic parameterization, and is temporally persistent so it can be predicted from its own history.
31ec3801f8f702330d63b2375eeba37165d67998.open_work: Implementing the organization metric as a prognostic variable in a climate-model convection parameterization and testing online.
31ec3801f8f702330d63b2375eeba37165d67998.issues: Trained on idealized simulations; the metric is not directly observable; online coupled performance not shown in the abstract.

d8146a31d34021c05e2caa1d8387c2c7089b0d60.goal: Remove the dependence of ML weather models on NWP-produced initial conditions by building an end-to-end ML data assimilation and forecasting system.
d8146a31d34021c05e2caa1d8387c2c7089b0d60.architecture: FuXi Weather: ML forecast model coupled with ML-based assimilation of multi-satellite observations in a cycling DA-forecast system.
d8146a31d34021c05e2caa1d8387c2c7089b0d60.data: Multi-satellite observations (fewer than used by conventional NWP); ERA5-type reanalysis for training; compared with ECMWF HRES.
d8146a31d34021c05e2caa1d8387c2c7089b0d60.result: Reliable 10-day forecasts at 0.25 degree; outperforms ECMWF HRES beyond day one in observation-sparse regions such as central Africa; background forecasts help constrain analysis.
d8146a31d34021c05e2caa1d8387c2c7089b0d60.open_work: Adding more observation types (e.g. conventional and in situ data) and probabilistic DA and forecasting.
d8146a31d34021c05e2caa1d8387c2c7089b0d60.issues: Uses fewer observations than operational systems, so global skill may lag HRES in data-rich regions; reliance on reanalysis for training.

9656ddd001268a8c654e4a7cbbb4938ecd96ade8.goal: Develop a data-driven model for high-resolution regional forecasting while keeping a global domain for boundary information.
9656ddd001268a8c654e4a7cbbb4938ecd96ade8.architecture: Bris: graph neural network built on the AIFS framework with a stretched grid giving high resolution over the Nordics and coarse resolution elsewhere.
9656ddd001268a8c654e4a7cbbb4938ecd96ade8.data: Pretrained on 43 years of global ERA5 at 31 km; fine-tuned on 3.3 years of 2.5 km MEPS operational analyses; verified against Norwegian station observations.
9656ddd001268a8c654e4a7cbbb4938ecd96ade8.result: 2.5 km, 6-hourly forecasts; lower 2 m temperature RMSE than both MEPS control and ensemble mean; competitive precipitation and wind speed.
9656ddd001268a8c654e4a7cbbb4938ecd96ade8.open_work: Improving extremes, increasing temporal resolution and adding probabilistic forecasts.
9656ddd001268a8c654e4a7cbbb4938ecd96ade8.issues: Underestimates extreme events; 6-hour time step coarse for short-range needs; short high-resolution training record.

a8e0ee7aa27d5b0baa7b45a0a04cdb3f496be77b.goal: Make long-range forecasts of global monthly SST anomalies, including ENSO and marine heatwaves.
a8e0ee7aa27d5b0baa7b45a0a04cdb3f496be77b.architecture: Unet-LSTM deep learning time series model predicting 2-D global SST fields up to 24 months ahead.
a8e0ee7aa27d5b0baa7b45a0a04cdb3f496be77b.data: ERA5 monthly mean SST and 2 m air temperature, 1950-2021.
a8e0ee7aa27d5b0baa7b45a0a04cdb3f496be77b.result: High skill in equatorial and subtropical Pacific; skill up to 18 months for 2019-2020 El Nino and 2016-2018 La Ninas; long-lead skill for the northeast Pacific Blob.
a8e0ee7aa27d5b0baa7b45a0a04cdb3f496be77b.open_work: Including subsurface ocean information to capture events like the 2015-2016 El Nino.
a8e0ee7aa27d5b0baa7b45a0a04cdb3f496be77b.issues: Weak prediction of the 2015-2016 extreme El Nino; short-lead skill only for Ningaloo Nino; surface-only inputs; limited independent test period.

22086b4549aa13b96316f54f3c3c6f175ff38b85.goal: Assess how well statistical methods remove meteorological variability when estimating emission-driven air quality trends.
22086b4549aa13b96316f54f3c3c6f175ff38b85.architecture: Multiple linear regression and other methods, including random forest with local and regional meteorological features, tested against a chemical transport model ground truth; a GEOS-Chem-based correction method.
22086b4549aa13b96316f54f3c3c6f175ff38b85.data: GEOS-Chem simulations as synthetic data for PM2.5 and O3 in the US (2011-2017) and China (2013-2017), including constant-meteorology and constant-emission runs.
22086b4549aa13b96316f54f3c3c6f175ff38b85.result: Common regression methods correct poorly; random forest reduces trend estimation error by 30-42%; emission and meteorological influences are partly inseparable.
22086b4549aa13b96316f54f3c3c6f175ff38b85.open_work: Recommendations for applying statistical approaches in policy evaluations with real observations.
22086b4549aa13b96316f54f3c3c6f175ff38b85.issues: Evaluation relies on a model world, so results depend on GEOS-Chem fidelity; interaction effects limit any purely statistical separation.

cbbe71208ea0d8b98509d5eb3cc74c57bb7412bc.goal: Review how machine learning can improve El Nino prediction beyond the roughly 6-month skill limit of classical methods.
cbbe71208ea0d8b98509d5eb3cc74c57bb7412bc.architecture: Review of neural-network-based ENSO prediction, including attribute selection from complex network approaches.
cbbe71208ea0d8b98509d5eb3cc74c57bb7412bc.data: Reviewed studies use observational and reanalysis tropical Pacific data and climate model output.
cbbe71208ea0d8b98509d5eb3cc74c57bb7412bc.result: Early ML results show enhanced skill for lead times beyond 12 months.
cbbe71208ea0d8b98509d5eb3cc74c57bb7412bc.open_work: Critical outlook on further developments, including better predictors and robust validation.
cbbe71208ea0d8b98509d5eb3cc74c57bb7412bc.issues: Review predates many later deep learning ENSO studies; small observational sample size limits skill verification.

3f6e39d109175487652f41e0ef2ca0049adb0793.goal: Train physics-based and ML parameterizations without gradients or residual tendencies by posing learning as an inverse problem.
3f6e39d109175487652f41e0ef2ca0049adb0793.architecture: Unscented and ensemble Kalman inversion, gradient-free and parallelizable, applied to calibrate an eddy-diffusivity mass-flux (EDMF) turbulence and convection scheme, including hybrid closures with neural networks.
3f6e39d109175487652f41e0ef2ca0049adb0793.data: Large-eddy simulation data used as calibration targets.
3f6e39d109175487652f41e0ef2ca0049adb0793.result: Methods converge quickly, are robust to noise and model failures, support batching, and calibrate hybrid parameterizations; unscented Kalman inversion gives parameter uncertainty.
3f6e39d109175487652f41e0ef2ca0049adb0793.open_work: Calibrating parameterizations against observations and climate statistics within full Earth system models.
3f6e39d109175487652f41e0ef2ca0049adb0793.issues: Demonstrated in single-column setting with LES targets; scaling to very high-dimensional neural network parameter spaces is challenging.

2b16403d718ddbf25ce3fdb2237e064d84a2caae.goal: Assess whether deep learning medium-range weather models can forecast extreme weather robustly.
2b16403d718ddbf25ce3fdb2237e064d84a2caae.architecture: Review of recent deep learning weather forecasting models and the challenges extremes pose; proposes a foundational workflow for extreme-focused models.
2b16403d718ddbf25ce3fdb2237e064d84a2caae.data: Not applicable (review); covers models trained mostly on ERA5.
2b16403d718ddbf25ce3fdb2237e064d84a2caae.result: Identifies limitations of leading models for extremes and argues data-driven models need to be tailored to extreme events.
2b16403d718ddbf25ce3fdb2237e064d84a2caae.open_work: Implementing the proposed workflow, including extreme-aware losses, evaluation and data.
2b16403d718ddbf25ce3fdb2237e064d84a2caae.issues: Review; rapidly evolving field so specific model assessments may date quickly.

df993e97fda975038337507453ae063445a7fb60.goal: Estimate 3-D ocean hydrographic structure by projecting satellite surface data to depth.
df993e97fda975038337507453ae063445a7fb60.architecture: Stacked LSTM neural network with Monte Carlo dropout for uncertainty, trained on co-located in situ vertical profiles.
df993e97fda975038337507453ae063445a7fb60.data: Satellite surface observations and in situ profiles over the North Atlantic, 2010-2018.
df993e97fda975038337507453ae063445a7fb60.result: Produces temperature and salinity profiles with uncertainties, outperforming simpler statistical methods and feed-forward networks.
df993e97fda975038337507453ae063445a7fb60.open_work: Extending to other basins and integrating with ocean reanalysis or assimilation systems.
df993e97fda975038337507453ae063445a7fb60.issues: Regional application; depends on sparse in situ profiles; quantitative skill not reported in the abstract.

db61f512b35c4c248e94f938981e1fc3462c24aa.goal: Find interpretable, transferable cloud cover parameterizations that avoid neural networks' poor out-of-distribution behavior.
db61f512b35c4c248e94f938981e1fc3462c24aa.architecture: Hierarchical framework combining symbolic regression, sequential feature selection and physical constraints to discover analytical cloud cover equations.
db61f512b35c4c248e94f938981e1fc3462c24aa.data: Coarse-grained global storm-resolving ICON simulations; transfer tested on ERA5 reanalysis.
db61f512b35c4c248e94f938981e1fc3462c24aa.result: Best equation reaches R2 = 0.94 with 11 parameters, comparable to NNs, beats Xu-Randall across regimes (Hellinger distance below 0.09), and transfers better to ERA5 than other schemes.
db61f512b35c4c248e94f938981e1fc3462c24aa.open_work: Online implementation in climate models and equation discovery for other parameterized processes.
db61f512b35c4c248e94f938981e1fc3462c24aa.issues: Diagnostic cloud cover only; online performance and climate-change generalization not shown in the abstract.

b8911fef2cc1f6be4a71bfd294d10cde67c677e0.goal: Improve 1-3 day deterministic air pollution forecasts used for public health communication.
b8911fef2cc1f6be4a71bfd294d10cde67c677e0.architecture: Random forest, XGBoost and LSTM post-processing of deterministic forecasts, with four feature-importance methods including SHAP.
b8911fef2cc1f6be4a71bfd294d10cde67c677e0.data: Deterministic dispersion and CAMS forecasts plus measurements of PM10, NOx and O3 at sites in Greater Stockholm, Sweden.
b8911fef2cc1f6be4a71bfd294d10cde67c677e0.result: ML improves forecasts for all sites and pollutants; NOx MSE at street canyons drops by up to 60%; gains depend more on pollutant and site than algorithm; tree models now used operationally.
b8911fef2cc1f6be4a71bfd294d10cde67c677e0.open_work: Better prediction of short high-concentration peaks and generic models using spatial as well as temporal variation.
b8911fef2cc1f6be4a71bfd294d10cde67c677e0.issues: Struggles with peaks at street canyon sites; site-specific training; limited generalization for PM10 except with LSTM.

07ae762dc6620e3211171f22dfdd942a30ee7512.goal: Develop neural network cloud cover parameterizations for ICON from storm-resolving simulations.
07ae762dc6620e3211171f22dfdd942a30ee7512.architecture: Three NN types differing in vertical locality (cell-based, neighborhood-based, column-based), with SHAP interpretability analysis.
07ae762dc6620e3211171f22dfdd942a30ee7512.data: Coarse-grained regional (NARVAL) and global (QUBICC) ICON storm-resolving simulations.
07ae762dc6620e3211171f22dfdd942a30ee7512.result: NNs accurately diagnose subgrid cloud cover in similar regimes; global NNs reproduce regional SRM cloud cover; SHAP shows column-based NN overemphasizes specific humidity and cloud ice.
07ae762dc6620e3211171f22dfdd942a30ee7512.open_work: Online coupling in ICON and improving generalization, with neighborhood models as a compromise.
07ae762dc6620e3211171f22dfdd942a30ee7512.issues: Offline, diagnostic evaluation only; generalization limited outside training distribution.

a434f28fb4f2da407c11cf104e47f4c5a12bae13.goal: Perform probabilistic statistical downscaling of biased coarse simulations without paired low/high-resolution data.
a434f28fb4f2da407c11cf104e47f4c5a12bae13.architecture: Two stages: optimal transport map for debiasing at coarse resolution, then a probabilistic diffusion model with conditional sampling for upsampling.
a434f28fb4f2da407c11cf104e47f4c5a12bae13.data: One- and two-dimensional fluid flow simulations representative of weather and climate difficulties.
a434f28fb4f2da407c11cf104e47f4c5a12bae13.result: Produces realistic outputs at 8x and 16x upsampling and matches physical statistics even when low-frequency content of inputs and outputs differs.
a434f28fb4f2da407c11cf104e47f4c5a12bae13.open_work: Application to real weather and climate model output and observations.
a434f28fb4f2da407c11cf104e47f4c5a12bae13.issues: Demonstrated on idealized fluid flows only; computational cost of diffusion sampling; no real-data validation.

42ee444d8a5bd6dabbff4902bc846cf0b65d9f54.goal: Summarize the use of deep learning for predicting extreme weather.
42ee444d8a5bd6dabbff4902bc846cf0b65d9f54.architecture: Survey of methods, mainly recurrent neural networks and convolutional neural networks applied to extreme weather prediction.
42ee444d8a5bd6dabbff4902bc846cf0b65d9f54.result: Preliminary summary showing deep learning can extract image features of extreme weather and estimate occurrence likelihood.
42ee444d8a5bd6dabbff4902bc846cf0b65d9f54.open_work: Not detailed in the abstract; more rigorous evaluation of DL for rare events follows naturally.
42ee444d8a5bd6dabbff4902bc846cf0b65d9f54.issues: Preliminary and broad; predates recent global ML weather models; limited critical assessment evident from the abstract.

9bc9f65f26a85c3df2c445834f76967f00612806.goal: Disentangle the influences of aerosols and greenhouse gases on regional surface temperature trends.
9bc9f65f26a85c3df2c445834f76967f00612806.architecture: Artificial neural network predicting the year from near-surface temperature maps, explained with layer-wise relevance propagation plus a simple uncertainty metric to mask noise.
9bc9f65f26a85c3df2c445834f76967f00612806.data: CESM1 single-forcing initial-condition large ensembles with different aerosol and greenhouse gas forcing; observational temperature maps.
9bc9f65f26a85c3df2c445834f76967f00612806.result: North Atlantic, Southern Ocean and Southeast Asia are key regions; observations correlate better with the year after training on the ensemble with aerosols fixed at 1920 levels.
9bc9f65f26a85c3df2c445834f76967f00612806.open_work: Further use of XAI to understand nonlinear combinations of anthropogenic forcings across models.
9bc9f65f26a85c3df2c445834f76967f00612806.issues: Single climate model; LRP relevance depends on network and method choice; attribution is indirect.

546be866949bfa9a0eaa418cfb40934bcf69c5d0.goal: Couple a data-driven weather model with data assimilation so ML forecasting does not depend on traditional analysis systems.
546be866949bfa9a0eaa418cfb40934bcf69c5d0.architecture: FengWu-4DVar: the FengWu AI forecast model inside a 4D-Var assimilation cycle, using auto-differentiation instead of a hand-coded adjoint.
546be866949bfa9a0eaa418cfb40934bcf69c5d0.data: Simulated observations (derived from reanalysis) in cycling experiments.
546be866949bfa9a0eaa418cfb40934bcf69c5d0.result: Generates reasonable analysis fields and accurate, efficient cycled forecasts without a physical model.
546be866949bfa9a0eaa418cfb40934bcf69c5d0.open_work: Assimilating real observations and comparing against operational analyses.
546be866949bfa9a0eaa418cfb40934bcf69c5d0.issues: Tested only with simulated observations; background error covariance treatment and real-observation issues not addressed in the abstract.

607fe577a880363d5a32bbabec17e6a2f10007c6.goal: Forecast probabilities of extreme long-lasting heatwaves and study how training-data length limits skill.
607fe577a880363d5a32bbabec17e6a2f10007c6.architecture: Convolutional neural networks taking 500 hPa geopotential height, soil moisture and related fields to predict heatwave occurrence probability.
607fe577a880363d5a32bbabec17e6a2f10007c6.data: Extremely long climate model simulations (thousands of years) from an intermediate-complexity climate model; heatwaves over France.
607fe577a880363d5a32bbabec17e6a2f10007c6.result: Positive skill up to 15 days for 14-day heatwaves from geopotential, longer from soil moisture; NN identifies wavenumber-3 patterns; 100-year training sets yield much lower skill.
607fe577a880363d5a32bbabec17e6a2f10007c6.open_work: Rare-event simulation and transfer learning to cope with the lack-of-data regime.
607fe577a880363d5a32bbabec17e6a2f10007c6.issues: Trained and tested in a climate model world, not observations; skill drops sharply with realistic data lengths.

e7352d8f6420945b1ca7f18e75aa6d2c6829d00b.goal: Nowcast severe thunderstorm events with timely warnings.
e7352d8f6420945b1ca7f18e75aa6d2c6829d00b.architecture: Deep learning on radar reflectivity videos plus lightning data, framed as classification with an ensemble method using value-weighted skill scores.
e7352d8f6420945b1ca7f18e75aa6d2c6829d00b.data: Weather radar and lightning data from Liguria, Italy.
e7352d8f6420945b1ca7f18e75aa6d2c6829d00b.result: Produces a warning machine validated against radar data for the region.
e7352d8f6420945b1ca7f18e75aa6d2c6829d00b.open_work: Testing at other regions and operational evaluation.
e7352d8f6420945b1ca7f18e75aa6d2c6829d00b.issues: Single region; quantitative skill not reported in the abstract; limited number of severe events.

2918c5384ca86484e26958291d0561c6608ffaf7.goal: Argue for how to accelerate climate model improvement combining process knowledge, resolution and AI.
2918c5384ca86484e26958291d0561c6608ffaf7.architecture: Opinion piece: AI-derived closure functions embedded in process-based parameterizations with conservation laws, plus moderately increased resolution around 10 km.
2918c5384ca86484e26958291d0561c6608ffaf7.data: Not applicable (opinion); proposes learning from observations and high-resolution simulations.
2918c5384ca86484e26958291d0561c6608ffaf7.result: Recommends a balanced approach and argues resolution beyond about 10 km would hinder ensembles needed for calibration and uncertainty quantification.
2918c5384ca86484e26958291d0561c6608ffaf7.open_work: Implementing hybrid parameterizations and calibration frameworks in full climate models.
2918c5384ca86484e26958291d0561c6608ffaf7.issues: Perspective rather than demonstration; trade-offs depend on future computing.

ebbda23710122a5ea2a466f55ba063f1efcade68.goal: Provides a large, consistent, ML-ready multi-model climate dataset, since most ML emulation, downscaling and prediction work relies on output from a single climate model.
ebbda23710122a5ea2a466f55ba063f1efcade68.architecture: Dataset and modular retrieval/preprocessing pipeline; benchmarks several ML emulators (forcing-to-climate mapping) and a multi-model 'super emulator'.
ebbda23710122a5ea2a466f55ba063f1efcade68.data: Forcing inputs from Input4MIPs and outputs of 36 CMIP6 climate models across scenarios; pipeline can add further models and scenarios.
ebbda23710122a5ea2a466f55ba063f1efcade68.result: Emulator benchmarks show that ML model performance and generalization vary substantially across climate models; training on several models at once is feasible.
ebbda23710122a5ea2a466f55ba063f1efcade68.open_work: Extending to more variables, models and tasks (downscaling, prediction) and assessing whether super emulators generalize to unseen scenarios and models.
ebbda23710122a5ea2a466f55ba063f1efcade68.issues: Benchmarks are emulation of model output, so they inherit CMIP6 biases; coarse resolution and limited scenario set constrain conclusions about generalization.

77b0986bc150258b8f21e364b6a20a7be29a2990.goal: Estimates instantaneous precipitation from geostationary satellite infrared imagery, which lacks direct sensitivity to surface rain, using deep learning.
77b0986bc150258b8f21e364b6a20a7be29a2990.architecture: Multiscale encoder-decoder convolutional neural network that detects precipitating pixels and estimates rain rate.
77b0986bc150258b8f21e364b6a20a7be29a2990.data: SEVIRI/MSG channels at 8.7, 10.8 and 12.0 micron plus in situ rain gauge measurements over Belgium, the Netherlands and Germany as targets.
77b0986bc150258b8f21e364b6a20a7be29a2990.result: Detects precipitating pixels with POD 0.75 and FAR 0.3; estimates instantaneous rain rate with RMSE of 1.6 mm/h.
77b0986bc150258b8f21e364b6a20a7be29a2990.open_work: Testing over other regions and climates, adding more channels or radar targets, and comparison with operational satellite precipitation products.
77b0986bc150258b8f21e364b6a20a7be29a2990.issues: Regional training over western Europe; infrared-only inputs limit skill for warm rain; gauge point measurements versus pixel-scale estimates introduce representativeness error.

7f7bb9ba221db8db337cb0c55667fa278c0df767.goal: Provides a common benchmark dataset so that statistical postprocessing methods for medium-range forecasts can be compared fairly for operational choices.
7f7bb9ba221db8db337cb0c55667fa278c0df767.architecture: Benchmark dataset of time-aligned forecasts and observations with proposed evaluation methods; first benchmark compares several postprocessing methods for 2 m temperature.
7f7bb9ba221db8db337cb0c55667fa278c0df767.data: ECMWF ensemble forecasts and reforecasts paired with station observations and gridded data over a central European domain (EUMETNET), distributed via climetlab and Zenodo.
7f7bb9ba221db8db337cb0c55667fa278c0df767.result: Releases the public EUPPBench v1.0 dataset with download examples, evaluation protocol and a first intercomparison of 2 m temperature correction methods.
7f7bb9ba221db8db337cb0c55667fa278c0df767.open_work: Extending to more variables (wind, precipitation), longer periods and larger domains, and broader method intercomparisons.
7f7bb9ba221db8db337cb0c55667fa278c0df767.issues: Version 1 focuses on 2 m temperature and a limited region, so conclusions may not transfer to other variables or climates.

50e6d6b328d593ae91f09312a9a7e6cf841e7eab.goal: Identifies the physical mechanisms behind projected weakening of North Atlantic circulation under warming, using transparent ML to keep predictions physically tractable.
50e6d6b328d593ae91f09312a9a7e6cf841e7eab.architecture: THOR: interpretable equation transform plus k-means to label dynamical regimes, then a multilayer perceptron explained with layerwise relevance propagation and theory.
50e6d6b328d593ae91f09312a9a7e6cf841e7eab.data: Climate model output (CMIP6 abrupt 4xCO2 and 1% per year CO2 experiments) using only ocean depth, dynamic sea level and wind stress as inputs.
50e6d6b328d593ae91f09312a9a7e6cf841e7eab.result: Under abrupt CO2 quadrupling, weakening arises from shifted deep water formation regions, a northward Gulf Stream shift and an eastward North Atlantic Current shift; 1% CO2 runs show similar weaker patterns.
50e6d6b328d593ae91f09312a9a7e6cf841e7eab.open_work: Applying THOR across more climate models and to observations to test robustness of the identified regime shifts.
50e6d6b328d593ae91f09312a9a7e6cf841e7eab.issues: Results rely on model simulations and a regime labeling built on a barotropic vorticity framework; regime shifts may be model-dependent.

9212923c425e9ba92008c6c0ab3d548e7a8d4f93.goal: Supplies a long-term, homogeneous satellite image dataset of tropical cyclones for benchmarking spatio-temporal ML models.
9212923c425e9ba92008c6c0ab3d548e7a8d4f93.architecture: Dataset with a processing workflow (typhoon-centered infrared crops in Lambert azimuthal equal-area projection, inter-satellite calibration) and benchmark tasks for analysis, forecasting and reanalysis of intensity.
9212923c425e9ba92008c6c0ab3d548e7a8d4f93.data: Over 40 years of geostationary infrared imagery of western North Pacific typhoons, aligned with best track data.
9212923c425e9ba92008c6c0ab3d548e7a8d4f93.result: Benchmarks show the intensity tasks remain challenging for recent deep learning models, with performance sensitive to many design choices.
9212923c425e9ba92008c6c0ab3d548e7a8d4f93.open_work: Developing models for track and intensity forecasting, societal impact and climate change tasks using the dataset.
9212923c425e9ba92008c6c0ab3d548e7a8d4f93.issues: Single infrared channel and western Pacific basin only; best track labels contain agency-dependent uncertainties.

37c351328c530be0fdf8ecb724f0d252a6cfbb8e.goal: Builds a lightweight data-driven climate emulator that remains stable and physically consistent over century-long autoregressive runs, unlike most AI weather models.
37c351328c530be0fdf8ecb724f0d252a6cfbb8e.architecture: Low-resolution SFNO-based emulator with a hard-constrained first-order integrator, spectral regularization for fine scales, and a training strategy for data-limited settings.
37c351328c530be0fdf8ecb724f0d252a6cfbb8e.data: 6-hourly ERA5 at coarse resolution; can be trained on as little as 2 years of data.
37c351328c530be0fdf8ecb724f0d252a6cfbb8e.result: Stable for 100-year simulations with 100 ensemble members; climatology and variability of temperature, wind, precipitation and humidity match ERA5; trains in 2.4 hours on one A100.
37c351328c530be0fdf8ecb724f0d252a6cfbb8e.open_work: Using large ensembles to study extremes, responses to external forcing, and variable importance; adding forcing to represent climate change.
37c351328c530be0fdf8ecb724f0d252a6cfbb8e.issues: Coarse resolution and no ocean coupling or time-varying forcing, so it reproduces present-day climate rather than projections; inherits ERA5 biases.

5430984aa9c0dae3948a167f7049e661ba56e23b.goal: Generates daily temperature and precipitation from monthly ESM or emulator output so that daily extremes such as heat waves can be analyzed cheaply.
5430984aa9c0dae3948a167f7049e661ba56e23b.architecture: Conditional 3D (space-time) diffusion model that temporally downscales monthly means to daily fields.
5430984aa9c0dae3948a167f7049e661ba56e23b.data: A handful of ESM realizations spanning a range of radiative forcing scenarios (CMIP6 ESM output).
5430984aa9c0dae3948a167f7049e661ba56e23b.result: Produces daily fields whose extremes (heat waves, dry spells, rainfall intensity) closely match ESM statistics in frequency and spatial characteristics.
5430984aa9c0dae3948a167f7049e661ba56e23b.open_work: Coupling to monthly emulators for full pipelines, extending to more variables and multiple ESMs, and joint multivariate generation.
5430984aa9c0dae3948a167f7049e661ba56e23b.issues: Emulates a specific ESM so inherits its biases; skill outside the training forcing range and for rare extremes is uncertain.

00d63fcb5bf7667d4bffa43a1aa9433686a568b0.goal: Improves the operational GPM passive microwave precipitation retrieval (GPROF) using modern neural networks.
00d63fcb5bf7667d4bffa43a1aa9433686a568b0.architecture: Two probabilistic neural-network retrievals: GPROF-NN 1D (pixel-wise) and GPROF-NN 3D (convolutional, using spatial structure).
00d63fcb5bf7667d4bffa43a1aa9433686a568b0.data: The same a priori database and inputs as GPROF for GMI and MHS sensors; independent check with Hurricane Harvey against GPM combined and ground radar.
00d63fcb5bf7667d4bffa43a1aa9433686a568b0.result: For GMI, 1D lowers MAE from 0.079 to 0.059 mm/h and raises correlation from 0.797 to 0.847; 3D reaches MAE 0.043 mm/h and correlation 0.897. Runtime is lower than GPROF.
00d63fcb5bf7667d4bffa43a1aa9433686a568b0.open_work: Validation against independent measurements, especially for MHS, and operational adoption in the GPM pipeline.
00d63fcb5bf7667d4bffa43a1aa9433686a568b0.issues: Main evaluation uses a test set consistent with training data, so training-data representativeness errors are not assessed; MHS gains unclear on independent data.

17083d7cb404ed1b79d0b40ee96c273b89f0cb11.goal: Learns state-dependent systematic sea ice model errors from data assimilation increments as a basis for ML bias correction or parameterization.
17083d7cb404ed1b79d0b40ee96c273b89f0cb11.architecture: Convolutional neural network mapping forecast states and tendencies to sea ice concentration analysis increments.
17083d7cb404ed1b79d0b40ee96c273b89f0cb11.data: GFDL SPEAR ice-ocean DA system assimilating satellite sea ice concentration every 5 days, 1982-2017; inputs include SIC, SST, ice velocity, thickness, shortwave, skin temperature, salinity and land-sea mask.
17083d7cb404ed1b79d0b40ee96c273b89f0cb11.result: CNN predicts increments skillfully in both hemispheres and all seasons, consistently beating a climatological increment prediction.
17083d7cb404ed1b79d0b40ee96c273b89f0cb11.open_work: Implementing the CNN online in free-running SPEAR as a parameterization or bias correction and testing its effect on simulated sea ice.
17083d7cb404ed1b79d0b40ee96c273b89f0cb11.issues: Offline only; increments mix model error with observation and DA errors; only concentration increments are learned.

eb8268307580823b2f3668eecf1ab15ad4a26dd4.goal: Streamlines data curation for subseasonal (2-6 week) forecasting in the US, where dynamical models have limited skill.
eb8268307580823b2f3668eecf1ab15ad4a26dd4.architecture: Curated dataset and benchmark comparing operational dynamical models, classical baselines and ten ML/deep learning methods.
eb8268307580823b2f3668eecf1ab15ad4a26dd4.data: Multi-source US subseasonal data (temperature, precipitation, climate indices and dynamical forecasts) at regular grid, accessible via a Python package.
eb8268307580823b2f3668eecf1ab15ad4a26dd4.result: Benchmarks suggest simple, effective ways (e.g. learned corrections and ensembling) to improve on operational models.
eb8268307580823b2f3668eecf1ab15ad4a26dd4.open_work: Regular updates, expansion to more targets and regions, and testing new deep learning methods on the benchmark.
eb8268307580823b2f3668eecf1ab15ad4a26dd4.issues: US-only domain; subseasonal skill is low overall so differences between methods may be small and period-dependent.

67afa64612fc21f160f8ca75653ac8f44436463b.goal: Enables data-driven weather forecasts at finer time steps than the training data resolution by embedding physical evolution.
67afa64612fc21f160f8ca75653ac8f44436463b.architecture: WeatherGFT: physics-AI hybrid with a PDE kernel integrating dynamics at small steps (e.g. 300 s) and parallel neural networks with a learnable router for bias correction, plus lead time-aware training.
67afa64612fc21f160f8ca75653ac8f44436463b.data: Hourly reanalysis (ERA5) for training; evaluation across multiple lead times including sub-hourly.
67afa64612fc21f160f8ca75653ac8f44436463b.result: Generalizes forecasts across time scales, including 30-minute forecasts finer than the dataset resolution; weight analysis shows physics drives evolution while AI corrects.
67afa64612fc21f160f8ca75653ac8f44436463b.open_work: Verifying sub-hourly forecasts against independent high-frequency observations and extending physics to more processes.
67afa64612fc21f160f8ca75653ac8f44436463b.issues: Ground truth at 30-minute scales is lacking in hourly data, so sub-hourly skill is hard to verify; simplified PDE kernel omits many physical processes.

6ac66bf1eb648449daeaff7f99203e5cfcebe741.goal: Downscales precipitation while capturing the conditional distribution needed for reliable ensembles and unbiased extremes.
6ac66bf1eb648449daeaff7f99203e5cfcebe741.architecture: Deterministic downscaler followed by a temporally conditioned video diffusion model that adds stochastic high-frequency detail.
6ac66bf1eb648449daeaff7f99203e5cfcebe741.data: FV3GFS global atmosphere model output, coarse versus fine resolution; case regions include California and the Himalayas.
6ac66bf1eb648449daeaff7f99203e5cfcebe741.result: Outperforms six state-of-the-art baselines in CRPS, MSE and precipitation distribution metrics.
6ac66bf1eb648449daeaff7f99203e5cfcebe741.open_work: Applying to observations or other climate models and testing in climate change settings.
6ac66bf1eb648449daeaff7f99203e5cfcebe741.issues: Trained and evaluated within one model (perfect-model setting); computational cost of diffusion sampling; limited regions examined.

ecce87d8a72db4db12a7adb9e1f7c9c8ded85028.goal: From the title, develops a deep learning model for ENSO forecasting that is interpretable, to link predictive skill to physical precursors.
ecce87d8a72db4db12a7adb9e1f7c9c8ded85028.architecture: Deep learning model with interpretability analysis; specific architecture not reported in available information.
ecce87d8a72db4db12a7adb9e1f7c9c8ded85028.data: Not reported in the abstract (abstract unavailable); likely climate model and reanalysis ocean-atmosphere fields.
ecce87d8a72db4db12a7adb9e1f7c9c8ded85028.open_work: Not reported; natural steps include validating interpretations against ENSO theory and extending lead times.
